title: Ham & egg Brioche
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 Celsius
Fill each bowl with one slice of **3 slices Prosciutto** so that the whole bottom and sides are covered
Add one egg into each bowl
Place it in the oven on a baking tray and set the timer for 15 minutes
Take it out, add **Little Bowl of Grained Cheese**, bit of salt and pepper
Enjoy it

title: Low Carb Palatschinken mit Mandelmehl
instructions: Mixen Sie die **6  Eier** mit dem Handmixer ein bisschen schaumig
Fügen Sie alle anderen Zutaten hinzu und mixen Sie die Masse gut durch
Erhitzen Sie die Pfanne und geben Sie ausreichend Masse in die Mitte der Pfanne
Schwenken Sie langsam die Pfanne bis sich die Masse komplett verteilt hat
Nachdem eine Seite goldbraun gebraten ist, drehen Sie die Palatschinke vorsichtig mit einem Pfannenwender um
Wiederholen Sie den Vorgang bis die gesamte Masse zu Palatschinken verarbeitet ist
Servieren Sie die Palatschinken mit kohlehydratarmer Marmelade, Nutella oder Erdnussbutter
Guten Appetit!

title: Keto Low Carb Bauernbrot
instructions: **4  Eier** mit etwas Salz gut vermischen
Sobald sie in die beste Flaumigkeit gemischt sind, fügen Sie das **400 g Topfen Brösellig** hinzu
In der Zwischenzeit alle trockenen Zutaten mischen und in die Schüssel geben
Sobald alles richtig gemischt ist, fügen Sie **100 ml kochendes Wasser** Wasser und **2  EL Essig** hinzu
Mischen Sie noch einmal und lassen Sie es für 15-20 Minuten sitzen
Den Ofen auf 150 C vorheizen
Den Teig aus der Schüssel nehmen und mit der Hand in den Brotlaib formen.
Nehmen Sie ein wenig von den **100 g Kartoffelfasern** und decken Sie die Oberseite des Brotes damit ab. Dies gibt dem Brot das natürliche Aussehen nach dem Backen
Wenn Sie möchten, machen Sie mit einem Messer ein paar Linien im ganzen Brot, um es wieder natürlicher erscheinen zu lassen
Stellen Sie es in den Ofen und backen Sie für 90 Minuten
Guten Appetit

title: Dehydrated Food Recipes
instructions: Prepare your **2 Cups Fruits** or **2 Cups Vegetables**. Wash and clean them entirely making sure all of the bad pieces are cut out.
Depending on what exactly are you planing to make, cut your veggies and **2 Cups Fruits** into smaller pieces or slice into about quarter of an inch thick slices.
If you are planing to season them, add into a mixing bowl and sprinkle with your favorite seasonings or seeds. Gently mix all making sure every piece is covered with your flavors.

Layer one by one on a sigle sheets of dehydrator trays, making sure there is a space in between for the air to circulate. Close the lid and dehydrate for few hours depending on the type and size of your **2 Cups Fruits** and **2 Cups Vegetables**.

title: Can You Freeze Avocados?
instructions: Begin by selecting perfectly ripe avocados. Fresh avocados are ripe when they yield slightly by gently squeezing them. Peel the avocados and cut them in half, remove the pit, and scoop out the creamy flesh.
Start by removing the pit and scooping out the **1  Avocado** flesh. Dice it into chunks or mash it if you prefer.
Sprinkle the **1  Avocado** with **2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice** juice or any citrus juice before freezing to prevent it from turning brown.

Place the prepared **1  Avocado** in an airtight container or a plastic bag, squeezing out as much air as possible to prevent freezer burn. You can also wrap them tightly with plastic wrap to prevent ice crystals to form.

title: How to Soften Cream Cheese Quickly
instructions: Choose your preferred method. You can use the room temperature method, microwave method, double boiler method, or warm water bath method, depending on your time and equipment availability.

Take the cream **1 Package Cream Cheese** out of the refrigerator and remove it from its packaging. Place it on the countertop and let it sit at room temperature for about 30 minutes. Ensure it doesn’t stay out too long to avoid spoilage.

Place the unwrapped cream **1 Package Cream Cheese** in a microwave-safe bowl if you're using the microwave. Microwave it on high for 15 seconds, then check and stir it. Repeat in 10-second intervals until it reaches your desired softness, being cautious not to overheat.

Bring a pan of water to a simmer for the double boiler method. Put the cream **1 Package Cream Cheese** in a heatproof bowl and set it on the simmering pot. Stir occasionally until it reaches the desired consistency.

Place the whole block of wrapped cream **1 Package Cream Cheese** in a bowl of warm water in this method. Let it sit for about 15 minutes, flipping the block in the water every few minutes to ensure even softening.

title: Dehydrated Broccoli Chips
instructions: First, thoroughly wash and dry your **1  Broccoli Head** and discharge broccoli leaves. The smaller your broccoli florets are cut, the less drying time it will take for you to dehydrate fully. Segment your broccoli into small green florets leaving the stems as well. The stems are extra delicious once dried.
Arrange the **1  Broccoli Head** pieces onto the drying trays. Make sure they do not overlap.

Close the lid of the food dehydrator, set the temperature to 70 Celsius or 150 Fahrenheit for approximately 6 to 8 hours, depending on the size and let the **1  Broccoli Head** dehydrate. Make sure you swap your trays every 2 hours to get all broccoli pieces to dry faster and evenly. You can even turn the florets toward the end of drying.

title: Low Carb Breaded Cauliflower Bites
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients for your low-carb bites, including fresh **1/2  Cauliflower**, keto **1/2 Cup Keto Breadcrumbs**, **2  Eggs**, **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1 teaspoon Turmeric**, and **1 teaspoon Garlic** powder. Ensure you have everything ready before starting the recipe. Wash and cut the cauliflower into your preferred sizes. If you use a whole head of cauliflower, double the ingredients. At the same time, preheat your oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit.

Whisk the **2  Eggs** with **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1 teaspoon Garlic** powder, and **1 teaspoon Turmeric** in a mixing bowl to create an egg wash. In a separate bowl, place your keto **1/2 Cup Keto Breadcrumbs**. This mixture will be used as the coating for the **1/2  Cauliflower**. You can also thin out the batter using a few drops of milk.

Take a floret and dip the **1/2  Cauliflower** into the egg wash, ensuring it is fully coated. Coat the cauliflower with the **1/2 Cup Keto Breadcrumbs**, pressing gently to ensure they stick well. Place the battered cauliflower florets on the prepared baking sheet in a single layer, leaving space between each. Depending on the size, bake the cauliflower for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

title: Sheet Pan Easy Berry Cake
ingredients: 1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. At the same time, heat the oven to 170 Celsius or 350°f.
First, whip up **1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice** egg whites using a hand mixer or machine with a whisk attachment and beat on high speed until soft peaks form. Set aside.
Next, whisk egg yolks with a **10 Tablespoons Sweetener** of your **1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice** in a separate bowl until the mixture thickens and changes to light yellow.

Once **1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice** egg yolks are thoroughly whisked with **10 Tablespoons Sweetener**, add whipped egg whites and gently fold them all. Switch your kitchen machine on medium and slowly add all other ingredients while whisking simultaneously.
Cover **1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice** preferred sheet pan with parchment paper and pour the batter in.
Add fresh **1.5 Cups of Berries of your choice** to the batter and bake the cake for 30 minutes or until the toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean.

title: Sugar Free Meringue Lemon Curd Cupcakes
instructions: Heat your oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. Prepare all of the ingredients for making the cupcakes. **1 Tablespoon Butter** and **3  Eggs** should be at room temperature.

Using a hand blender, whisk your **3  Eggs** thoroughly. Add sweetener and make sure everything is blended. Slowly one by one, add **3/4 Cup Almond flour** flour and baking powder. Whisk once again for all to combine.
Following comes to add the **1/2 Cup Lemon curd** **1 teaspoon Fresh lemon juice** and **1 teaspoon Lemon zest**, plus melted **1 Tablespoon Butter**.

When your batter is thoroughly combined, scrape down the sides and pour it onto the muffin baking tray covered with cupcake liners. The batter is perfect for eight standard-size cupcakes or 12 cupcakes with medium liners. Place into the oven and bake for 10 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Once your cupcakes are baked, take them out of the oven and let them cool fully. This time will be great for preparing the **Meringue frosting** icing, as your **1/2 Cup Lemon curd** curd keeps chilling in the fridge. Once your cupcakes are cooled, use a spoon, knife, or cupcake plunger to make a hole in the center of each cupcake. Cupcakes need to be cool completely before frosting as well as filling.  Take your creamy lemon curd from the fridge and mix in the lemon **1 teaspoon Fresh lemon juice** if too thick. Fill the cupcakes with your silky lemon curd in the center. It comes to about 1 **1 Tablespoon Butter** of lemon curd for each cupcake.

Once the cupcakes are filled with **1/2 Cup Lemon curd** curd, place the frosting in a pastry bag and frost the cupcakes with **Meringue frosting**. Lastly, you can decorate the top of the meringue icing with lemon **1 teaspoon Lemon zest** for that perfect lemony look.

title: How To Make Dehydrated Blueberries
instructions: Prepare your **1 cup Fresh Blueberries** for dehydration. Use fresh blueberries. Wash thoroughly with water and discharge any that are overripe or damaged. Once you have checked blueberries, dry them with a paper towel. Cut each of the blueberries in half to cut the time of the drying process.
Place all **1 cup Fresh Blueberries** on the dehydrator tray in a single layer, ensuring they do not overlap.

Place all the dehydrator trays filled with **1 cup Fresh Blueberries** on each other, close the lid, and set the temperature to 70 Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit. Dehydrate for 7 to 12 hours, depending on the number of trays and the size of the blueberries. Please remember that whole blueberries can take up to 18 hours to dehydrate. Swap the trays every two hours, ensuring all blueberries are dehydrated equally.

title: Basic Fathead Dough Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients for making the perfect fathead dough. **1 Cup Almond meal** flour is best blanched as it will resemble most of the color of a standard dough. **2 Cups Shredded mozzarella**, please shred it at home as pre-shredded from the shop contain most of the time starches. An egg is best if room temperature.
Start with heating your non-stick pot on a medium-high. Place your shredded **2 Cups Shredded mozzarella** and start melting it until you get the consistency on the image.

Once the cheese melts, turn the heat off and add the **1 Cup Almond meal** flour. Using a wooden spoon bled it all together halfway.  Add one egg and work the dough. Using a spatula, start mixing dough together thoroughly until all blended.

Place the dough on a parchment paper or silicone sheet, and using your hands as you see in the video, start working your dough. This process might take 5 to 10 minutes until all is combined into one smooth consistency dough.

title: How To Dehydrate Mushrooms
instructions: Using a damp kitchen towel, gently clean all of the mushrooms. Tap dry mushrooms with a paper towel.
Using a sharp knife, slice all of the mushrooms vertically. The thickness should be half a millimeter or a quarter of an inch.
Arrange sliced mushrooms in a single layer onto your dehydrator trays. Make sure they do not overlap each other.
Place all of the trays onto a dehydrator machine and close the lid. Switch on 70 degrees Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit. Dehydrate for 6 to 8 hours.

title: Pine Cone Cheese Ball Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Regarding **2.5 Cups Hard Cheese** spread, I have picked my favorite mixture. Cheese depends on your taste. Any hard cheese you shred at home will work.

Into a big bowl, add all of the grated **2.5 Cups Hard Cheese**. Into it, press your garlic **5 Cloves Garlic** and sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream**. You can add a pinch of salt and pepper for extra taste. Gently mix well all of the ingredients together until you get a perfect cheese mixture. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill in the fridge for a few hours.

Pick a big serving plate. Into the middle place rosemary sprigs, fresh dill weed, or the branches of Christmas pine trees. Take out your **2.5 Cups Hard Cheese** mixture and start piping the whole mixture on a plate forming two egg shape looking half balls.

Starting at the narrow end, spread **1 Cup Almonds** into the **2.5 Cups Hard Cheese**. Gently push the thicker edge into the cheese spread with a slight angle. Keep placing all of your almonds until both of the balls are covered. Once you are done, with the palm of your hands, press on all the almonds to hold them together and make a unified layer.

title: Easy Keto Breakfast Sandwich Recipe
instructions: First, prepare all of your ingredients. Regarding the bread, you can use any of the low carb keto rolls I have mentioned above.
Cut your bread on a plate into half and place the base of the bun into your casserole.

Start layering the casserole first with a little bit of **1/4 Cup Grated Cheese** cheese. One slice of ham or prosciutto on top of it and then one raw egg. Do not swap the steps as the meat holds the one egg inside the casserole. Top it up with additional grated cheese and either fresh herbs or spices.

Once you’re done with layering, add the top layer of the bun and cover it with the casserole top. This will prevent the bun in the oven from burning. The whole keto breakfast sandwich will also be nice and soft.
Bake in the oven at 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit for approximately 15 minutes. Serve with sliced avocado for additional healthy fat.

title: Cheesy Keto Bread Bites
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making your cheesy keto bread bites. **1/4 Cup Pork Cracklings Grind** scratchings could be mixed into a paste using a magic bullet or a coffee grinder.

In a big mixing bowl, start adding all of the dry ingredients, which are, in our case, baking powder, **2 Cups Almond Flour** flour as well as **2 Tablespoons Coconut Flour** flour.  Mix them all together using a whisk.
Into the mixture, start adding all of the wet ingredients which are sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream**, egg, and melted **1/4 Cup Lard**. Mix it all until you get a dough consistency.

It is best to refrigerate the dough before making the low-carb bread bites. Shape the dough into a loaf and cover with a cling film which is in my opinion the best way to store it in your fridge. Store it for at least 2 to 3 hours, if not overnight.

Heat the oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. Take out the dough from the fridge and roll it onto parchment paper or a silicone sheet. As you can see in the video, you can use parchment paper to properly roll the dough into a nice longer sheet. Spread your scratching paste onto the dough and fold it in half.
Keep folding and rolling the dough until all of the paste has been incorporated into the mixture. Shape into a rectangular shape approximately half an inch or 1 1/2 cm thick.
Using a small round-shaped cookie cutter, start cutting the small bread bites and placing them on the baking sheet covered with parchment paper.

Once all of the bites are on the parchment paper, mix your egg yolk, and using a brush, spread the egg yolk on each of the bread bites. This will help your **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheese** cheese to hold as well.
On each low-carb bread, bite, and add a little bit of **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheese** cheese. Place into your oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown.

title: Keto Biscuits and Gravy
ingredients: 1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream
instructions: The first step is to prepare all of the ingredients for keto biscuits.

In a big bowl, mix all of the dry ingredients first, into which you then add all of the wet ingredients except the homemade pork **2 Tablespoons Pork Scratchings grind**. Thoroughly mix everything until you get a perfect dough for making the biscuits.
Chill in the fridge for two to three hours if time allows.

Heat your oven to 180 Celsius and 350 Fahrenheit. Take the dough out of the refrigerator and start rolling it into a rectangular shape. Spread all of the scratching paste onto the dough and fold it in half.
Using a round cookie cutter, cut your biscuits and place them onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Design and brush the top of each biscuit with mixed egg yolk and place into the oven for 15 minutes.
Prepare all of the ingredients needed for **1 lb Sausage** gravy.

Heat your saucepan and add **2 Tablespoons Butter**. Once the butter melts, add your chopped onions and caramelize them until brown. Add all of the meat from your **1 lb Sausage** in our case already with sausage seasoning. Start cooking your sausage for approximately 10 to 15 minutes. Once you see that your sausage is fully cooked, you can sprinkle it with **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum.
Pour over sour **1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream** and mix the whole dish. Serve together with the biscuits and enjoy.

title: Chocolate Keto Mug Cake Moist and Delicious
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients for making the best Keto Chocolate Cake in a Mug.
Let us start first by mixing better together with a **2 Tablespoons Sweetener**.

Once **2 Tablespoons Sweetener** and **2 Tablespoons Butter** are mixed, you can slowly add other ingredients. Add one egg and whisk together. Add a few drops of **2 Drops Vanilla Extract** extract and whisk together. The same goes for blanched **1/4 Cup Almond Flour** flour and **1 teaspoon Cinnamon**.
Once all the above is mixed, you can add cocoa **2 Tablespoons Cocoa Powder** and baking powder as the last ingredients. Mix everything until thoroughly combined.
Split it into 2 cups or use just one single mug if you would like to. Fill your Mug and Microwave for 45 seconds on high

title: Keto Bread Pudding
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. Prepare all of the ingredients for making the best keto **4 Slices Brioche Bread Toast** pudding.
Add your **3  Eggs**, **1 Cup Heavy Cream** cream, **1 Tablespoon Cinnamon**, brown sugar **2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar Substitute**, and **2 Drops Vanilla Extract** extract in a bowl.
Using a whisk, mix all of the ingredients until you get a perfect egg mixture to use later on.

Once you have your **4 Slices Brioche Bread Toast** toast ready, slice it into thicker pieces and cut into small cubes. Depending on what casserole size you’re using, fill up the casserole and make sure there are enough bread pieces covering the casserole up to the top.
Once all of your **4 Slices Brioche Bread Toast** pieces are spread inside the casserole. Take the egg mixture and pour it all over the bread.
Once everything is mixed together, top up your casserole with pieces of butter.
You can also sprinkle some extra **2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar Substitute** sugar and **1 Tablespoon Cinnamon** on top of your casserole. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes until golden brown.

title: Cucumber Chips Recipe
instructions: Prepare your cucumbers and **2 teaspoons Salt**. It is best to pick cucumbers of the same size for the dehydration to be equal.
Using a meat slicer, mandolin, knife, or vegetable peeler, slice your cucumbers into approximately half a centimeter or quarter of an inch thickness.
Layer all of the slices one by one on dehydrator racks, ensuring the slices are not overlapping.
Slightly **2 teaspoons Salt** the layered slices and let them rest for 10 to 15 minutes. This will help your cucumbers get additional moisture out as well.
Using a kitchen towel, lightly tapping your slices, soaks up all of the moisture your cucumber slices have produced. Keep drying them until your towels do not soak up the moisture anymore.

Place your dehydrator trays onto the dehydrator machine, cover with the lid, and set on the lowest temperature, in my case 70 celsius or 160 Fahrenheit, for approximately 5 to 7 hours, depending on the thickness of your slices.

title: Keto French Toast Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all of the ingredients. You can make our **5  Brioche Bread Loaf Slices** toast bread a few days in advance as a bit older bread soaks much better. Regarding the brown sugar **1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar substitute**, you can either use any of the store-bought or make your own with our recipe.

Whisk your **3  Eggs** in a mixing bowl or a soup plate as I have used. Add **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream **1 Teaspoon Cinnamon** as well as a brown sugar **1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar substitute**. Whisk all together and start preparing for soaking.
Place one toast inside the mixture and let it soak for half a second. I usually turn the toast a few times inside the mixture to ensure the **5  Brioche Bread Loaf Slices** is thoroughly soaked in.
Heat your pan and put butter or olive oil of your choice for frying. Make sure it is fully heated for the french toast to start frying immediately.

Place your toast onto the frying pan and start frying it on a medium heat using a fork. At the same time, place the second toast into the mixture and let it soak. Turn it a few times and put it on the frying pan.

Let your toast fry on a pan for about a minute or two, then turn onto the other side. Some people like to have lightly fried French toast, and some want to keep it longer. It all depends on your preference. Place onto your breakfast plate and serve immediately.

title: How To Make Strawberry Powder
instructions: If you have fresh **1 Cup Dehydrated Strawberries**, slice them thinly and place them on the dehydrator racks. Dehydrate for 7-8 hours or until they are fully dehydrated. Prepare your strawberries, whether you dehydrate strawberries yourself as per our recipe, buy already dried strawberries, dehydrated Strawberries, or Freeze Dried Strawberries.

Place your strawberry into the Magic Bullet, Coffee Grinder, or any blender machines you have in your kitchen. Blend fully until you get dusty fruit powder from your **1 Cup Dehydrated Strawberries**.
Open the lid gently as the dust might come out. Place your fruit powder immediately into the air-tight container.

title: How To Dehydrate Raspberries
instructions: Pick the best **2 cups Fresh Raspberries** you can, without any bad spots. Wash them and let them dry thoroughly on a kitchen towel. You can additionally soak them in a mixture of water and vinegar to kill all of the germs and beginners' mold.

Once you have picked your **2 cups Fresh Raspberries** and dried them fully, place them onto dehydrating trays, leaving the spaces in between for the air to circulate freely. If you have very soft raspberries, you can use liners for the dehydrator trays, so they do not fall onto the bottom of the dehydrator.
Dehydrate for 10 to 12 hours, making sure you swap the trays every two to three hours. To shorten the drying time, you can cut your **2 cups Fresh Raspberries** in half.

title: Keto Cheese Puffs Air Fryer
instructions: Prepare both **50 grams Hard Cheese** and egg whites. It is best if you buy a hard cheese and shred the cheese yourself as a store-bought shredded cheese contains starches that are not suitable for our Keto lifestyle and the structure of the cheese puffs.

Whisk your egg whites into a stiff peak. You can skip this step and just add liquid egg whites into the shredded **50 grams Hard Cheese**, giving you more of the liquid texture inside the low-carb cheese puffs.

Add your whisk egg whites into the shredded **50 grams Hard Cheese**, and using a fork, start gently folding them into the cheese. Make sure all of the egg whites are thoroughly combined with shredded cheese.

Start shaping your **50 grams Hard Cheese** puffs. As you see, I have made more of a longer shape, but you can also shape them into balls in various sizes. Keep in mind that the size will double while air frying. The length of the frying also depends on the size of your cheese puffs.

Gently place each one of the **50 grams Hard Cheese** puffs into your air fryer. Make sure you leave the space in between as they increase in size. You can also gently spray them with an oil of your choice.

Air fry your **50 grams Hard Cheese** puffs following up the instructions of your particular air fryer. I have used our Tefal Actifry, where the best cheese puffs I got were on number two for 15 minutes.
Once your puffed **50 grams Hard Cheese** is ready, gently remove them from your air fryer and place it on a plate for serving.

title: Homemade Keto Bread Crumbs
instructions: Prepare **1  Keto Bun** **10  thin slices of Farmers Bread** of your choice and heat the oven to 120 Celsius or 250 Fahrenheits.
Slice your **1  Keto Bun** **10  thin slices of Farmers Bread** into as thin as you can manage.
Cut your slices into small squares.

Once all the slices are cut, place them on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Make sure you layer all of the **10  thin slices of Farmers Bread** pieces into one layer, so they do not overlap. Place into the oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Depending on if you are using a magic bullet, blender, or a food processor, fill up the container and close the lid.
Blend fully until you get the best homemade breadcrumbs.

title: Everything Bagel Keto Crackers
instructions: As a first step, prepare all of the ingredients. Everything bagel seasoning can be made in your house in less than three minutes following our recipe.

We start with preparing our fathead dough. Place shredded **2 Cups Shredded Mozzarella** into the pot and start melting on medium heat until all cheese has been melted. Once you see the cheese entirely melted, switch off the stove and add **1 Cup Almond Meal** meal as well as one egg. Using a wooden spatula, incorporate the egg and almond flour into the mozzarella cheese. Keep mixing until you get everything combined and a fathead dough starts forming.
You can preheat the oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit at this step. Place the dough onto parchment paper and start rolling into a really thin sheet.
Once your fathead dough is rolled out, you can start with the egg wash. Ensure all egg wash is spread on the whole sheet of rolled-out fathead dough.
Using a pizza cutter, cut the whole sheet into your preferred shapes: squares, triangles, circles, or rectangles.
The last step is sprinkling the whole sheet with everything bagel topping. Place into the oven and bake at 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit for 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Green Goddess Vegan Dressing
instructions: First, gather all of the ingredients together.

Using your blender, place all of the liquids first onto the base of the container. It is extra **1/4 Cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil** olive oil, **Fresh Lemon Juice from 2 Lemons** juice, and apple cider **2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar** in our case.
Next comes all the greens, which in our case are **1 Cup Fresh Spinach**, **1/2 Cup Fresh Parsley**, basil **1/2 Cup Fresh Basil Leaves**, and **1/3 Cup Chives**.
The following comes **1/2  White Onion** and **2 Cloves Garlic**.
Dry ingredients such as **1/3 Cup Nutritional Yeast** yeast, **1 teaspoon Salt**, and **1/4 Cup Almond Nuts** follow last.
Follow your blender instructions and switch the blender on puree. Let it blend thoroughly and check for consistency. If you need, repeat the blending once again.

title: Keto Fried Cheese Balls
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Egg whites should be at room temperature to get the best-whipped texture you can.
Start with whisking your egg whites. Make sure your egg white is whisked fully until you get a stiff peak.
Add your whisk egg whites into the **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** cheese.
Gently start folding your egg whites into the **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** cheese using a fork or a spoon.
In this step, we start shaping the **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** balls. Make sure you shape your fried cheese balls small as they double in size while frying.
Heat your vegetable oil, and once hot, gently place **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** balls one by one into the frying pot.

Once you see your fried cheeseballs have got a beautiful shape and a golden brown color, using your fork, gently remove them from oil and place them on the kitchen paper towel to get rid of that extra oil.

title: Easy Sugar-Free Popsicles Homemade Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for making the best **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** popsicles. You can prepare Whipped **1 Cup Heavy Cream** and Greek **1 Cup Greek Yogurt** in advance following our recipes. You can also make our Sugar-Free Chocolate and Chocolate Magic Shell following our recipe if you need more tips and tricks.
Using a hand blender container, simply pour your **1 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and **3 Tablespoons Sweetener** and whip until stiff peaks.
Once your whipped **1 Cup Heavy Cream** is ready, place it into the Mixing bowl with **1 Cup Greek Yogurt** and whisk until all combined.
Once all whipped, fill up our silicone molds using a small spoon.
Add a popsicle stick and add one more spoon to cover it.
Place in the freezer and freeze for 3-4 hours, best overnight.
Prepare your ingredients for making a **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** Magic Shell sauce.
Using a double boiler, place **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** chocolate and **3 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** butter in and let it all melt together.
When your popsicles are fully frozen, and you are ready to dip, place the **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** sauce into a tall container so you can dip the popsicles in.
Enjoy either immediately or store in the freezer for later.

title: Easy Crunchy Keto Taco Cups Recipe
instructions: First of all, heat your oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. Prepare your **1/2 Cup Mozzarella Cheese** and **1/4 Cup Cheddar Cheese** cheese.
Using a big glass bowl, add all the ingredients in, and mix them.

Using either your kid's compass or a bowl, make lovely round shapes on parchment paper to have your cups identical in size. Fill each circle with the mixture, and using your hands, make sure the circles are almost identical. Place into the oven and bake for approximately eight minutes until the corners brown.
Oil the tops of the muffin pan, take cups out of the oven and immediately place each circle onto the muffin tin, shaping them into the cups.
Prepare all the ingredients together for an easy assembly.

Heat your skillet over medium-high, add a bit of oil and cook the **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** beef for approximately 10-15 minutes. Add taco **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning**, mix it thoroughly and let it cook for additional 10 minutes.

Place your **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning** cups on a tray and start filling with **1 Cup Lettuce** cut into small pieces. Continue adding Taco **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** Beef, **1/4 Cup Onion**, and black **1/4 Cup Black Olives** you have cut into small pieces.
Keep filling up with cut **1/2 Cup Tomatoes**, **1/2 Cup Avocado**, and grated **1/4 Cup Cheddar Cheese** of your choice. You can also sprinkle salsa dressing or any other garnishes mentioned above.

title: How To Make Homemade Keto Soup Noodles
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for making Homemade Soup Noodles
Preheat your oven to 160 Celsius or 320 Fahrenheit
Place all the ingredients into the jar you have for your magic bullet or a blender.
Thoroughly mix all the ingredients in a blender.
Pour the whole mixture onto your baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Place the baking sheet into the oven and bake for approximately eight minutes.
Once your keto soup noodles sheet is baked, take it out of the oven and let it cool.
Peel the sheet off the noodles and cut it into sizes to fit your kitchen pasta machine.
Using your pasta machine, let the sheets go once again through the part, which thins the sheet even more. This is optional
Let it run through the cutting part of the pasta machine.
Add them directly into your hot soup just before serving.

title: Easy Homemade Ground Beef Keto Tacos
instructions: If you do not have **6 Tablespoons Keto Salsa** **2 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** **6  Keto Taco Shells** prepared, please follow our recipe with step-by-step recipe together with video instructions.
For the rest, it is the best to prepare all the other ingredients into a separate bowls for an easy assembling of the Whole **2 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** meal.
Heat up your skillet over medium high, add a bit of oil and cook the **2 Cups Ground Beef** beef for approximately 10-15 minutes.
Once you see the color changed, add taco **2 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning**, mix it fully and let it cook for additional 10 minutes.
Having all of your ingredients prepared in advance, you can start assembling those Gorgeous Gluten-Free Tacos.
Start by taking one of the **2 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** **6  Keto Taco Shells**.

As a base, take one of the salad **6  Lettuce Leaves** and place it in. This will not only give you that perfect green color, but will hold all the sauce, from food, which might soften your **6  Keto Taco Shells**.
Fill up with one tablespoon of **2 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** **2 Cups Ground Beef** and press a bit onto inside the shell, so all other ingredients can fit.
Start layering **6 Tablespoons Keto Salsa**, which will further flavor our keto **2 Cups Ground Beef** tacos.
Next goes **1/2 Cup Onions**, **1/4 Cup Black Olives** and **1/2 Cup Tomatoes**.
To give our tacos perfect color and extra flavors, add small cubes of **1/2 Cup Avocado** and sprinkle a bit of **1/4 Cup Cheddar Cheese** cheese.
As **1/4 Cup Fresh Cilantro** is a must in any tacos, freshly chopped adds one more flavor to already awesome Tacos.

title: Best Keto Salsa Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the Ingredients needed.
Chop **1/2 Cup  Cilantro** fully and cut all other ingredients into small pieces.
Using a bigger bowl, start adding all of the needed ingredients.
Start with canned or fresh **1 Cup Canned Tomatoes**, followed by chopped onions, **1/2 Cup  Cilantro**, **2 Cloves Garlic**, and jalapenos.
Continue by adding Taco **1 Tablespoon Taco Seasoning**, half a **1/2 Teaspoon Salt** of salt, and freshly squeezed **1  Lime Juice** from a lime.
Using your spatula, combine all of the ingredients for Salsa by mixing them fully.

The last step is optional, depending on how you like your salsa texture to be. You can stop at the fourth step and leave everything chunky, or you can place all of the Salsa into the Magic Bullet or a Food Processor and mix it fully into a smooth consistency.

title: Low Carb Lasagna with Ground Beef
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**.
Place **1  Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves** into a cooking pot sprinkled with olive oil and caramelize for a few minutes.
Once caramelized, add **1/2 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook for 15 minutes.
Add diced **1 Tablespoon Fresh Marjoram** **2 Stems Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and heavy **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
Prepare all of the Ingredients for Lasagna Sheets making
Place all of the ingredients into the Magic Bullet and fully blend.
Pour the mixture onto the sheet, and using a spatula, spread the mixture evenly throughout the whole sheet.
Bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes total time at 150C or 300F.
Once baked, gently turn it upside down and peel the Parchment Paper from it.
Cut into the size to fit your casserole or a Baking Dish using either a sharp knife or a pizza roller.
To layer the whole dish, start with Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** on the bottom of the casserole.
Add a bit of grated **1/2 Cup Grated Cheese for layering** and a layer of Lasagna Sheet.
Continue **1/2 Cup Grated Cheese for layering** until you use all of the Lasagna Sheets or your Casserole is full. Lastly, top it up with the remaining Meat **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**.
Top up your whole Low Carb Lasagna Casserole with Grated **1/2 Cup Grated Cheese for layering** fully.
Bake at 200C or 400F for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Easy Keto Fettuccine Alfredo with Homemade Noodles
instructions: Preheat oven to 150 C or 300F
Prepare all of the ingredients for Keto Noodles.
Place all of the Ingredients for Low Carb Noodles into the Magic Bullet or a blender you have at home. Blend until smooth consistency.
Pour onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper or a silicone sheet with edges. Using your spatula, make sure all of the mixtures are spread evenly onto the sheet.
Bake for approximately 8 minutes.
Once the sheet is baked, gently peel the silicone or parchment paper and cut using various methods.
Once your homemade noodles are ready, you can prepare all of the ingredients for Making Alfredo Sauce.
Smash **3  Garlic Cloves** and chop **1/2 Cup Chopped Parsley** into small bits.
Heat up the pot and place all of the **1/4 Cup Butter** to melt.At the same time add **3  Garlic Cloves** and mix together. Let garlic brown gently and get the roasting aroma.
Once the **1/4 Cup Butter** is melted, but not boiling, add heavy **1 Cup Heavy Cream** and start mixing. Let cook for approximately 2-3 minutes in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add **1 Cup Finely Grated Parmesan Cheese** cheese and stir constantly until the parmesan melts fully.
Flavoring Alfredo sauce with a teaspoon of salt and **Salt & Pepper** will just enhance all of the taste.
As of last, add **1/2 Cup Chopped Parsley** parsley and switch off the heat. Stir together.
Add Keto Noodles and gently mix together.

title: Low Carb Fettuccine Noodles
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients and preheat the oven to 150 C or 300F
Add all of the ingredients into your Blender Jar, be it Magic Bullet or any blender you have at home.
Blend all of the ingredients together until all are fully combined.
Pour onto the Silicone Sheet with edges or a baking sheet covered with Parchment Paper.
Using a silicone spatula or any spatula, gently spread all of the mixtures to cover all of the gaps.
Place into the oven and bake on150 C or 300F for approximately 8 minutes
Once the sheet is baked, place it onto the fresh parchment paper facing the Silicone sheet down.
Gently peel the silicone sheet or parchment paper from the baked Noodles sheet.
You can either use Hand Pasta Roller. You can also cut the sheet with Pizza Roller or roll the whole sheet and cut with a knife.
If you do have a pasta machine, cut the sheet into the size, that fits and prepare the best ever Low Carb Fettuccine Noodles.

title: Keto Pasta Carbonara Recipe
instructions: If you do not have one of the Keto Pasta ready and you have decided to go with our recipe, prepare all of the ingredients. At the same time heat up the oven to 300 Fahrenheit or 150 Celsius.
All you have to do is put all of the ingredients is into the magic bullet or any of the blenders you have.
Blend it all together until a smooth consistency and pour onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes, let it cool and roll into a loaf.
Cut into preferred slices.
For our pasta carbonara sauce, you would need egg yolks.
For the **1 Cup Pork Bacon (Pancetta)**, cut it into small square pieces.
In a small bowl whisk both of the egg yolks.
Into it add your **1 Cup Parmesan Cheese** cheese and mix it all together.
Prepare your cooking pot and start cooking your **1 Cup Pork Bacon (Pancetta)** bites over medium heat until fully cooked and crunchy.
Once your **1 Cup Pork Bacon (Pancetta)** is fully cooked, add your pasta and mix together. Switch off the heat as raw egg yolks might scramble.
Into it, add the **1 Cup Parmesan Cheese** **4  Eggs** mixture you have prepared beforehand and add 1 teaspoon of black pepper.
Mix it all together.
Top it up with extra grated **1 Cup Parmesan Cheese** and serve immediately.

title: Low Carb Spaghetti Bolognese
ingredients: 4 Tbsp Bamboo Fiber (alternative Oat Fiber 2 Tbsp)
instructions: Start with preparing Spaghetti. Prepare all of your ingredients.
Place all of the ingredients for Pasta making into the blender or a Magic Bullet.
Mix fully until all combined.
Pour either on a silicone baking sheet with edges or an ordinary baking sheet covered with Parchment paper.
Bake for 8 minutes on 160C or 320F
Once it is baked, peel the parchment paper or a silicone sheet from the pasta sheet.
If you are going to use a Pasta Machine, cut the sheet into the sizes, that fits in. If you do not have a pasta machine, roll the whole pasta sheet and using a sharp knife, cut it into thin slices.
Ingredients for Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**
Cut your **1,5 Cup Diced Bacon**, **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, Onion as well as **2  Garlic Cloves** into **1  Small Onion** squares.
Start with cooking **1  Small Onion** together with **2  Garlic Cloves**.
Once browned, add **1,5 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat of your choice and cook for about 10-15 minutes.
Add **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery** as well as spices, a bit of salt, and pepper. Stir all together and cook for another 10 minutes.
As last, add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and heavy **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream**, mix gently all together and cover with a lid.
Cook for additional 40 minutes.
Once your bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** is ready, you can place spaghetti onto the bowl and top it up with Bolognese sauce.

title: Homemade Low Carb Pasta Recipe
instructions: First off, prepare all of your ingredients.
At the same time heat up the oven to 160C or 320F.
Place all of the ingredients into the container for the magic bullet.
Blend it fully until all of the ingredients are combined together.
Gently spray your baking pan with oil and place parchment paper on top of it.
Pour all the mixture onto the parchment paper and using your spatula spread it all to cover the whole baking sheet.
Place into the preheated oven at 160 Celsius or 320F for 8 minutes.
Once your **2 Tbsp Ground Psyllium** Husk Low Carb Pasta sheet is baked, take it out of the oven gently peel parchment paper.
Roll the whole sheet into one Roulade-like loaf.
Using a sharp knife cut into slices as thin as you would like your pasta to look.
Unroll and serve immediately with your favorite Keto Sauce.

title: Keto Gnocchi Tomato Basil
instructions: If you already have your Keto Gnocchi prepared, skip to step 8.

Mixing all of the ingredients for Keto Gnocchi, start preparing the dough. If you have not made them before, it is better to have a look at the Homemade Keto Gnocchi post I have written, where the whole video and steps are attached for easier understanding.
Once your dough is fully combined, separate it into four pieces and roll each into a thin log.
With your cake scraper or a knife, cut small identical pieces out of the log until you’re finished with all of the dough.
Using the wooden gnocchi board, start shaping your fusilli. For a better understanding look at the video with step-by-step instructions.
Once you have your gnocchi prepared in the shape of a fusilli, take them out of the fridge and place them into the salty boiling water where you have added 1 tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil.
Cook for approximately five minutes and using your sieve, take them out of the boiling water as you normally would with any pasta.
Prepare all of your ingredients together.
For the sauce, heat up your pan and add extra virgin olive oil together with crushed **5 Cloves Fresh Garlic**. Cook it until golden brown.
Add your cherry **10  Mini Cherry Tomatoes** cut into smaller pieces together with half a tablespoon of **10  Fresh Leaves Basil** **1/2 Tbsp Basil Pesto**. Mix and cook for a few minutes.
Once you see that your **10  Mini Cherry Tomatoes** are getting softer, add **10  Fresh Leaves Basil** basil and pre-cooked gnocchi into the pan.
Mix, cook for a few minutes and serve immediately.

title: Sugar-Free Chocolate Magic Shell Recipe
instructions: Prepare your **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** Bar or Chocolate Chips as well as **3 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** Oil
Using a Double Boiler (or an Instant Pot), melt both, the **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** and **3 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** oil stirring regularly.
Once melted, let the **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** sauce cool down, otherwise, your ice cream might melt while dipping it into the hot chocolate sauce.
Transfer it into a tall glass, wide enough to dip your particular Keto Dessert in.

title: Homemade Mini Sugar Free Popsicles Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
Pour **2 Cups Heavy Cream** cream with one tablespoon of powdered **3 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener** into the glass container. Using your Hand Blender, whisk until stiff peak and place aside.
In another glass container whisk egg whites until soft peak
And a third glass jar with egg yolks and the rest of the powdered **3 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener**. Whisk this super yummy combination until fluffy.
Using your spatula, gently combine all of the 3 deliciousness into one triple delicious mixture.
Fill whatever mold you have chosen for those lovely homemade **3 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener**-Free Mini Popsicles.
Gently bang your filled molds against the kitchen counter few times. This helps all extra bubbles inside to pop and you will get even out mini popsicles.
Add Ice Pop sticks and a bit of extra mixture on top to cover them. Bang once again and straight into the freezer.

title: How To Make Keto Peanut Butter Mousse without Cream Cheese
instructions: If you do not have **1 Cup Keto Whipped Cream** Cream already done, whisk together heavy cream together with your sugar sweetener.
Into a mixing bowl add **1/2 Cup Peanut Butter** Butter.
Using your handheld whisk, set it to medium and gently shart whisking **1/2 Cup Peanut Butter** butter together with **1 Cup Keto Whipped Cream** Cream until both are fully combined.
Using a tall glass, prepare your piping bag to easily fill your **1/2 Cup Peanut Butter** Butter Mousse. You can choose to scoop it as well.
Once your piping bag is filled, push it towards the end and cut the tip of the bag.
Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator.

title: Keto Gnocchi with Bacon and Cream Sauce
instructions: Mix all of the ingredients for Gnocchi into a dough. Cut into 4 pieces and roll into a log. Each log is cut into small pieces.
Take each piece into your hand and roll it into a tiny ball. Once done, press into the middle with your finger to shape into Orecchiette.
Place gnocchi into boiling water, where you have added a bit of oil and salt. This will help gnocchi not stick together. Cook for approximately 5 minutes.
Prepare all of the ingredients for Keto Alfredo Sauce with **1/2 Cup Bacon**.
Cook your **1/2 Cup Bacon** first until golden brown.
Once the **1/2 Cup Bacon** is golden brown, add Heavy **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** and grated **3/4 Cup Grated Hard Cheese**.
Cook the sauce for few minutes until all of the **3/4 Cup Grated Hard Cheese** is melted.
Place your Gnocchi into a bowl and add a scoop of the sauce.
To make it a bit more colorful and add a bit of freshness, you can cut fresh **Fresh Chives - Optional** on top.

title: Crispy Keto Chaffle Chips
instructions: Using either a manual shredder or your kitchen machine, shred your **1 Cup Hard Cheese**.
Heat your Mini Dash, Chaffle Maker.
Once hot, place scoop ¼ of a cup filled with shredded **1 Cup Hard Cheese** into the middle.
Wait for a minute for the base of the **1 Cup Hard Cheese** to start melting.
Gently close the lid and its pressure will spread the **1 Cup Hard Cheese** fully throughout the whole Chaffle maker.
Let it cook for about 5 minutes until it is easy to open and Chaffle is not sticking.
Gently lift the whole Chaffle and take it out of the Chaffle Maker.
Immediately, when the Chaffle is taken out of the Maker, using your scissors or knife, cut it into desired shapes.

title: Crispy Keto Tortilla Chips Gluten-Free
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients and make sure you have boiling water on as well.
In a cup, mix all of the dry ingredients and make sure no lumps or bigger pieces appear.
Once everything is fully mixed add hot water and make sure you start mixing immediately. Fully mix all of the dry ingredients with the hot water until fully combined and your dough is nice and silky.
On your table, prepare two parchment papers and spray both of them with oil before you place the dough.
Roll the dough into really thin and try to shape in square or rectangle size.
As you see in the video and images, cut the dough into squares and then triangles.Leave it set for approximately 10 to 15 minutes.
Slowly place each one of the Tortilla chips on a frying pan and fry it on medium heat making sure you turn it a few times.
Once your keto tortilla chips are ready, placed them on a plate covered with paper tissue which will take out most of the extra oil.

title: Birds Milk Jello Keto Recipe
instructions: Keto Chocolate LayerPrepare all of your ingredients. You can mix all dry ingredients **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** one small jar.
Warm up the **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** on the stove.
Once everything is mixed together and you get a smooth consistency pour all **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** your baking tray.
Place **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** the refrigerator for approximately 1-2 hours depending on the thickness of your chocolate pudding layer.
Birds **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** Base: On the kitchen stove, dissolve milk together with sugar **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)**, and while whisking add **1 Pkt Gelatine**.
When all is dissolved switch the heating off and place the **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** mixture on the site. Let it cool.
Using your hand mixer whisk whipping **1 Cup Sour Cream** together with sugar **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)**. Pour into the big glass jar and place it aside.
Pour sour **1 Cup Sour Cream** **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** the same jar together with sugar substitute and whisk fully.
Once whisked, slowly start pouring the cooled **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** milk mixture **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** the jar and keep mixing.
Pour all of it **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** the Whipping **1 Cup Sour Cream** Glass Jar mixture and gently whisk all together.
Take your Chocolate Pudding layer and make sure it is stiff on top.
Gently pour the whole white layer on top and place it **1/2 Cup Sweetener (split into 3 parts)** the refrigerator again for 4 - 6 hours, best overnight.

title: Extra Crispy Keto Tater Tots Croquettes Recipe
instructions: As a first step, prepare all of your ingredients for easy assembly.
After you weigh all the dry ingredients, prepare one big bowl where you can mix it all up.
Place all the dry ingredients into the mixing bowl.
Using your spatula, mix all the dry ingredients fully.
Once all the dry ingredients are mixed, slowly start adding hot or boiling **1 Cup Hot Water** into the bowl while mixing it all.
When all the hot **1 Cup Hot Water** is within the dry ingredients' mixture, using your spatula, make sure it is all fully incorporated together with Keto flours and **6 teaspoons Xanthan** gum.
Once your mixture is smooth, place it all onto the sheet and using your hands, work out the dough making sure it is smooth without any dry lumps from the nut flowers.
Take approximately ¼ of the dough and start rolling.
The easiest for me is to roll it into a log.  Using your spatula or cake scraper, separate the log into smaller pieces, all the same sizes.
One by one, take each of the pieces and roll with your hands into smaller log or cylinder shape tots.

Once all of your Keto Tater Tots are prepared, place them one by one into the preheated frying pan with oil. Have your settings on to six or medium heat. Slowly fry all the Keto Tots, turning them regularly.
When you see that your tots are turning into a beautiful golden color, one by one, place them into the plate covered with a paper towel.

title: Instant Pot Homemade Curd Cheese
instructions: Pour the **1/2 Gallon Organic Whole Milk** into the glass container.
Cover your glass container filled with **1/2 Gallon Organic Whole Milk** either with a glass top or a plate to make sure no dust or dirt gets in during the three days of the fermentation process.
Place the jar either on your kitchen counter or pantry.
On the second day, you will see a beautiful fresh cream being developed on top of the **1/2 Gallon Organic Whole Milk**.
On the third day, the fermentation process is supposed to be finished.
Pour all of the **1/2 Gallon Organic Whole Milk** into an instant pot and close the lid.
Switch an instant pot on the yogurt feature and add the timing for 30 minutes.
Switch the instant pot on and let it gently cook.
Once your 30 minutes are finished, open the lid and let the Curd Cheese sit in an instant pot until it cools down fully.

Once everything is cooled down gently check with the end of the spatula if the curds are properly formed.If you want to achieve even dryer curds, let the Whey drip through the Muslin cloth for a few hours or you can also hang the muslin cloth and squeeze it gently.

title: Keto Brussel Sprouts Cups Recipe with Bacon and Cheese
instructions: Heat Up The Oven to 200C or 400F
Fully clean all brussel sprouts and cut the ends and outer layer leaves.
Blanch Brussel sprouts in the boiling water for approximately 2 to 3 minutes. Once they’re blanched, run them through the cold water. Place cooked Brussel Sprouts aside and move onto the next step.
If your **1 Cup Bacon Bits** is raw, you can quickly fry it into bits in this step.
Prepare a bowl where you can mix all of the wet ingredients as well as half of the grated **1,5 Cup Hard Cheese**.
Break the **3  Eggs** and mix them a little bit into a soft fluffiness as you see on the video. Season it with salt and pepper, add sour **1 Cup Sour Cream**, and mix again.
Once all is fully mixed add grated **1,5 Cup Hard Cheese** and mix it once again.
Pick any of the cups you would like for baking either a single-serve baking dish, mini casseroles, mugs, or cups, which are heat resistant and will not crack in the oven.
Fill each of the cups with egg and **1,5 Cup Hard Cheese** mixture halfway. Add one spoon of **1 Cup Bacon Bits** bits into each cup.
Place into the oven and bake it for 20 minutes at 200C or 400F.

Once the Keto Brussel Sprouts Cups are baked, take all of the cups out of the oven and let them cool down a little bit. What you will see is the mixture has grown double in size. Do not worry as this will flatten after they cool a little bit.
Wait until they flatten and cool down and add **1/2 Cup Fresh Chives** and on top grated **1,5 Cup Hard Cheese**. Place Brussel Sprout in the middle, on top of each cup.
Place all of the mini casseroles once again into the oven and bake for another 10 minutes.

title: Keto Cloud Egg Crisps
instructions: Heat up the oven to 200C or 400 F
First of all, prepare all of the ingredients.
Please the egg whites into a container where you can mix them into fluffiness. Use your hand blender or mixer and mix the egg whites fully.
Once your egg whites are fully mixed and have a nice stiff peak, add cheese you have **1/4 Cup Grated Cheddar Cheese** yourself and **1 Tbsp Garlic Powder** powder.
Once everything is fully mixed add **1/4 Cup Grated Cheddar Cheese** and **1 Tbsp Garlic Powder** and with a silicone spatula gently fold both additional ingredients into the egg whites.
Using a silicone spatula, gently fold both additional ingredients into the egg whites.

Prepare your baking Tin form, which you normally use for your cupcakes or muffins. This is the best form since the bottom of the tin has got a beautiful round shape and lets you get the perfectly same round-shaped Keto Cloud Egg Chrisps to form.
Spray the baking form fully to help your crisps easily taken out after they have been baked.
Using your silicone spatula, place egg white mixture into each muffin tin baking form evenly. This recipe should be enough for the form I have used which is 12 pieces.
Once all of the mixture is spread, use your hands and/or spatula and make sure each of the egg white mixture is spread throughout the round shape of your baking muffin tin.
Once all done, place it into the oven and bake for 10 minutes on 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit.
If you want them even more crunchy but on the other side a bit dryer you can leave them on for 15 minutes.

title: Simple Keto Basil Pesto
instructions: Pick fresh Basil **4 Cups Fresh Basil Leaves**, prepare the extra **1/4 Cup Extra Virgin Olive Oil** olive oil and Himalayan **1 tsp Salt** and squeeze half of the **1/2  Lemon (Juice)** to have it all ready.
Fill Magic Bullet with Basil **4 Cups Fresh Basil Leaves**
Add a spoon of Himalayan **1 tsp Salt**
Add EVO Oil
Add a freshly squeezed **1/2  Lemon (Juice)** juice from half of the lemon to retain that beautiful green color.

Once all of the ingredients are in the Magic bullet Cup, close the lid and switch on the magic bullet.Mix it for about half a minute and when you see it all done, open the magic bullet Cup and add the rest of the basil **4 Cups Fresh Basil Leaves** and oil into it.

Once everything is fully mixed pour into a jar or a glass container that you can store in the refrigerator. I love my mason jars as you might already know, and I have stored this Keto **4 Cups Fresh Basil Leaves** Pesto into one of the smaller size mason jars.
Stored in the refrigerator it should last for up to a year.

title: Keto Smores Chaffle Recipe
instructions: Using ever so popular Dash Mini Maker, make your **Sweet Chaffles:** Chaffles in advance as the first step in our recipe.
Once your **Sweet Chaffles:** Chaffles are done, you can continue with Keto Marshmallows, following steps in the recipe until you get the perfect fluff out of the mixture.
Take one of the **Sweet Chaffles:** Chaffle and with a spatula spread the Marshmallow Fluff onto the Chaffle using circular Motions. Check the video for a better understanding.
Once you are ready with spreading and happy with the thickness of Marshmallows, cover the top with another **Sweet Chaffles:** Chaffle.

Gently press both of the Chaffles against the marshmallow fluff, making sure **0,5 Cups **1 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute**-Free Chocolate** marshmallow is spread evenly throughout all of the Chaffles from inside. You can even the sides with the edge of the knife to have everything perfectly even.
Let all of the Chaffles filled with marshmallows sit for a while until you prepare your **0,5 Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** ganache.
Either in an Instant Pot or Double Boiler, melt **0,5 Cups **1 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute**-Free Chocolate** Chocolate together with Cocoa **4 teaspoons Cocoa Butter** until fully melted.
Take each **Sweet Chaffles:** Chaffle filled with Marshmallow and dip into the **0,5 Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** around the whole outing covering all of the marshmallows.
Let it sit on a rack until fully dry.

title: Easy Strawberry Mint Keto Smoothie Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all of the ingredients. With regards to the liquid, you can pour both **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** milk as well as heavy cream into one cup beforehand.
Take clean, washed, whole **2 Cups Strawberries**, and pour them into a blender.
Add **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** milk and heavy cream into the blender.

Add 6 to 8 bigger size fresh mint **6-8  Fresh Mint Leaves** into the blender. The best is to pick them directly from the garden or a pot you have in the kitchen since this will give the best freshest and flavorful touch to this Keto Smoothie.
Close the lid, switch on the blender onto smoothie settings and mix.
Once or mixed you can serve it over a glass filled with ice.

title: Extra Moist Blueberry Bundt Cake Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 Cup Fresh Blueberries - optional (1/4 Cup Dry Blueberries)
instructions: To make the cake, prepare all ingredients together. You can make **7 Cups Farmers Cheese**' cheese and **4 Tablespoons Yogurt - optional** at home, and sweetener can be ground into powder form using a coffee grinder. At the same time heat oven to 150 degrees Celsius or 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In your kitchen machine, mix egg whites until fluffy and stiff.
Swap the bowl and add egg yolks with **7 Tablespoons Sugar Substitute** sweetener for mixing. Keep mixing until you get a fluffy light yellow consistency.
Once you thoroughly mix the egg yolks, add additional ingredients. Switch on the kitchen machine and keep mixing until all the farmer's **7 Cups Farmers Cheese** is fully incorporated.
Slowly fold all of the egg whites in. After adding egg whites and mixing, fold in the **1/2 Cup Fresh Blueberries - optional (1/4 Cup Dry Blueberries)** dried, fresh or frozen.

Once you have mixed all, take your silicone form and pour the cake batter into it. Bake the cake in the oven for 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. Once you take the cake from the oven, invert the cake onto the wire rack and allow the cake to cool.

title: Sugar-Free Sesame Snaps Recipe
ingredients: 3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Honey or Maple syrup
instructions: Prepare all ingredients together. For a more crunchy version, skip **3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Honey or Maple syrup** replacement.

Heat the cooking pan and pour in the **3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Honey or Maple syrup**-like sweetener and **3 Tablespoon Brown Sugar substitute** sugar. Using a spatula, stir everything together lightly on low heat.

On a heated pan, make sure both sweeteners are fully melted and mixed. Let them boil slightly, letting the water dissolve and evaporate slightly from the **3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Honey or Maple syrup**-like sweetener for a thicker and crunchier option. You can also add **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** extract, which is optional.

Once you melt both of the sweeteners, add **1 Cup Sesame Seeds** seeds. Stir constantly and combine **3 Tablespoon Brown Sugar substitute** with seeds. Make sure the seeds are fully coated with sweeteners.

Once all the **1 Cup Sesame Seeds** and the sweeteners are thoroughly mixed, transfer them onto a lightly greased parchment paper. Let them cool for 2-3 minutes. Using a rolling pin, start rolling the mixture into the thinnest possible. You can place another piece of parchment paper on top for an easier spread. Check the video for a better understanding. I have used wet hands and a silicone spatula to shape the corners.

Once the mixture is spread fully and made to your desired thickness, slice the sheet into your desired shapes and sizes with a wet knife. It is easier to cut it while the mixture is still soft, as once it hardens, it will take double the time. Let it cool thoroughly.

Once everything is cooled, using scissors, cut the **3 Tablespoons **3 Tablespoon Brown Sugar substitute**-Free Honey or Maple syrup** **1 Cup Sesame Seeds** bars into the shapes, leaving the paper on it. It will help you with storage, and it’s perfect for packaging later on. Once ready to eat, peel and enjoy.

title: Raw Seed Keto Crackers Bread
instructions: Prepare all the **1/4 Cup White Chia Seeds**
Using one bigger bowl, place all of the **1/4 Cup White Chia Seeds** insight and mix all together.
Take about a quarter cup of the mixture and place it into your grinder, magic bullet or coffee grinder. Grind all into a powder and place it back into the bowl.

Using your spatula mix the powdered **1/4 Cup White Chia Seeds** into whole seeds fully and add **1,5 Cup Water**. Keep mixing until all of the water is incorporated. Let it sit for about 5 to 10 minutes.

Once you see the mixture has thickened, start spreading it either on a parchment paper baking tray or a dehydrator tray. Using a silicone spatula is the best way to spread the mixture as thin as possible.

Place all of the trays onto a dehydrator and start the process.  If you do not have a dehydrator and would like to use the oven, you can do the same and spread the mixture onto a baking tray covered with parchment paper and dehydrate in the oven at 70°.
Cut and enjoy

title: Homemade Vanilla Extract Recipe
instructions: Split **9  Vanilla Beans** beans in half lengthwise to ensure all the little beans are opened up. Scrape out the vanilla beans once they are all sliced, and cut the vanilla beans into half to fit into your mason jar.
Depending on how many mason jars you will use and how much **9  Vanilla Beans** extract you would like to have, split all the beans into Mason jars evenly.
Make sure you get better quality with **3 Cups Vodka** or any other alcohol you would like to use.
Once you have segregated all of the **9  Vanilla Beans** beans into the mason jars you’re going to use, add one cup of **3 Cups Vodka** to each.
Prepare your Instant Pot by placing the metal stand and filling it with at least one cup of water.
On the stand, place three of the mason jars fully closed and close the lid of an instant pot.
Switch the instant pot on pressure for 45 minutes at the highest.

Once your 45 minutes is over, let the pressure of an Instant Pot release slowly and wait for an extra 10 to 15 minutes. Open your Instant Pot gently and if you wish, either let the jars in or take them out but do not open them.

title: Homemade Crunchy Pork Scratchings With Lard
instructions: Prepare your pork fat for this recipe. Ensure it is bought **2,2 lb Pure Fat from Pork** an excellent source to get the cleanest and best pig fat you can get. At the same time preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 400 degrees Fahrenheit.

First, make sure that all the **2,2 lb Pure Fat from Pork** fat is clean. Wash the fat properly and dry it with a paper napkin.  Using a sharp knife, cut the pork fat into strips and then approximately 2 cm or half an inch size squares.
Once all the fat is cut into squares, place it inside a glass casserole and pour some water. Place the casserole into the oven and let the rendering process start.

Approximately halfway, after about 20 minutes to an hour, you will see enough lard already melted. This is the best time to take the casserole out and strain all the fat into a glass jar through a strainer.

As you see in the picture, you will end up with a **2,2 lb Pure Fat from Pork** lard by-product. This lard is bright yellow while melted, but once it cools down, the color will turn into a beautiful pure white.

Once all the scratchings are done, take the casserole out of the oven, strain the remaining melted lard and place the scratchings on a paper towel. This will ensure that any additional oil is taken away, and you will end up with a beautiful, crispy, flavorful snack.
As scratchings do not have any flavor, you could spread them onto a tray and sprinkle them with salt or additional spices if you wish.

title: Cinnamon Pork Rinds Keto Churro
ingredients: Oil or Lard for deep frying​
instructions: Prepare your ingredients for a quick start.

Ensure your **500 g Raw Pork Skin** is clean and cut into small pieces to fit in a cooking pot. Place all the skin into the cooking pot and cover with water. On top of the skin you're going to cook, place a heavy pot to ensure the skin is permanently submerged in the water while cooking. Cook for about an hour.

Once you cook the **500 g Raw Pork Skin** thoroughly for an hour or so, take it out and let it dry and cool.  Some of the skin still contains fat that needs cleaning up. With a sharp knife, scrape the fat to ensure you get the thinnest skin possible. Cut into the desired shape. Cut it into long strips if you want a churro-like look and shape.

Once all the **500 g Raw Pork Skin** is clean and cut, place them onto a dehydrator sheet. Switch on the dehydrator for eight hours. The dehydration time depends on the size and thickness of your skin. It should take about eight hours, sometimes less, sometimes more.
Once all the **500 g Raw Pork Skin** is dehydrated, collect them from the sheets and place them in a jar or a bowl for later.

Prepare a cooking pot with oil and switch the heat on for **Oil or Lard for deep frying​** frying. Once the oil is fully heated, one by one, submerge the sticks of dry **500 g Raw Pork Skin** into the oil. It is advisable to use Tongs to make sure the skin doesn't fully twist.

When all the churros are **Oil or Lard for deep frying​**-fried and still warm, it is advisable to coat them straight away; otherwise, the sweet mixture will not stick to the skin. Prepare a glass container where you add two tablespoons of **2 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener** and two tablespoons of **2 Tbsp Cinnamon**. Mix it, and one by one, coat every single **500 g Raw Pork Skin** rind in the mixture.
Serve and enjoy.

title: Easy Keto Bundt Cake Recipe in Marble
instructions: Heat up the oven to 170 Celsius or 340 Fahrenheit.
Prepare all of the ingredients.
Separate egg whites from egg yolks. Place egg whites into the kitchen machine and beat them until stiff peaks. Set aside.

In a fresh mixing bowl, start with egg yolk and dry ingredients. First, beat together egg yolks with sugar **4 Tablespoons Sugar Substitute** until fluffy and smooth. Once that is mixed, slowly start adding **7 Tablespoons Almond Flour** flour and keep mixing.  When all the almond flour is thoroughly mixed, add baking powder and incorporate that into the batter once again.

Add part of the egg whites into the batter and slowly fold them into the mixture. Keep adding more and more of the egg whites in, and keep folding.  Once all of the egg whites are in the batter, gently fold them in until all of the egg whites are incorporated into the mixture, and you do not have any lumps.
Pour ¾ of the batter into the prepared bundt pan. Make sure it is spread evenly inside the pan. Gently hit the pan against the surface for all the bubbles to disappear.

With ¼ of the batter left, add **2 Tablespoons Cocoa** in and mix the cocoa with your spatula. Make sure no lumps of dry cocoa stays in. Gently pour that on top of the batter inside the pan. Using a stick, the end of the spoon, or the back of your spatula, mix the chocolate part into the cake using circular motions. Check the video for a better understanding.
Place it into the oven and let it bake for 45 minutes.

title: Crispy Smoked Zucchini Chips Recipe
instructions: Using your mandolin or electric food slicer, as you can see on the video, slice the **3  Zucchini** into thin approx 3 mm slices.

Once you slice your **3  Zucchini**, place them into a mixing bowl.  Sprinkle extra virgin **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil, smoked **1 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika Powder**, and **1 Tablespoon Salt**. In this step, you can add more spices if you wish to.
Gently mix all of the **3  Zucchini** slices, ensuring all the spices and oil evenly distribute on each zucchini.
Take out your dehydrator and place **3  Zucchini** slices in a single layer onto the dehydrator trays. Using your hand will help ensure you coat all the zucchinis evenly from each side.
Once you fill all of the dehydrator trays, stack them on top of each other, close the lid and switch the dehydrator on low heat for 8 hours or overnight.

title: Instant Pot Keto Mulled Wine Recipe
ingredients: 1  Bottle (Dry Red Wine of your choice)
instructions: Pour your choice of Red **1  Bottle (Dry Red Wine of your choice)** into the Instant Pot.

Add all of the spices starting with Fresh **1/4 Cup Cranberries**, Few Star **3  Star Anise** Pieces, Slices of fresh **3  Fresh Ginger Slices**, **3  Cinnamon Sticks** sticks, few Cardamom **3  Cardamon Seeds**, whole **1  Vanilla Bean** Bean (which you can cut in half to intensify the flavor), Sugar **1 Tbsp Sugar Substitute** and Fresh **1  Fresh Rosemary**.
Add ¼ of the **1/4  Orange** as well as **1/4  Lemon** decorated with Cloves.
Close the lid, Turn the valve to pressure and switch the Instant Pot to Pressure for 1 minute.

The process behind is, that it will take approximately 15 minutes for the Instant Pot to fully Pressurize. During this time the **1  Bottle (Dry Red Wine of your choice)** warms up and combines all of the flavors together. And then only a minute will be needed to get the fully Mulled Wine Ready.
Let the Instant Pot De-pressurize naturally, open the lid and enjoy

title: Spinach Smoked Salmon Roulade Recipe with Caviar
instructions: Get all of ingredients ready. If you are using frozen **7 Ounce Frozen Spinach**, let it fully thaw. **6 Tablespoons Caviar** can be replaced by your favorite filling.
Preheat your oven to 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit. With a hand blender, whisk your eggs first until fluffy. Once they are mixed, add unfrozen **7 Ounce Frozen Spinach**.

Again using your hand blender, mix thoroughly and transfer it to a baking tray covered with parchment paper or a silicone sheet. Using a hand spatula, make sure the mass is spread all over the tray evenly. Check the video for a better understanding.
Sprinkle all of the grated **1 Cup Cream Cheese** on top of the **7 Ounce Frozen Spinach**-egg mixture. Make sure the cheese is spread evenly all over. Place it into the oven and bake for 15 minutes.
Once the **7 Ounce Frozen Spinach** roulade is baked, let it cool and spread cream **1 Cup Cream Cheese**. On top of the cream cheese, place the **7 slices Smoked Salmon** slices evenly.
Place all the **6 Tablespoons Caviar** alined in one row at the beginning of the **7 Ounce Frozen Spinach** roulade with a small spoon. The part which you will start rolling.
Start rolling from the side where you have placed **6 Tablespoons Caviar** and **7 slices Smoked Salmon**. Using both hands, start rolling the whole roulade.

Once the whole **7 slices Smoked Salmon** roulade is rolled, take a piece of plastic wrap and roll the salmon with it. Twist the ends of a cling film and place the entire piece into the fridge. It is best to refrigerate overnight.

title: How To Make Coconut Milk Form Scratch
instructions: Using a hammer or heavy meat tenderizer, hit heavily through the imaginary line in the middle of the coconut. Crack open the coconut and drain the liquid out of the coconut.
With a sharp knife, cut through the coconut meat diagonally and vertically to help with removing the meat from the coconut shelves.
Remove the coconut meat. With the help of a knife, try to release the coconut meat first from the side of the cups, pulling outwards.
Using a sharp knife or vegetable peeler, clean the brown layer of the coconut meat thoroughly. Wash the coconut if needed, leaving you with beautiful white-only coconut pieces.
With a hand grater, grate the coconut into shreds. You will get the perfect shreds for milk using the smaller holes.
Add 2 cups of shredded coconut and 1 litre (4 cups) of room temperature water into a stand mixer or blender and blend.
Pour the coconut milk and strain it through a muslin cloth, milk bag, or cheesecloth, squeezing as much of the milk as possible.

title: Spider Web Deviled Eggs
instructions: Boil your **6  Eggs** to fully hard using your preferred method.
Place half a cup of frozen **1/2 Cup Wild Blueberries** berries into a pot.
Add boiling water and let it boil for another 10-15 minutes. Letting them cook further will help evaporate water, making your color dark and deep.
Once your hard-boiled **6  Eggs** are cooked, remove eggs from a cooking pot. Place eggs to a large bowl and, with a teaspoon, lightly crack shell one by one throughout the whole egg.
Using a spoon, gently place the cracked **6  Eggs** one at a time into the boiled blueberry cooking liquid. It is best if you layer in a large saucepan.
Remove from heat and let stand for 15 minutes allowing the **1/2 Cup Wild Blueberries** berries water to work its charm and color all the **6  Eggs**.
Let the **6  Eggs** cool completely. Place all cracked eggs into a bowl and gently peel them all.

For olive spiders, it is best to buy **10  Black Olives** without seeds. It will be much easier to cut them into the exact shapes you want. Take the olives and cut them in halves. Once they are cut, take some halves and cut each into a bit thicker slices. This will then be used for the legs of the spiders.
All of the **6  Eggs** you have peeled need to be cut in half. Place eggs in a single layer in a large plate you will decorate.
Place one-half of the olive on top of each sliced egg. Slowly place three slices on each side of the half to form a spider-like looking little monster creature. You can use tweezers if you wish to.

title: How To Make Shredded Coconut From Scratch
instructions: Preheat oven to 70 Celsius (150 Fahrenheit) With a hammer, break the coconut until cracks.
Drain the **Water to Clean** into a separate bowl and open the coconut
With a hard and sharp knife cut the meat diagonally and vertically and take out the inside meat out of the coconut shell
With a vegetable peeler peel the outer dark skin from the meat. Wash the pieces to get the nice and white shreds.
Using a mandolin or a hand grater to shred the coconut pieces
Spread on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper and bake for approximately 10-15 minutes. Make sure you mix the shreds in between to get all of the moisture out and dry them fully.
Switch off the oven and let them cool inside to achieve better crunchiness.
Store in an air-tight container and enjoy.

title: Easy Keto Flaxseed Wraps Recipe
instructions: Prepare your ingredients for making the best and easiest tortilla recipe ever. Flax seeds can be dark or light, whichever you prefer. The only difference would be the shade of your wraps at the end. Water should be boiling for the flax to work. You could add **1 tsp Salt**, pepper, dry **1 Tablespoon Garlic Powder**, or spices for extra flavor
Place whole Golden seeds into the Magic Buller or Coffee Grinder and grind all of the seeds until you get a perfect grounded flour like consistency
Place the grounded **1.5 Cups Flaxseeds** into a medium size mixing bowl and add **1 Tablespoon Garlic Powder** and **1 tsp Salt**
Add boiling water into the bowl. The water needs to be boiling, otherwise, you will not get the smooth consistency and the dough would become clumpy.
Properly mix the dough until you achieve a beautiful consistency to be able to work easily with it.
With a knife or spatula, separate the dough into 6-8 pieces. it all depends on how thin and big you are able to make your Flaxseed Keto Wraps.

Either on a Parchment paper or nonstick silicone mat, start rolling the dough into a thin rounded shape. Try to roll it as thin as possible, but not entirely thin, otherwise, you will not be able to lift the wrap from the silicone mat.
Cut a parchment paper into smaller squares. You will need this for placing the wraps on it for easier handling
With a round bowl or a plate, press onto the rolled wrap to get ever and precise shape.
Using a long knife or spatula, slowly get the wraps onto already precut Parchment Paper. Please see the video for better instruction. Preheat the pan on a medium high

Once you have all of the Flaxseed Keto Wraps ready, start with roasting them on a pan. You can use few drops of oil if you do not have a nonstick pan. Cook each side of the Wrap for about a minute, pressing gently from time to time. Once you see, they are done, place them on a plate and serve.
