title: 3 Cheese Keto Zucchini Boats with Bacon
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making stuffed **3  Zucchini** boats. Cut **1 Cup Pre-Cut Bacon** into smaller pieces.
Preheat the oven to 190C or 370F. Place all of the fillings as per the recipe into a big bowl and properly mix it all together.

title: Keto Fiber Noodles
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon Oat Fiber or Potato Fiber
instructions: Prepare all ingredients and heat the oven to 150 Celsius or 300 Fahrenheit
Place all the ingredients into the Magic Bullet or a blender you use. Blend all thoroughly until creamy, silky consistency.

Pour onto a baking sheet covered with a silicone sheet lining. Using your spatula, spread it all over the sheet, completely thin. If any holes appear, try to cover them gently.  Place into the oven and bake for 8 minutes.

Once your baked pasta sheet is cooled, cut the ends in case they are extremely thin or crusty. Cut your sheet into four pieces to fit the size of your pasta machine.  Pick the shape and let it gently roll through the pasta machine to give you a perfect shape of noodles or spaghetti.

title: Best Keto Dinner Rolls
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Having your **4  Eggs** at room temperature is best to get the extra stiff peak with your egg whites.
In a glass bowl, add all the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly. Set aside.
First, whisk your egg white until it stiff peaks using a kitchen machine and set aside. this will help in having your kaiser rolls extra fluffy.
Whisk egg yolks and add **1 Cup Greek Yogurt** and all of the wet ingredients. Give it a full mix.

Once all of the wet ingredients have been thoroughly mixed, start adding spoon by spoon your dry mixture. Keep your machine on as it will continue mixing all ingredients. Once that is done, reduce the speed to a minimum and start adding the egg white mixture you have on the side. Mix half into the mixture and stop. Take the bowl out from the machine, and the second half of the egg whites fold gently using a spatula. Cover it with a kitchen towel and let it rest for approximately half an hour. Preheat your oven to 150 degrees Celsius or 300 degrees Fahrenheit.

Using your hand, start shaping your keto dough into buns. Bear in mind that they will still get bigger once baked, and therefore try to keep enough space in between. Roll them into balls and place them on a baking sheet with silicone or parchment paper. Using your hand, gently flatten them into a bun shape.

To get the perfect look of authentic kaiser rolls, sprinkle a tiny bit of your **3/4 Cup Potato or Oat Fiber** on top of each bun. Now comes the best part. Using a kaiser shape, gently stamp each of your buns to get that famous look. Place into the oven and bake the rolls for 40 minutes at 150 Celsius or 300 degrees Fahrenheit until golden brown.

title: Sauerkraut Soup Recipe
ingredients: 2 Cups Dried Wild Mushrooms (Penny Bun or Porcini)
instructions: First, prepare all of the ingredients. Hopefully, by now, you have a jar of dry **2 Cups Dried Wild Mushrooms (Penny Bun or Porcini)** in your pantry to use it. Onions and **3 Cloves Garlic** should e thinly sliced. Prepare the **500 grams Sauerkraut**.

First, sauté onions and **3 Cloves Garlic** with a bit of olive oil in a large pot. Let the **1  Onion** caramelize, and add sliced **100 grams Italian Sausage**. Mix, add dry **2 Cups Dried Wild Mushrooms (Penny Bun or Porcini)**, sauté a bit more and continue with a pinch of salt as well as pepper.
Once everything is sautéed (see video), switch off the heat and add sweet **2 Tablespoons Dry Red Sweet Paprika** powder. While the heat is turned off, incorporate paprika powder fully.

Add the **500 grams Sauerkraut** and mix well. Switch the heat on again, add boiling water or bone broth and cover with a lid. Let the soup simmer on medium heat for approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes.

title: How to Make Keto Sugar-Free Sprinkles
instructions: Depending on the colorings you will use, prepare your coconut shreds and the ingredients for colors. Heat the oven to 70 Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit.Prepare your coconut shreds, and separate them into glass bowls depending on the number of colors you are going to make.
Prepare your coconut shreds, and separate them into glass bowls depending on the number of colors you are going to make.

For **Natural Homemade Coloring** coloring, I have picked berries and turmeric. As you see in the video, I used frozen blueberries and fresh raspberries, which I cooked until most of the water evaporated. I let them run through the sieve to get rid of the little seeds and prepared the colored liquid.  The exact steps you can use for various other natural colors I have described in the article above. I mixed turmeric with a few drops of water for the yellow and orange color.

Into each bowl, add your food **Natural Homemade Coloring**. Mix fully until you get the color you have been looking for. If the colors are not spreading evenly, add a few drops of water and mix again.

Prepare your baking sheet covered with parchment paper. On it, place each colored sprinkles in separate lines with space in between. It will be later on much easier to separate the colors. Place into the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes. After that, switch the oven off, gently mix the sprinkles so the moist one gets on top, and let it dry and cool inside the oven.

title: Easy Keto Cupcakes
instructions: Heat your oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. At the same time, prepare all of your ingredients, which are **3/4 Cup Blanched Almond Meal** flour, **3  Eggs**, **1 Tablespoon Butter**, sweeteners, and baking powder.
Add **3  Eggs** to a container for your hand mixer and whisk them until fluffy.
One by one, add all of the other ingredients.
Whisk thoroughly until all combined, and you have no lumps in the batter.
Fill your baking cupcake muffin tin covered with cupcake liners. Bake in the oven for 10 minutes and let it cool.

title: Keto Goldfish Crackers Recipe
instructions: Prepare your only one ingredient, and that is **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese** cheese. If you pick slices, which are the easiest to cut out, you have no worries. If you want to use a block of cheese, try to slice it with your bread slicer or a meat slicer.
Using a fish-shaped cookie cutter, start gently cutting fish shapes out of your **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese**. One by one, place the fish-shaped cheese onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Once all of your **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese** is placed onto a baking sheet, cover it with a kitchen paper towel and put it into your kitchen pantry for 3-4 days until your cheese fully dries.
Once your goldfish **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese** pieces are fully dry, heat your oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. Place in the oven for 3-4 minutes and enjoy.

title: Low Carb Meatloaf Recipe with Cheese and Leeks
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients needed for our low-carb meatloaf recipe. In our case, it is **2,2 Cups Minced Meat** meat, **2  Eggs**, **2  Whole Leeks**, dried **1 Tablespoon Dried Marjoram**, salt, pepper, and, if needed, dry garlic. At the same time, heat the oven to 180 Celsius or 356 Fahrenheit

Clean and cut the lower white part of the leek (approximately 10 centimeters), chop it into small pieces, and add it to the bowl with **2,2 Cups Minced Meat** meat. The rest of the **2  Whole Leeks** separate into single leaves as they would be used for packaging the meatloaf.
Add **2  Eggs** and herbs into the mixing bowl with **2,2 Cups Minced Meat** meat and chopped leek. Combine all.

Place a big pot with water to boil. Once boiling, add leaves from leek and cook for 3-4 minutes.  Remove the leak leaves from the water, pour cold water over them to set the color, and set them aside to dry a bit.

Start layering your meatloaf dish. Arrange the leek leaves on the bottom of the pan with the sides leaning over as described in the video. Once your sheets are layered, fill half of the pan with mixed meatloaf and add two **2  Buffalo Mozzarella** bowls into the middle. Cover it with the rest of the **2,2 Cups Minced Meat** mixture. Finish up by covering the **2  Whole Leeks** dish with the leek ends and, if needed, add more leaves, so the entire dish is covered.
Cover with aluminum foil, place it in the oven, and bake for 40 minutes. Once 40 minutes are done, take out the aluminum cover and bake for an additional 10 minutes.

title: Keto Crispy Baked Zucchini in Oven
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for baked zucchinis. At the same time, heat your oven to 190 Celsius or 375 Fahrenheits. Clean and slice your **1  Whole Zucchini** into approximately one-centimeter thick slices. If you do not have **Breadcrumbs from 1 Bun**, simply slice your keto bread, bake it in the oven to dry, and let it run in your food processor.
Prepare three bowls. Into one, place an egg and whisk with a fork. Into the second bowl place your **Breadcrumbs from 1 Bun** and into the third sliced zucchinis.
First, soak your **1  Whole Zucchini** slices in the egg mixture. Turn them a few times, making sure each zucchini slice is coated with eggs.
Using a fork, move the egg-coated slices into the **Breadcrumbs from 1 Bun** mixture. Coat the breadcrumbs thoroughly onto each of the slices.

One by one, place each of the coated **1  Whole Zucchini** slices onto the baking tray covered with either a parchment paper or a silicone baking sheet. Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Sugar-Free Gummy Bears
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making sugar-free gummy bears.
Into a glass, place the tea bag, and pour boiling **1/2 Cup Hot Water** in.
Add a sweetener of your choice and **1 Packet Gelatine Sheets**.

As mentioned, **2 teaspoons Lemon Juice** juice is fully optional, and it only adds to the flavor. Add one spoon if you like, and make sure everything is thoroughly mixed and **1 Packet Gelatine Sheets** entirely dissolved.
Using a pipette, which comes with gummy bear molds, start filling your mold with the liquid. Place into the fridge until it hardens.

title: Gluten Free Gingerbread Cookies Keto
ingredients: 3 teaspoons Gingerbread spices (an equal amount of Nutmeg, Coriander, Fennel, Anis, Cardamon, Ginger, Cinnamon)
1  Egg yolk (+ 3 teaspoons almond milk for top of cookies)
instructions: Heat up the oven for 170 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. Prepare all of your ingredients together with a tablespoon of **3 teaspoons Gingerbread spices (an equal amount of Nutmeg, Coriander, Fennel, Anis, Cardamon, Ginger, Cinnamon)** spices. Separate an egg and use egg white for the dough. Place the egg yolk into a separate bowl to be used at the end.
In a big glass bowl, mix all the dry ingredients together. Once you make the dough, use a piece of plastic wrap and place it into the refrigerator for an approximately half hour.

Place the **3 teaspoons Gingerbread spices (an equal amount of Nutmeg, Coriander, Fennel, Anis, Cardamon, Ginger, Cinnamon)** cookie dough onto a silicone sheet or parchment paper sprinkled a bit with **1/4 Cup Vanilla Protein** powder or **1  Egg yolk (+ 3 teaspoons almond milk for top of cookies)** **1,5 Cups Almond Flour** to prevent sticking. On top of the dough place a parchment paper and with a rolling pin and roll the dough thinly.
Using your favorite cookie cutter, cut the rolled dough into shapes, which you can immediately place onto the baking tray covered with parchment paper.

Whisk your leftover egg yolk with a fork or whisk. You can add a few drops of **1  Egg yolk (+ 3 teaspoons almond milk for top of cookies)** milk if the consistency is too thick. Using your brush, brush the mixed egg yolk on top of each cookie.

What to decorate your cookie is really up to you. Above I have mentioned a few tips and suggestions you can use. I have used almonds as the simplest and still beautiful. You can use walnuts or any nuts, for that matter. You can also leave them clear. Bake for 9 minutes.

title: Hearty Vegetable Stew Recipe - Hungarian Lecso
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. Make sure you cut all vegetables into thin slices for a better taste.
Place a large pot or Dutch oven onto a stovetop and heat up. Add oil.
Once the pan is fully heated, add onion slices and cook halfway. Add chopped **5 Cloves Garlic** and cook both thoroughly until the onions and garlic brown.

Once you caramelize onions, add all **3  Green Pepper** **Black Pepper** slices and mix. Simmer until peppers get soft, stirring occasionally. It might take a while since peppers always take the longest time to soften.
Once your peppers are soft, add thinly sliced **4  Tomatoes**, mix them all into the veggies, cover the pot, and allow it to cook for about 5 minutes.
Once you cook all of the veggies, make sure you switch off the heat. In the meantime, add turmeric powder, thyme and season to taste with salt and **Black Pepper**.

Once you switched off your baking pan for a few minutes, take your **4  Eggs**, and with the whisk, mix egg yolks and egg whites in the glass before pouring. Ensure you integrate the eggs into a smooth consistency until the stew has thickened.

Slowly pour the whole mixture onto the vegetables and mix the **4  Eggs** with your wooden spatula.Do not switch the heat on anymore. The eggs will cook themselves inside the vegetables even without the heat.

title: Avocado Burger
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making an **1  Whole Avocado** bun **1  Low Carb Burger**. Regarding the burger, I have made our low-carb burgers, but you can also choose a **1 Slice Bacon** burger or the burger of your choice, some bacon, tomato, **Slices Radish**, **Slices Cucumber**, lettuce, **1 Slice Cheese**, and sesame seeds for the topping.
Using a sharp knife, cut the **1  Whole Avocado** in half.
The lower part of the **1  Whole Avocado** is cut into a small base for the avocado to stand correctly.
Gently peel all of the **1  Whole Avocado** skin, making sure the avocado itself looks pretty.
Place the base of the **1  Whole Avocado** on the plate and start layering your veggies, **1  Low Carb Burger**, **1 Slice Bacon**, and lettuce.
Place the top of the **1  Whole Avocado** on a bun. I picked a barbecue stick to attach the whole avocado in the middle.

title: Naruto Rolls - Cucumber Sushi Rolls
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together, in our case, long cucumbers, **1/2  Avocado**, and raw **6 slices Raw Salmon**.
Using your vegetable peeler, slice the cucumber's outer layers.

Having your sushi bamboo mat already prepared, layer the slices of cucumbers, making sure they are halfway covering each other. Once all of the slices are layered, cut the ends to make sure the pieces are the same size.
Onto the one corner of the cucumber slices, place your toppings **1/2  Avocado** and **6 slices Raw Salmon** horizontally.
As you see in the video, start rolling Naruto rolls exactly the same way as you would roll standard sushi into a log.

Once your cucumber is rolled, cover it with cling film and tighten it from each side for the roll to hold its shape. It is advisable to either place the Naruto roll in the fridge for an hour or freeze it for a few minutes for the cucumber to hold its shape before cutting.
Take your naruto roll log out of the fridge or a freezer, open the cling film, and gently cut it into six cucumber naruto rolls.

title: Zucchini Chips Dehydrated
instructions: Clean and dry **3  Zucchini**
Cut them into a thin slices either on a bread/meat cutting machine, or by hand at the thinnest. I have used bread machine on N1.

Place all the zucchinis into a bowl, sprinkle with **2 Tablespoons Olive oil** oil, **1 Teaspoon Freshly Grated Garlic** **2 Tablespoons Freshly Ground Thyme** thyme, **2 Tablespoons Sesame Seeds** seeds, **1/2 Teaspoon Salt** and garlic.
Gently mix all together and place it onto the dehydrator plates.
Switch the dehydrator onto the highest ( in my case it is 70 C or 158 Fahrenheit)
Switch the plates every 2 hours to get the drying process evenly.
Once done store it in the airtight container or enjoy it in 2 minutes as we did ( or one person in our family did)

title: Keto Asparagus Pasta
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients you will need for keto pasta and cheesy, creamy sauce.

Clean and slice the skin of the white **15 Pieces White Asparagus** and cut the ends a bit. Take 10 pieces and slice them with a hand slicer into a thin tagliatelle. Cut the tops and put aside with additional 5 whole pieces

Boil the water, where you add a bit of lemon, butter and **Lemon, Butter, ​and Stevia ( for boiling)** (this will prevent the bitterness of some **15 Pieces White Asparagus**) Place all asparagus ( slices and the leftovers) into the water and cook for 12 minutes. You can cook the Tagliatelle and extra pieces separate if you want or if you think it would be difficult to separate them, but I have done it all together and it was ok. Once asparagus in cooked, throw the water and take all the leftover pieces and add them into the **250 grams Sour Cream** sauce.

In the meantime heat up sour **250 grams Sour Cream** and **150 grams Creme Fraiche** cheese. Add **50 grams Grated Cheese** cheese and with hand blender mix the cream with **15 Pieces White Asparagus** pieces to get a smooth sauce.

title: Wild Garlic Greens Chips
instructions: Heat up the oven on 160 Celsius or 320 Fahrenheit
Clean and dry wild **100 grams Wild Garlic**
Place in a bowl and add 1 Tbsp Extra **1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil** olive oil and mix well, so each leave is coated with oil
One by one place leaves on a baking tray covered with parchment paper. The leaves should not be over each other
Grain hard **5 grams Shredded Cheese** and sprinkle on already placed leaves
Place in the oven for circa 13 minutes
Bon appetite

title: How To Make Wild Garlic Pesto Recipe
ingredients: 200 milliliters Extra Virgin Olive Oil (3/4 Cup plus 3 Tablespoons)
instructions: Wash and dry clean all the wild **200 grams Fresh Wild Garlic Leaves** leaves and prepare your oil as well as **Himalayan Salt**.
If you’re using a magic bullet or any other food processor, put all wild **200 grams Fresh Wild Garlic Leaves** leaves into the container.
Add Extra **200 milliliters Extra Virgin Olive Oil (3/4 Cup plus 3 Tablespoons)** Olive Oil
Lastly, add **Himalayan Salt** of your choice.
Blend it thoroughly until you’re satisfied with the consistency.

title: How To Make Keto Burger Mini Bites
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
Using a grater, slice all of the vegetables you have chosen.
Using a large mixing bowl, place all of the grated vegetables in.
Add two **2  Eggs**, **2 Tablespoons Almond Flour** flour, **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1 teaspoon Pepper**, and mix.
Once everything is thoroughly mixed, start forming your burger mini bites.
One by one, place each burger onto your sheet pan covered with parchment paper.
Place into the oven and bake for 20 minutes on 220 Celsius or 420 Fahrenheit.
Once your burgers are baking, you can portion all of the leftovers in the meantime.
After 20 minutes of baking, take your sheet pan and turn each burger.
Place into the oven once again and bake for another 10 minutes.

title: Cream Cheese Fat Bombs Recipe
ingredients: Lemon Juice and Zest from 1 Lemon
Little Natural Coloring (possible to use a bit of juice from a fruit or LC syrup)
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients together on the kitchen counter.
Add all of the ingredients one by one into a big jar or a whisking jar.
Using a hand blender, whisk all together into a smooth, creamy consistency.
Once everything is mixed into a smooth consistency, and you wish to follow the steps of coloring your fat bombs, separate them into two jars.
Add your **Little Natural Coloring (possible to use a bit of juice from a fruit or LC syrup)** coloring into each jar.
Whisk each container together with the coloring until you get the desired color.
Once you are satisfied with the colors, fill your molds with the mixture.
For the whole mixture to set correctly and avoid the bubbles, gently bang the molds against the kitchen counter a few times.
Place in the freezer for 1 to 2 hours.

title: Drying Garlic From Your Harvest
instructions: The first thing to do is peel and separate the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** from the bulb. Slice them thinly so they will dry quickly.

If you use a round dehydrator with lots of holes, you might need a plastic insert silicone, which is a big help for laying out the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves**. Spray a small amount of olive oil onto the surface and spread it around the tray using a kitchen rubber brush. It will prevent the garlic from sticking to the dehydrator and can even add extra richness to the dried garlic.

Spread out the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** slices evenly on the trays with the plastic insert. Make sure to make space in between each piece for proper airflow. Set the temperature to around 160° Fahrenheit or 70° Celsius, depending on the dehydrator you are using.  Dehydrate for 6-8 hours until thoroughly dried and brittle.

title: How To Make Dried Tomatoes Using Dehydrator
instructions: Prepare your **2 Cups Sliced Tomatoes** by washing them first. After drying them, cut the tomatoes in half and cut side into uniform smaller tomato pieces about 1/4 inch thick.

As you have seen on my other dehydrated food blogs, I use a plastic insert silicone when dehydrating to prevent any falling ingredients from the trays. I used a plastic insert on the trays before spraying over a small amount of olive oil. It will prevent the **2 Cups Sliced Tomatoes** from sticking to the surface.

Arrange the tomato slices on the trays, ensuring each won't overlap. Placing the slices correctly and with spaces from each other is vital so they will dry evenly. Close the lid, and they are ready to dry. This is also the step where you can season your sliced **2 Cups Sliced Tomatoes** with dried herbs or any seasoning you choose.

Once the **2 Cups Sliced Tomatoes** are assembled, set your dehydrator to 135° Fahrenheit or 57° Celsius and let the tomatoes dry for 8-12 hours max. When the tomatoes are dehydrated, they should look like leathery slices with no moisture after drying. Place them on a baking sheet at room temperature for easy cooling.

title: Keto Bolognese Sauce
instructions: Using a cooking pot, start with browning your **1  Onion** with 1 Tablespoon of Olive oil.
Once the **1  Onion** is caramelized halfway, add **4  Garlic Cloves** and cook it for another few minutes.
Add your **1 Cup Bacon Diced** which you have cut into small cubes and your **2 Cups Minced Meat** meat. Mix it together and cook for approximately 10 to 15 minutes.
Once your **2 Cups Minced Meat** meat and **1 Cup Bacon Diced** are cooked for approximately 15 minutes add **1 Cup Diced Fresh Celery** and all the herbs as well as salt and pepper.
Mix together and cook for another 10 minutes.
Once everything is cooked add **1,5 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce together with **1 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and mix all properly.
Cover with the top and cook it for another 40 minutes.

title: Keto Stuffed Tomatoes Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients beforehand.
For Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**, dice your **1  Small Onion**, **2  Garlic Cloves**, **1/2 Cup Diced Bacon**, and **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**.
Start with your **1  Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves**. Place them into a cooking pot sprinkled with olive oil and caramelize for few minutes.
Once caramelized, add **1/2 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes.
Add diced **1 Tablespoon Fresh Marjoram** **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
Cut top or the head of each **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**. Do not throw it as you will use it later to close the tomato.
Using a **1  Small Onion** spoon, hollow out each of the **9  Tomatoes**.
Scoop out all of the seeds as well as all the liquid, which will avoid **9  Tomatoes** being too watery after baking.
Again, using your spoon, fill each of the **9  Tomatoes** with bolognese sauce up to the top of the cut **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**.
Top it up with Grated Cheese.
Bake in the oven at 200C or 400F for approximately 30 minutes.

title: Almond Flour Keto Butter Cookies Recipe
instructions: Heat up the oven to 180C or 350F
Prepare all of your ingredients
On low heat, start melting the **1/4 Cup Butter**.
Let it cook for about half a minute and add a **1/4 Cup Brown Sugar** sugar substitute.
Cook it on low heat for approximately 2 to 3 minutes.

Once **1/4 Cup Butter** and sugar substitute are fully dissolved add **1/2 Cup Almond Flour** flour and mix fully.This is the step where you have to work fast as the **1/4 Cup Brown Sugar** sugar substitutes harden very quickly.
Add a few drops of **Vanilla Extract - Optional** extract.
Place all of the mixtures into the bowl with egg white and start mixing it fully.
Depending on what size of cookies you would like to have, pick either a measurement Spoon or normal round shape scoop.

This step is **Vanilla Extract - Optional** depending on what type of cookies you would like. If you prefer flat cookies, make sure you press either with your hands or the back of the spoon and make sure the cookies are as thin as possible.
Bake at 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit for approximately 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Keto Almond Flour Biscuits
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making our keto biscuits. Regarding pork **1/4 Cup Pork Scratchings grind** and **1/4 Cup Lard**, I have a perfect easy recipe you can pick and make your homemade pork scratchings.
Add all of the dry ingredients, **2 Cups Blanched Almond Flour** flour, baking powder, and **2 Tablespoons Coconut Flour** flour into a big bowl. Using a whisk, mix all of the ingredients.

As next goes, all of the wet ingredients, which in this case is an egg, sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream** and **1/4 Cup Lard** which has been left at room temperature to soften. Mix once again, and using a spatula, make sure all of the ingredients are well combined, and you end up with a beautiful dough.
Place all dough onto a cling film and make one loaf to store in the fridge. Leave it in the fridge for 2 to 3 hours, even overnight.

The first thing is to heat your oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. Take out the dough from the fridge and, using parchment paper as you see on the video, start rolling the dough. As you see, I have rolled it into a longer shape, which allowed me to spread the ground cracklings evenly. I have folded the dough in half and, using parchment paper, rolled it into a rectangular shape approximately 3 cm or less than an inch thick.
Using a cookie cutter or glass or a mason jar, let’s start cutting out your biscuits. Place them one by one on a parchment paper-lined baking sheet.

Once all biscuits are cut out, and on the baking tray, we can start designing them. I have used an egg slicer to make the design, as you see, but this is optional. I wanted those keto biscuits with **1/4 Cup Pork Scratchings grind** cracklings looking precisely the same as we are used to making them in my country, Slovakia. Once the design is done you can brush the top of each biscuit with an egg yolk. Place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes.

title: Crunchy Keto Popcorn Homemade Moon Cheese
instructions: Cut hard **1 Cup Hard Cheese** first into slices and then into small squares (I have used Gouda)
Place it on a baking sheet covered with parchment paper and cover with a napkin
Keep it on a kitchen top for 48 Hrs
Heat up the oven to 200 C (392F)
Place the **1 Cup Hard Cheese** in the oven for 3 minutes
Bon appetit

title: Easy Sugar-Free 4 Ingredient Nutella Cookies Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together. It is always easier to assemble everything once all is ready to mix. Make sure all is at room temperature. At the same time, preheat oven to 350°f or 180 Degrees Celsius.
Scoop out half a cup of **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Nutella** or hazelnut spread into a large bowl.
Add all of the other ingredients.
Mix all of the ingredients with sugar-free **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Nutella** using a spatula, ensuring you blend everything.

Once thoroughly mixed, prepare your cookie sheet by lining it with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat. Using two teaspoons or a small ice cream scoop, place the cookies on the baking sheet, leaving space between them.  You can finish shaping the cookies and flatten them with your wet hands. If you prefer, flattening keto **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Nutella** cookies gives them a bit of crunchiness.

Bake for 10 minutes in the oven and let them cool completely on a cooling rack. In addition, you can add a sprinkle of sea salt on top. Enjoy delicious baked cookies straight, or store them for later.

title: Oven Baked Keto Cheese Chips Recipe
instructions: Prepare your ingredients. In our case, it is slices of cheddar **6 slices Cheese (I have used Gouda)** together with gherkins and **5  Olives**. Cut both **2  Pickles** as well as olives into small slices.
Heat up the Oven to 170 Celsius or 340 Fahrenheit.
Place slices evenly onto the baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Place a few pieces of gherkins and **5  Olives** onto the **6 slices Cheese (I have used Gouda)** slices.
Place into the oven and bake for approximately 15 minutes until crunchy. Let your slices cool before touching. They will become more crispy as they cool down.

title: Homemade Keto Cheese Bacon Nachos Chips Recipe
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C or 390F
Shred both of the Cheeses
Cut **1/8 Cup Bacon** into small pieces
Prepare a baking sheet with Parchment paper
Spread all the **1/2 Cup Grated Emmental **1/2 Cup Grated Cheddar Cheese**** cheese
Sprinkle with tiny pieces of **1/8 Cup Bacon**
Cover with all the **1/2 Cup Grated Cheddar Cheese** Cheese
Shape all of it into one big square for easier cutting later on
Place it into the oven for circa 9 minutes
Take it out of the oven and let it cool a bit
Peel the whole sheet and cut with scissors into stripes.
Cut each stripe into triangles as per video shown
Place it on a clean parchment paper (do not use the leftover oil) and broils it for 1-2 minutes to get it crunchy
Bon Appetit

title: Granulated Garlic Recipe
instructions: First things first, prepare the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** by washing and drying. Slice into small, thin pieces and get your dehydrator ready.

Arrange your **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** by spraying some **1 teaspoon Olive Oil** oil first in the dehydrator trays, and once finished, assemble all the slices, making tiny spaces from each piece. Prepare the dehydrator and set the temperature to around 160° Fahrenheit or 70° Celsius. Start drying them for about 6 hours.

Prepare your magic bullet blender and start placing the dried **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** into the cup. If you feel more creative, add a small amount of salt or dry herbs to season. Start blending dried garlic by pulsing for a few seconds, and check if the granule form is perfect enough for you.

When blending the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves**, you have to check occasionally and ensure you will not get a fine powdered one. Since I was using a magic bullet, I double-checked while blending because the dried food would most likely get powdered easily. Keep them as a pantry staple, and be ready to use them for cooking.

title: Quick and Easy Creamy Keto Taco Soup Recipe
ingredients: 1/2 Cup Greek Yogurt or Sour Cream
instructions: First, prepare all ingredients you will use to cook this delicious creamy keto **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning** soup.
Chop all the vegetables into smaller pieces. The size depends on how big you like them in the soup.
Take out the Greek **1/2 Cup Greek Yogurt or Sour Cream** or sour cream from the fridge to be at room temperature when being used.
Start heating your cooking pot over medium heat with a tiny bit of olive oil.
Add onion and **2 Tablespoons Garlic** and cook until caramelized.
Once your onion and **2 Tablespoons Garlic** caramelize, add **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** beef and cook it until it browns up. It should take approximately 5 to 10 minutes.

Once your **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** beef browns, switch the heat and add taco **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning**. If you do not have taco seasoning packets, you can use our keto taco seasoning recipe, done in less than 5 minutes.
Mix it all until all the Mexican **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning** is fully incorporated.
Once your **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** beef is seasoned and browned, switch the heat back to medium-high, add remaining vegetables, and mix.
Add liquid such as **1 Cup Water or Broth**, bone broth, or chicken stock and cook for an additional 20 minutes.
Once all cooked, switch the heat off and add room temperature Greek **1/2 Cup Greek Yogurt or Sour Cream** or sour cream.
You can add grated cheddar cheese or hard cheese of your choice for extra creaminess.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro, avocado slices, lemon, or grated cheddar cheese.

title: Crispy Baked Zucchini Chips
instructions: Start by preheating the oven to 425°Fahrenheit (220°Celsius). First, wash and slice the zucchini round and turn it into perfectly thin slices. After you slice your zucchini, pat them dry using kitchen or paper towels before transferring them into a bowl.

Once in a bowl, sprinkle the zucchini slices with sweet **1 Tablespoon Sweet Paprika Spice** and **1 Teaspoon Salt**, followed by a small amount of olive oil for the coating. Mix until you cover all the slices evenly with sweet paprika powder.
Prepare your baking tray and arrange the zucchini slices in a single layer. Lay the zucchini slices evenly.

Bake the zucchini in the preheated oven for about 15-20 minutes. Remember to watch them and flip the slices between the baking times so they will cook evenly and get crispy. Once the zucchini chips are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool slightly before serving. They will continue to crisp up as they cool.

title: Crispy​ Garlic Keto Croutons Recipe Air Fryer
ingredients: 2 Cups Keto Farmers Bread (half of the loaf)
instructions: As already mentioned, pick your favorite **2 Cups Keto Farmers Bread (half of the loaf)**. Chop fresh herbs and get **2 Tablespoon Olive Oil** oil ready.

Make sure your **2 Cups Keto Farmers Bread (half of the loaf)** is cooled. Cut it into same-size slices and subsequently squares. As you see in the image, I have made smaller bread cubes, as I always love everything in more minor variations. For me, it tastes better as big chunks.

Place all of the croutons into a large bowl. Add oil and all the ingredients, herbs of your choice, and a bit of salt and pepper. With a big spatula, mix all of the croutons thoroughly. Remember to make sure the oil and herbs are spread evenly.
Depending on your Air Fryer, fill it up with your croutons. Make sure you only add one layer. Otherwise, they will not crisp fully.
Switch the Air Fryer on. You do not need to add additional oil since you have already coated your croutons with oil.
After 10 minutes, the crunchy croutons are golden brown and ready to be served. Let them cool or serve them still hot or warm. It all depends on how you want to use them.

title: Keto Radish Chips
instructions: Begin by preparing your ingredients for making dehydrated radish chips. I have used hemp **1 Tablespoon Hemp Seeds** as an addition, but you can add whatever seeds you wish. Thoroughly wash and remove excess dirt from **5  Red Radishes (Medium Size)**. Fully dry with a paper towel before you cut the radishes.

Take the bunch of **5  Red Radishes (Medium Size)** and thinly slice them into pieces using a sharp knife or mandolin. After you slice the radishes, place them into the mixing bowl and add flavors. Add the **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil** oil, sprinkling hemp **1 Tablespoon Hemp Seeds** for an added twist, and a gentle sprinkle with **1 teaspoon Salt** to elevate the taste.
Gently toss these seasoned radish slices in a mixing bowl, ensuring you cover each piece with the goodness of the oil, **1 Tablespoon Hemp Seeds**, and seasoning. Toss well.

Lay the radish slices on dehydrator sheets, ensuring enough room to breathe and crisp up. Place sheets on top of each other and close the dehydrator. Switch on and dehydrate for approximately 5 to 6 hours.

title: Bacon Wrapped Brussels Sprouts Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients together. Fully clean **12  Brussels Sprouts** sprouts, trim the stem ends, and discharge the outer layers. At the same time, preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 400 Degrees Fahrenheit.

Fully dry your **12  Brussels Sprouts** sprouts. Take one piece and one strip of **12 slices Bacon or Prosciutto**. If the piece of bacon slice is too broad, you can fold it or cut it into two parts. Wrap each Brussels sprout with bacon.

Lay the **12 slices Bacon or Prosciutto** wrapped **12  Brussels Sprouts** onto a rimmed baking sheet lined with parchment paper and top up with **1/4 Cup Shredded Cheese** cheese. Place into the oven and bake for 30 minutes or until bacon is crisp.
Once all the roasted **12  Brussels Sprouts** sprouts are baked, secure with a toothpick or finger food mini skewer. Place onto a serving dish and sprinkle with fresh thyme for extra flavor.

title: Sugar Free Almond Bark Recipe
instructions: First, prepare all your ingredients. You can choose any type of **1/2 Cup Chocolate** you like. White chocolate chips or milk chocolate bars also make the perfect almond bark candy recipe. If you plan on using activated **1/2 Cup Almonds (Skinless)**, ensure they are fully dehydrated since moisture can affect the texture of the almond bark. Almond slices or roasted almonds are also okay for this chocolate candy recipe.

Prepare the instant pot, add boiling water and switch to Suate. Add the glass bowl. Melt the **1/2 Cup Chocolate** and **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil. Using a microwave or a double boiler is another alternative if you do not have an instant pot. Stir with a stick until the chocolate is melted and thoroughly combined.

Prepare your silicone mold and assemble your **1/2 Cup Almonds (Skinless)** within the bar shape. Make sure the almonds are scattered evenly. Once the almonds are in, add the melted **1/2 Cup Chocolate** using a spoon. It is best to use a spoon to prevent any mess when you pour the chocolate in. Fill all the gaps with chocolate until all the almonds are covered.

After adding the **1/2 Cup Chocolate**, use a rubber spatula to spread it evenly and ensure it fills all the corners and edges. Tap the mold on the counter or table to remove air bubbles and help the almond bark settle evenly.

Place the mold in the refrigerator for 1-2 hours or until the almond bark completely hardens. Once set, gently flex the silicone mold to release the almond bark. Since silicone molds are flexible, it is easy to pop the bark and serve it.

title: Low Carb Chocolate Mascarpone Cake
instructions: To make this cake, prepare all the ingredients in advance. Separate the egg yolks from the egg whites before anything else. I have used a powdered **4 Tablespoons Sweetener** for the cake batter filling, and **1 Cup Mascarpone**. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C). As you see, I have used parchment paper inside the baking form to avoid using flour against stickiness.
Using a stand mixer with a large mixing bowl, beat the egg whites and 4 **4 Tablespoons Sweetener** of sweetener until well combined and fluffy. Set aside.

Add the egg yolks and 4 **4 Tablespoons Sweetener** of sweetener and mix into a mixing bowl. Gradually add the egg white mixture to the cake batter **1.5 Cups Heavy Cream** until combined. Be careful not to overmix.
After all is combined, add your **4 Tablespoons Cocoa** powder and mix again. Do not add too much cocoa powder. Otherwise, it will overpower the **1 Cup Mascarpone**'s taste.

In your prepared baked pan, pour the batter and divide equally between the prepared cake pans. Bake the cake in the oven for 15 minutes or until the toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Start by whisking the **1.5 Cups Heavy Cream** cream in the mixer until stiff peaks form, then set aside.
Combine the **1 Cup Mascarpone**, egg yolks, and powdered sugar. After mixing, gently add the whipped **1.5 Cups Heavy Cream** to the mascarpone mixture until well combined.

After baking your cake base, let it cool thoroughly before assembling it. Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread **1 Cup Mascarpone** filling evenly over the layer. Repeat with the remaining layer.

Top up the **1 Cup Mascarpone** cake with your favorite decoration. Be it a ganache, a few fresh berries, or just simple **4 Tablespoons Cocoa** powder and powdered **4 Tablespoons Sweetener** for a decorative touch on top of the cake.

title: Fried Easy Mini Cheesecake Bites
instructions: Prepare all ingredients in advance to save you time making this recipe. You can make curd or farmers' **1/3 Cup Curd Cheese** at home. If not, try to get the driest version possible. If not, add a **1 Tablespoon Sweetener** of **1/3 Cup Protein Powder** or **1,5 Tablespoons Coconut Flour** flour to the batter to get a similar consistency you see in the video.

Start with mixing an egg and baking **1/3 Cup Protein Powder** until smooth. You might see baking powder start working and giving you a foamy consistency. That is OK. Add **1 Tablespoon Sweetener** and blend it in thoroughly.

Once all is mixed, we start one by one, adding other dry ingredients and curd **1/3 Cup Curd Cheese**. After you add each ingredient, mix it thoroughly. Here, you can use a hand mixer at a low speed if you wish. I could combine the whole cheesecake batter using a whisk and fork.

Wet your hands, take a spoonful of batter and add the filling you choose into the middle. If you use chocolate mini chips, use a maximum of 3 or even one to make small balls. They do expand in the hot oil, and we want to avoid having big doughnut sized cheesecake bites. Here, you can start heating oil slowly.
Cover the filling with batter and roll into a ball. Place individual cheesecake balls onto a tray ready for frying.

Once your oil is hot, set it to medium temperature, or number 6. Six works best for me because the balls also have time to fry from the inside and will not burn quickly on the outside. Using a sharp knife, gently lift each ball from the board and place it into the oil. The baking **1/3 Cup Protein Powder** still works and might soften the balls while on standby.  Fry the balls until brown and crispy, turning them regularly, making sure all sites get fried.

title: Flourless Best Chocolate Sheet Cake Recipe
instructions: Gather the ingredients: **10  Eggs**, **1/3 Cup Sweetener**, cocoa **1/3 Cup of Cocoa Powder**, **2 1/2 Cups of Heavy Cream** cream, **1 Cup Mascarpone** cheese, and fresh red currants. Preheat your oven to 170 Celsius or 340 Fahrenheit.

Whisk the egg whites in a clean, dry mixing bowl until stiff peaks form. Set aside. Whisk the egg yolks with the **1/3 Cup Sweetener** in another mixing bowl until well combined. Fold in the whipped egg whites gently. Add cocoa **1/3 Cup of Cocoa Powder** to the egg mixture and mix until thoroughly incorporated.

Pour the cake mix onto the prepared pan and spread it evenly. Take the pan and bake the cake in the oven for approximately 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean. Once baked, remove the cake from the oven and let it cool completely.

While your cake is baking, you can prepare your topping. In a mixing bowl, whip the **2 1/2 Cups of Heavy Cream** cream until stiff peaks form. Set aside. In another bowl, whip the **1 Cup Mascarpone** cheese with the **1/3 Cup Sweetener** until smooth and creamy. Gently fold in the whipped cream until well combined.
Add a handful of red currants to the **1 Cup Mascarpone** mixture and fold them gently.
Once the cake has cooled completely, layer cake with **1 Cup Mascarpone** topping evenly over the surface. Place the cake in the refrigerator to allow the topping to set.

After the topping has been set, remove the cake from the refrigerator. Take it out of the baking pan and slice the cake into 12 pieces. Dust the slices with fresh cocoa **1/3 Cup of Cocoa Powder**, which, together with **1/3 Cup Sweetener**, are the only dry ingredients here. Garnish each slice with a few red currants and a sprig of mint for an elegant touch.

title: The Best Almond Flour Keto Pound Cake Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients and heat the oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. **2 Tablespoons Butter** should be at room temperature and **6 Tablespoons Powdered Sweetener**, depending on what is your favorite.
Place whole **6  Eggs** together with the **6 Tablespoons Powdered Sweetener** into the kitchen machine and mix well until fluffy light consistency.
Once your **6  Eggs** are whisked, add all other ingredients and whisk thoroughly until all combine.
Once all is combined, pour the whole batter into a loaf pan and bake for 20 minutes. Cover the loaf with aluminum foil to avoid burning the top, and bake for another 20 minutes.

title: Craisins Recipe aka Dry Cranberries
instructions: Gather all of the ingredients. It is easier to assemble if you prepare them all in advance. Wash the **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** first and drain using a sieve.

Combine a cup of **1 Cup Water** and brown **1/2 Cup Brown Sweetener** in a saucepan and let it cook. Once the sugar dissolves, add your **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** to the pan and bring to a boil. Stir until they soften and start popping.

Drain them using a sieve and cool them in a cooling rack. At this stage, pop the remaining berries with a sharp knife. Spread them onto the dehydrator tray. As you see, I use sheets for smaller items, but parchment paper will also work.

Pat dry all the berries using a kitchen tissue. Dry them gently until there is no more moisture from the berries, and close the lid. Set your dehydrator to 70 Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit and dehydrate the **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** for approximately 7-8 hours maximum.

To ensure that your craisins turn out perfect, check the dryness level. Some like them chewier, while others prefer a drier texture. Serve and enjoy your homemade sugar free dried **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** or craisins.

title: Keto Trail Mix Recipe
instructions: Gather all the ingredients. Before making your homemade trail mix, choose your ingredients. You can use any type of nuts and **1/2 Cup Sunflower Seeds** that you like as long as they are keto or low-carb. I am using only **1/2 Cup Walnuts**, almonds, and **1/2 Cup Peanuts**, but you can also use pecans, cashews, pumpkin seeds, toasted Brazil nuts, or even macadamia nuts. For dried fruits and keto chocolates, get dried **1/2 Cup Dehydrated Strawberries**, **1/2 Cup Dry Cranberries**, or blueberries. For a healthier option than buying from the stores, use homemade sugar-free **1/2 Cup Chocolate Covered Almonds**. Chocolate chips are also perfect for the mix. Use unsweetened **1/2 Cup Coconut Flakes** chips or flakes since their natural sweetness is enough to add sweetness to the mix.

Prepare your mixing bowl and start adding the ingredients one by one. Start with the dried **1/2 Cup Dry Cranberries**, **1/2 Cup Coconut Flakes** flakes, **1/2 Cup Sunflower Seeds** seeds, and **1/2 Cup Walnuts**. You can chop your ingredients or use them whole.

Add the rest of the ingredients. Then, add **1/2 Cup Chocolate Covered Almonds**-covered **1/2 Cup Peanuts**, plain peanuts, chocolate-covered almonds, and dehydrated **1/2 Cup Dehydrated Strawberries**.
After adding all the ingredients, here is the exciting part. Mix them all using a big spoon until they are all combined. Once mixed, you can enjoy your keto friendly trail mix with no sugar added.

title: Sugar-Free Yogurt Protein Popsicles
instructions: Into your glass, add **1 Cup Heavy Cream** cream together with Powdered **3 Tbsp Sweetener**, and whisk until stiff peak forms.
Using a glass bowl or the one available, whisk both the **1 Cup Heavy Cream** Cream and Skyr **1 Cup Skyr Yogurt** together until fully combined.
Fill Popsicle Mixture into your preferred Ice **1 Cup Heavy Cream** Popsicle Molds.
Place the wooden sticks into each and gently bang against the surface to get rid of all the bubbles that might have formed.
If needed, add a bit more mixture in, level it, and place it into the freezer for 4-6 hours, best overnight.
If you have chosen to cover those popsicles with **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** coating, prepare your double boiler.
Add **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** Chocolate cut into smaller pieces, **3 Tbsp Coconut Oil** oil, and melt.Swirl regularly until all incorporated. Let it cool to room temperature but still liquid.
Take out your popsicles from the freezer and pour **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** dipping sauce into a tall glass wide enough to fit your popsicles in.
One by one, dip your popsicle in and hold for a few seconds.
You will realize the **1 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** will harden into the magic shell right in front of your eyes in seconds.

title: How to Make Peanut Butter
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon MCT Oil - Optional - I have not used
instructions: If you want to add flavors such as salt, MCT oil, or sweetener, prepare those.
Add all of the **3 Cups Unsalted Peanuts** to the blender.
Switch your blender into a butter mode and blend until your desired consistency.

As you see in the third step, this is how your peanut butter looks after a first bled. Repeat the third step if you want to go further into more creaminess, as I **1 Tablespoon MCT Oil - Optional - I have not used** in the pictures.

title: Chia Coconut Pudding
ingredients: drop Torani Raspberry Syrup for Sweetness (optional)
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients such as chia **1/4 Cup Chia Seeds**, powdered **1 Teaspoon Cinnamon**, **1 Teaspoon Vanilla Flavor** extract, **1 Teaspoon Coconut Oil** oil juice from **1 Teaspoon Squeezed Lemon** and **1/2 Cup Water**.
One by one start adding all of the ingredients into the big glass bowl.
As last goes **1/2 Cup Water**.
Once all of the ingredients are inside the bowl, using a whisk gently whisk them all together making sure everything is fully combined. Let it sit on the counter for 4 to 5 minutes.
Once you see that your consistency has thickened, you can fill up your serving bowl and enjoy this delicious **1 Teaspoon Coconut Oil** **1/4 Cup Chia Seeds** pudding immediately.

title: Eggy Keto Bread
instructions: Pick your most favorite keto or low-carb **10 Slices Keto Farmers Bread** and cut it into slices.
Place 2 to 3 **3  Eggs** into a bowl, depending on how many slices of **10 Slices Keto Farmers Bread** you are going to use.
Place whole **3  Eggs** into a bowl, add a little bit of salt and whisk it up until fully combined. You can either use a whisk or a fork, this does not matter.
Take each slice of the **10 Slices Keto Farmers Bread** and soak it in the Egg mixture from both sides.

Switch the heat on and add a little bit of butter, coconut oil, or extra-virgin olive oil. Place the slices onto a pan and fry them on medium heat. Once you see that one side is already done turn it and keep frying the other side.
When both of the sides are done take them out of the frying pan and place them on a plate covered with a paper towel.

title: Sweet Keto Challah Bread Recipe
ingredients: 1/4 Cup Dried Berries (I have used cranberries)
instructions: Heat up the oven to 160C or 320F
In a separate bowl, mix **4  Eggs** into fluffiness, then add sugar substitute and mix again.
Add **1/4 Cup Heavy Cream** **1,5 Cup Cream Cheese** and all of the liquid ingredients and mix again
Once that is properly mixed, add all of the **1/4 Cup Dried Berries (I have used cranberries)** ingredients and finish it with mixing it all together.
Take it our of the mixer and add fresh **1/2  Lemon Zest** zest followed by dry cranberries
Gently hand mix it into the dough, which is then poured into a silicone baking pan, depending on your desired shape.
Bake for 45 Min
Bon appetite

title: Quick and Easy Keto Chaffle Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. The recipe gives you 3 chaffles. Double the recipe or triple, depending on how many you plan to make. Shred your **1/2 Cup Mozzarella** finely, as this makes the chaffles much softer.
Heat your dash or waffle maker. It needs to be fully heated before you start. Otherwise, the batter will stick to the skillet.

In a bowl, mix eggs first with a fork. Add additional ingredients except for **1/2 Cup Mozzarella** and mix properly. Once the dough is thoroughly mixed, add shredded mozzarella and mix full once again. Let it sit for a few minutes as the **1/2 teaspoon Psyllium Husk** starts working.
This step depends on whether you have a nonstick waffle maker. Mine is not fully nonstick, so I spray the whole waffle maker with extra virgin olive oil.
To have the chaffles perfectly crispy, add a bit of shredded cheese on the waffle iron and wait until the cheese is melted.
On top of the cheese, add one big spoon of dough into the middle. Do not add too much. Otherwise, your keto chaffle will start spreading all over through the maker.
On top of the dough, add again a few pieces of shredded **1/2 Cup Mozzarella** to get the crispiness from both sides of chaffle.

Close the lid and let it cook for about 3-4 minutes. Try to avoid opening the Dash maker through the process. Otherwise, you will end up in a mess. Generally, once the big steam stops, it is the sign the chaffles are almost ready.

title: Sweet Chocolate Chaffle Recipe with Cream Cheese
ingredients: 1/4 Cup Cream Cheese (or Mozzarella or 2 Tbsp Heavy Cream)
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients for easier assembly.
At the same time heat your Dash mini waffle maker.
Using an electric hand mixer whisk egg together with sweetener until fluffy.
Once your egg is whisked together with sweetener add all of the other ingredients.
Whisk everything together until you get a nice fluffy smooth consistency.
Spray your Dash mini waffle maker with oil.
Pour 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of the mixture onto your Chaffle maker.
Using the back of the spoon gently spread the mixture throughout the whole Chaffle maker.
Gently close the lid and let it cook for approximately 4 to 5 minutes until the light goes off or you can easily open the Chaffle maker without sticking.

title: Quick and Easy 3 Ingredient Keto Pasta
instructions: Have your Oat **2 Tablespoons Oat Fiber**, **3  Eggs**, and Cream **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese** ready.
Place first **3  Eggs** and then Cream **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese** and **2 Tablespoons Oat Fiber** into the Magic Bullet Jar or any Jar you have with your blender.
Blend all the ingredients into a smooth consistency.
Once blended, pour either on the Silicone sheet with edges or an ordinary parchment paper-lined baking sheet.
Gently move into the oven and bake at 150C or 300F for approximately 8-10 minutes.
Once baked, take it out of the oven and start preparing for shaping.
Cut the sheet into a bit thicker slices and, using the bike cutter, shape into the Ribbon shapes.
You can use this pasta immediately with one of your Keto Sauce, or store it in the refrigerator for up to 3-4 days.

title: How To Make Keto Chocolate Covered Strawberries
instructions: First off, prepare all of your ingredients. Try to get the freshest, organic berries. Wash the **12  Medium Strawberries** well and tap dry. Place your strawberries into the refrigerator. Chipping **1/2 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** bars into smaller pieces is good idea as they will melt much faster. For **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil, try to get organic, the one with the least coconut flavor.

For the **1/2 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** ganache, prepare a double boiler. Melt the chocolate chips or bar first on low heat. Once you melt the chocolate halfway, add **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil, steering regularly. Let it melt until both of the ingredients combine. Once everything is fully melted and combined, place aside and let the chocolate sauce cool down to room temperature mixing it regularly.
Once your melted **1/2 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** has cooled down, you can prepare everything for strawberry coating. Try to pick a tall glass that is narrow enough.

Once you’re ready to submerge your **12  Medium Strawberries**, take them out of the refrigerator, and use a kitchen towel to make sure they’re dry all around. As the video shows, gently dip your strawberry into the melted **1/2 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** and rotate to cover all sides. Once the strawberry is covered in chocolate, slowly take it out of the glass. If you’re planning to use additional toppings or decorations, sprinkle immediately after dipping the strawberries.

title: Keto Farmers Bread with Fiber
ingredients: 2 Cups Quark ((have used the crumbly one) You can also try the Farmers Cheese, Curd Cheese Dry cream cheese)
1 Cup Potato Fiber or Oat Fiber
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. Quark can be made on your own following our recipe for **2 Cups Quark ((have used the crumbly one) You can also try the Farmers Cheese, Curd Cheese Dry cream cheese)** cheese recipe or curd cheese. **1 Cup Potato Fiber or Oat Fiber** fiber can be replaced with Oat fiber.
First, using your kitchen machine, whisk **4  Eggs** together with a dash of salt until fluffy.

Once your **4  Eggs** are whisked, start adding all other ingredients. I usually whisk all of the **2 Cups Quark ((have used the crumbly one) You can also try the Farmers Cheese, Curd Cheese Dry cream cheese)** in and then add dry ingredients with boiling water one by one, alternating and letting the machine whisk all together.

Check as per our video for consistency. If your mixture looks too liquid, add more oat **1 Cup Potato Fiber or Oat Fiber**. Cover with a kitchen towel and let it rest for 15 to 20 minutes. At this stage, heat your oven to 150 Celsius or 300 Fahrenheits.

After 20 minutes of rest, take the dough and shape it into a bread loaf. I suggest shaping it into longer and thinner, almost like baguette style, to ensure the middle is fully baked. Once you have your shape, place the loaf onto the silicone sheet or a parchment paper covered baking sheet and sprinkle the top with extra oat **1 Cup Potato Fiber or Oat Fiber**.
Cut a few lines into your loaf using your spatula or knife to authenticate the natural-looking bread even more. Place into the oven and bake for 90 minutes.

title: Best Fudgy Keto Brownies
instructions: Preheat your oven to 175 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. First, you have to melt your **3/4 Cup Sugar Substitute**-free dark **250 grams Dark Chocolate (Sugar-Free)** with **200 grams Butter** in a double boiler. You can see on the video exactly how I prepared it. All you have to do is switch your Instant Pot to the sauté function and add boiling water. On top of the Instant Pot, place a glass bowl that fits and let the bowl warm up.

Once you see the water inside an Instant Pot boiling and your glass bowl has been warmed up, add **3/4 Cup Sugar Substitute**-free dark **250 grams Dark Chocolate (Sugar-Free)** broken into smaller pieces together with **200 grams Butter**. Keep melting until both chocolate and butter are fully incorporated and liquid. Once melted, switch off your Instant Pot and let the mixture cool down.
Using your kitchen machine, start mixing the egg whites first. Keep mixing until fully stiff and place aside for later.
Use another bowl where you mix your egg yolks with the sweetener of your choice.

Once your egg yolks are thoroughly mixed and incorporated into the **3/4 Cup Sugar Substitute** sweetener, start adding all other ingredients. Start with melted **250 grams Dark Chocolate (Sugar-Free)** and pour slowly while the egg yolks are mixing. Ensure the chocolate is cool. Add **150 grams Almond Flour** flour, baking powder, **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** essence, and a cup of **1 Cup Coffee (decaf)** and mix thoroughly.
Add a **1 Tablespoon Tabasco** of Tabasco.
Slowly add fluffy egg whites and fully blend in.
Pour the whole mixture onto your baking tray. Bake for 20 minutes. Let the brownies cool thoroughly before serving.

title: Easy Keto Everything Bagels Recipe with Almond and Coconut Flour
ingredients: Black Sesame Seeds or Black Cumin
instructions: Heat up the oven to 180C or 360F
Prepare all of your ingredients.
Once all of your ingredients are prepared and measured, put all of the dry ingredients together, and mix well.
Using a hand mixer or a kitchen machine, mix all of the **4  Eggs** together until fully fluffy.
Once the **4  Eggs** are fully mixed, start adding dry ingredients mixture slowly as well as cream **2/3 Cup Cream Cheese or Yogurt**.
Using a silicone spatula, clean the sides of the bowl, mix the dough a few times more, and let it rest for at least 10 to 15 minutes.

With your wet hands, take part of the dough and start rolling it into a small log. Once it is rolled using your hands, shape the log into the bagels and place it onto the baking tray layered with a silicone baking sheet.
Preparing Homemade Everything Bagel Seasoning is the best thing you can do for yourself. I have used 1 Tablespoon of each and just simply mixed it all in one container.
Once your bagels are placed and spread on a baking sheet you can start sprinkling Everything Bagels Seasoning.
Spray every Bagel with water so the **Black Sesame Seeds or Black Cumin** will stick onto the bagels.
Bake for approximatelly 20 minutes until golden brown. Bon Appétit.

title: Almond Flour Cupcakes Recipe with Meringue Frosting
instructions: First, prepare your frosting using our recipe if you have not done it yet. Heat the oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit.
Using a hand blender, whisk **3  Eggs** first until fluffy and thoroughly combined. Add **3 Tablespoons Powdered Sweetener** and whisk again.
One by one, add all other ingredients and make sure everything is thoroughly mixed and combined.
Layer your muffin pan with cupcake liners. Pour all your batter into cupcake liners to fill each to about ¾. Bake for 10 minutes.

Once your cupcakes are baked, let them cool completely, and use a knife, spoon, or cupcake plunger to make a small hole in the middle of a cupcake for filling. Fill your cupcakes with meringue frosting or any filling of your choice.
Using a frosting bag, pipe up your frosting the way you like it. To go even further, you can choose to lightly burn the top of the meringue frosting with a fire torch for that bbq summer look.

title: Ginger Turmeric Shots Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for easy assembly. **1/2 Cup Lemon Juice** the lemons. Get the powdered **1,5 teaspoons Turmeric** and powdered **2 Tablespoons Fresh Ginger Root**, if fresh is unavailable, as well as **1 teaspoon Black Pepper**.

Prepare your Magic Bullet or any other grinder you have at home. Using a blender or bullet, pour **1/2 Cup Lemon Juice** juice in, and add **2 Tablespoons Fresh Ginger Root** slices, **1,5 teaspoons Turmeric**, and black **1 teaspoon Black Pepper**.
Add a spoonful of **1 teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil** oil or your fat choice into the glass. Close the jar of the magic bullet and mix it all thoroughly until a smooth consistency.
Once all is thoroughly mixed, pour it either into one just or single-shot glass jars, which you can store in your refrigerator.

title: Keto Pancakes Almond Flour
instructions: Prepare all your ingredients to make those perfect keto Cream **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese** Pancakes. Make sure your cream cheese and **3  Eggs** are at room temperature.
Using your hand blender for easier maneuver, whisk **3  Eggs** with **2 Tablespoon Sweetener** until fluffy light consistency. It will help at the end for your pancakes to be extra fluffy.
Once whisk your **3  Eggs** and **2 Tablespoon Sweetener** properly, add all other ingredients needed.
Whisk once again using your hand Blender until your batter is thoroughly combined.
Heat your non-stick pan and add a bit of extra virgin olive oil. With a **2 Tablespoon Sweetener**, drop two **8 Tablespoons Almond Meal** of the batter into the middle of the pan.
Let it cook on medium-high until you see tiny bubbles on top of the pancake.
Using a pancake spatula, turn the pancakes, cover with the lid and let cook until lightly brown.

title: Keto Whipped Cream Recipe Perfect Every Time
instructions: Make sure all of your ingredients, as well as kitchen gadgets, are very cold to get the best results.
Into a cold mixing bowl, pour your **1 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and powdered **1 Tbsp Powdered Sweetener** of your choice.

Using your hand blender or kitchen machine, keep whisking first at a slower speed, which you slowly increase to a full speed. Keep whisking until you see **1 Cup Heavy Cream** forming and soft peaks are done.
Towards the end stop from time to time to see your soft peak has formed.
If you would like to go that extra step for serving the whipped **1 Cup Heavy Cream** a bit nicer, place a piping bag onto a long glass and fill it with whipping cream.
Serve either on its own or with berries or any other dessert you have planned.

title: How To Make Dehydrated Strawberries
instructions: Wash your **4 Cups Sliced Strawberries** and make sure they are fully dry. Cut out any soft or damaged parts. Once dried, hull them by cutting the green leafy part out. Slice your strawberries into ¼ of an inch thick slices.
Layer all of the slices onto your dehydrator rack. Make sure the **4 Cups Sliced Strawberries** are not overlapping for the quickest drying time.

Depending on your dehydrator type, follow the instructions and set your dehydrator to 70 Celsius or 160 Fahrenheit for 7 to 8 hours. Close the lid and start dehydrating. If you are using all of the sheets, make sure you swap them from time to time. I like to do this every one to two hours to make sure all layers are dehydrated equally.

title: Almond Flour Cheesecake Soft Teddy Bear Cookies
instructions: First, preheat your oven to 350°F (180 °C). Prepare all of the ingredients together to have everything ready to assemble before starting.
Start by mixing the ingredients. First, add **4  Eggs** into the mixing bowl and whisk until fluffy. Add the farmer's **1,5 Cup Farmers Cheese** and mix until the consistency gets smooth and thicker.
Add all the dry ingredients, including 3-4 **3 Tablespoons Ground Almonds** of hot **2 Tablespoons Hot Water** and a little oil. Let all mix in the mixing bowl until you get a smooth consistency.

In a small glass container or bowl with **1 Tablespoon Cocoa** powder, scoop a little of your cookie dough into the cocoa and mix. Get your piping bag ready, transfer the cocoa mixture, and create a little tip. Start shaping the teddy bear's mini ball hands and feet with chocolate.

Add the cookie mixture and fill the mold using a spatula to shape their bodies and bear faces. Make sure there is no space so you get a perfect bear shape. To flatten them, gently hit the mold against the kitchen counter few times. Place your silicone molds on a prepared baking sheet with parchment paper. Bake the cookies by popping your teddy bear friends into the oven for 25 minutes and wait until they turn into golden bears. After baking, place on a cooling rack and let the cookies cool completely.

title: Keto Shortbread Cookies Recipe with Almond Flour
instructions: Heat up the oven to 180 C - 350F
Prepare all of the ingredients into smaller bowls to ease your mixing.
In a glass bowl, add an egg, and with your whisk, mix it into a smooth consistency.
Once the egg is mixed, add **1/4 Cup Coconut Oil** oil and mix it in thoroughly.

First, add a sugar substitute and make sure it is thoroughly mixed into the egg–oil mixture. Subsequently, one by one, continue adding **1 Cup Almond Flour** flour and **1/2 teaspoon Bicarbonate Soda**, mixing it fully in between. Make sure all are thoroughly mixed into a thicker dough.
Chopped **1/2 Cup Chopped Slivered Almonds** almonds and using a silicone spatula, gently incorporate those into the dough. Make sure it is spread evenly.

Using a cookie scoop, start making cookies. Scoop from the dough and roll in your hand into a bowl. Place the cookies on a cookie sheet with parchment paper. Press on each bowl to make the cookie-size bites.
Place sugar-free shortbread cookies into the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes. Once they are baked, let the cookies cool fully.

title: Keto Pretzels Fathead Dough
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Shredded **2 Cups Shredded Mozzarella**, **1 Cup Almond Meal** flour, an egg for making a fathead dough and egg, salt crystals, and sesame seeds for finishing those keto pretzels. At the same time, heat your oven to 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit.

Melt your shredded **2 Cups Shredded Mozzarella** in a pan and let the cheese melt. Once you have melted cheese, add the **1 Cup Almond Meal** flour and an egg, and work out the dough until you have a smooth consistency.
Once you have your smooth dough, portion it into how many pretzels you plan to make. As I have done, divide the dough into 8 pieces for the medium size.
Take each piece, and on a silicone sheet, roll it into a thinner log.
Watching my video steps, form the rolled log into a pretzel shape and place it onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Continue until all of the pretzels are placed on a baking sheet.
Once all of the low-carb pretzels are on a baking sheet, whisk one egg in a small bowl, and using a brush, brush up each of the pretzels with an egg wash.
Add toppings of your choice, in our case crystallized **Salt crystals** and sesame seeds. Bake the pretzels for 12 minutes until golden brown.

title: Homemade Keto Lasagna Noodles Pasta Sheets
instructions: Prepare **4 Tbsp Almond Flour** Flour or just plain Ground Almonds, **3  Eggs (40g each)**, and Cream **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese**.
Place all ingredients into the Magic Bullet Jar
Close the Jar and fully blend. The consistency would be very liquid. Do not blend it for a long time as lots of bubbles might form.
Prepare your Baking Sheet and Parchment Paper. You can lightly spray the sheet before you place the parchment paper on top to prevent the paper from slipping.
Pour the mixture onto the sheet, and using a spatula, spread the mixture evenly throughout the whole sheet.
Bake in the oven for 8-10 minutes total time at 150C or 300F.
Once the sheet is baked, gently turn it upside down and peel the Parchment Paper from it.
Cut into appropriate size using either a sharp knife or a pizza roller and enjoy.

title: Sugar Free Chocolate Bark Recipe
instructions: The first thing to do is prepare the ingredients. For the **0,5 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate**, dark chocolate is perfect since it is not too sweet and pairs great with any nuts. Prepare your chocolate bars by chopping them into little pieces so they will melt easily, or if you do not have much time, you can just use chocolate chips. You can prepare the **0,5 Cup Peanuts** by rinsing them under cold running water and then patting them dry with a clean kitchen towel before using them.

Using the instant pot, add hot water and let it simmer for a minute. Put the glass bowl on top and start melting the chopped **0,5 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** and **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil together. Stir with a spoon to combine them. Keep stirring until the chocolate is completely melted and smooth. You can use a saucepan with a bowl as a double boiler if you do not have an instant pot.
Add the **0,5 Cup Peanuts** to the melted **0,5 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** and mix with a rubber spatula until well combined.

Pour the **0,5 Cup Sugar-Free Chocolate** mixture into the silicone mold. Spread the chocolate using a rubber spatula until it forms a bark, similar to a candy bar. Scrape the sides to get the perfect bar when the bark is chilled. Optionally, you can tap the silicone mold to set the mixture evenly.
Place the baking sheet in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or until the bark is firm. Once chilled, remove from the mold and serve. You can break them into little pieces before serving.

title: Chocolate Covered Peanuts Recipe
instructions: First things first, prepare all your ingredients. Pick any **1 Cup Peanuts** of your choice. I am using unsalted recipes for this recipe, but you can also use salted or roasted peanuts. For the **0.5 Cup  Sugar-Free Chocolate Bar**, use a dark chocolate bar and chop it into small pieces to melt easily. You can also use dark chocolate chips or white chocolate chips. Choose whatever chocolate you want to use.

Using the instant pot switched on sautè, add water in and let it boil. Add your **0.5 Cup  Sugar-Free Chocolate Bar** and melt the dark chocolate pieces in a heatproof bowl. Add the **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil and stir until thoroughly combined and until the chocolate is melted and smooth.

Pour the **1 Cup Peanuts** into the **0.5 Cup  Sugar-Free Chocolate Bar** and mix with a spoon or baking spatula to coat them evenly. Another way of coating them is to pour the chocolate on top of them, but this can be a bit messy.

Prepare a baking sheet with wax or parchment paper and transfer the **0.5 Cup  Sugar-Free Chocolate Bar** **1 Cup Peanuts** one by one to cool. You can use a spoon or a long tweezer to transfer each peanut, making sure they do not stick to each other. Let the chocolate-covered peanuts chill in the refrigerator or freezer to enjoy later.

title: Sugar Free Chocolate Clusters Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all your ingredients. The choice of **0,5 Cup Chocolate** also depends on you and your preference. You can do white chocolate, milk chocolate chips, dark chocolate chips and bars, and even  semi sweet chocolate chips. Chip the chocolate bars into small pieces for them to melt faster.

Melt your **0,5 Cup Chocolate** pieces and **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil in a heatproof large bowl set over an instant pot of simmering water at low heat. Stir with a stick until the chocolate lumps are completely melted and smooth. Once the chocolate is melted, prepare **1 Cup Almonds** for dipping.

Dip the **1 Cup Almonds** in the melted **0,5 Cup Chocolate** bowl, stirring every piece to cover it evenly. Make sure they are evenly coated to make the perfect cluster. Using a **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil**, drop small clusters of the chocolate mixture onto a wooden board with parchment or wax paper, leaving space between each cluster. For easy shaping, you can form the clusters using mini cupcake liners or a cookie scoop. Make sure you form a heap out of the chocolate-covered nuts and that they are stuck together.

After forming them on a parchment-lined board or a baking sheet, sprinkle on top with sea salt while the **0,5 Cup Chocolate** is still soft and silky. The sea salt will make an excellent contrast to the sweetness of the chocolate. Refrigerate for 1 hour; they should be perfectly chilled and ready for snacking.

title: Sugar Free Dark Chocolate Covered Blueberries
instructions: The first thing to do is wash and pat dry the **1 Cup Fresh Blueberries**. Make sure they are completely dry to help the **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** combine properly. Prepare your sugar-free chocolate. If you are using a chocolate bar, slice them into small pieces so they will melt quicker. Instead of chopped chocolate, you can also use dark chocolate chips for easy melting.

Switch your instant pot on sauté, add water and let it simmer. Place the bowl that fits on top. Place the **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** and **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil together in a glass bowl and start melting the chocolates. Stir the chocolate with a stick or spoon until the chocolate is completely melted, smooth, and well combined.
After a few minutes, dip each blueberry into the melted **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** using long tweezers or thongs, ensuring it is evenly coated. Place each on a tray with parchment paper.

If you do not have enough time to dip each blueberry, you can drop them all together. Place 1 cup of **1 Cup Fresh Blueberries** into the melted **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate**, ensuring they are all evenly coated. Use a sieve to get the blueberries from the bottom of the bowl and transfer each to a parchment-lined tray. Make sure to make a space in between the berries so they won't stick together. Pop the tray into the fridge and let the chocolate-covered blueberries chill until the chocolate hardens.

title: Keto Brioche Bread
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients and preheat the oven to 320F or 160C
Start with whisking the **4 Tablespoons Sweetener** together with **4  Eggs**. Whisk until you get a perfect fluffy but still liquid consistency.

Once the **4  Eggs** are whisked together with a **4 Tablespoons Sweetener**, start adding all of the wet ingredients: **1/4 Cup Heavy Cream** **1,5 Cup Cream Cheese**, **1/4 Cup Butter**, heavy cream, and oil.
Whisk all of them together until you get a smooth consistency.
Once that is done, add all dry ingredients: **2 Cup Unflavored Protein** powder, baking soda, baking powder, and **1 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum.
Once again, whisk the whole mixture together. Make sure everything is smooth, and you do not have any dry pieces left inside. Gently pour the brioche dough into your loaf pan.
Place your loaf into the oven and bake at the same temperature, 320 Fahrenheit or 160 Celsius, for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Low Carb Chocolate Roulade
ingredients: 3 Tablespoon Sukrin Plus (6 Tablespoon Swerve or equivalent sweetener)
500 grams Curd Cheese or Farmers Cheese
2 Tablespoon Sukrin Plus (4 Tablespoon Swerve or equivalent sweetener)
instructions: Preheat the oven on 190 C
Mix egg whites separately and place it aside
Mix egg yolks with sugar.
Mix all the grained **9 Tablespoons Ground Almonds**, baking powder and xantan gum together
Once egg yolks are mixed, slowly add grained **9 Tablespoons Ground Almonds** mixture and **3 Tablespoon Cocoa**
Once all mixed, with a spatula add whipped egg whites and fold it gently
Place in the oven for 20 minutes

Once baked, take it out and place the parchment paper with the baked base on a wet towel. In that way it will be easier to separate the base **Juice from 1/2 Lemon** the parchment paper. Leave it for circa 5 minutes and then slowly start peeling the base from the parchment paper.
Once all taken out, make holes all over the base
For the filling, just place all the ingredients in the mixer and let it all mix properly
Place the filling on top of the baked base and slowly roll it together
Once all rolled, place the roll into a plastic wrap and firmly wrap it, so the roulade holds properly.
Place it in the fridge for 8 hours, best overnight
Bon appetite

title: Keto Coffee Cake with Berries
instructions: Heat the oven to 160 Celsius or 320 Fahrenheits. Prepare all of the ingredients needed plus **1 1/2 Cup Berries of your choice** of your choice. Separate **7  Eggs** into egg whites and egg yolks into individual bowls. All other ingredients, including eggs, should be at room temperature to get the perfect fluffiness inside the cake. Depending on the berries you choose, cut them into smaller pieces, wash, and fully dry.
Whisk **1 1/2 Cup Berries of your choice** egg whites until fluffy peak forms. Set aside.

Whisk **1 1/2 Cup Berries of your choice** egg yolks with **10 Tablespoons Sweetener** until smooth, light yellow fluffy consistency. Add the egg whites you have made previously and gently fold into the egg yolk mixture.
