Once all the layers are poured and spread, place them one by one on top of each other onto **2 Cups Berries or fruit of your choice** dehydrator. Switch the dehydrator on for approximately eight hours. Swapping the layers from time to time is advisable so each rack will get fully dehydrated.

When your **2 Cups Berries or fruit of your choice** roll-ups are fully dehydrated, let them cool completely. To check, touch each fruit roll with your bare hands and ensure they are no longer sticky. Gently peel the fruit leather from either plastic, parchment paper or a silicone sheet.
The final step is to pre-cut your **2 Cups Berries or fruit of your choice** skin. You can either roll the whole sheet and, using your scissors, cut it into the desired size.

title: How To Make Cranberry Powder from Dehydrated Craisins
instructions: Prepare your cranberries. You can either use store-bought dried cranberries or make your own **2 Cups Craisins** as mentioned above.

Transfer your DIY **2 Cups Craisins** to the blender or food processor. You can also use a coffee grinder since it makes fine powder, but make sure your blender or grinder is completely dry so the powder won't clump. Blend on the lowest setting until you get a fine, dusty fruit powder from the cranberries.
Gently open the lid, and they are ready to be stored. Be careful when opening the lid because it is dusty. You can use a small spoon to transfer the powder to a container.

title: Easy Cheesy Keto Brussel Sprouts Casserole
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit

Clean your **Brussels sprout circa 30 pieces** sprouts by cutting the end of the buts and peeling the outer layer of the leaves. Wash and place into the boiling pot of water for approximately five minutes and immediately place them into the iced water.
In the meantime, add **3  Eggs** into a mixing bowl and whisk them properly. At the same time, add salt and pepper.
Once your **3  Eggs** are whisked, continue adding sour **1 Cup Sour Cream** and mix thoroughly
As the last ingredient, add your **200 grams Grated Cheese** cheese and ensure the whole mixture is smooth.
Depending on the size of your casserole dish, spread the **Brussels sprout circa 30 pieces** sprouts evenly around.
Gently pour the mixture onto the **Brussels sprout circa 30 pieces** sprouts covering them all.
Place into the oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes.
After your Keto casserole has been baked, take it out of the oven. Spread the rest of the **200 grams Grated Cheese** cheese on top.
Place again into the oven and bake for 10 minutes until the **200 grams Grated Cheese** becomes golden brown.

title: Easy Keto Peanut Butter Cheesecake Instant Pot
instructions: As we only have 4 Ingredients in the basic Keto Cheesecake, it is easy to put them together. If you plan to make the crunchy topping, add **1/2 Cup Brown Sugar Sub** **1/2 Cup Sweetener** and a bowl of **1/2 Cup Crushed Unsalted Peanuts**.
Place all 4 ingredients into the bowl and mix: **1 Cup Peanut Butter** butter, **2 Cups Yogurt**, **1/2 Cup Sweetener**, and **2  Eggs**.

Pour the whole mixture into the Springform pan (that fits into your Instant Pot) lined with parchment paper from the sides as well. This will help in cleaning afterward. As you see in the picture, I have made a base handle or a thick sheet from the aluminum foil (check video) to place the spring form into the instant pot easily and especially take out once everything is done and hot. Cover the top of the springform pan with aluminum and ensure no air can come in or out. This will prevent your **1 Cup Peanut Butter** butter cheesecake from becoming too dry and cracking.

Place your trivet into the Instant pot and add one cup of water. Gently place your spring form with an aluminum holder into the Instant Pot. Cover the lid and set your Instant Pot to pressure cook for 25 minutes on high pressure. Once done, take out of the Instant Pot, let it cool and place into the refrigerator to set fully, best overnight.

You can prepare the crunchy topping crumbles for your cheesecake if you would like. This is optional, and you can skip this step. Roast **1/2 Cup Crushed Unsalted Peanuts** peanuts on the stove. Add **1/2 Cup Brown Sugar Sub** Sugar **1/2 Cup Sweetener** and let it melt. Mix together and pour onto the parchment paper. Once cooled, break into small pieces to make **1 Cup Peanut Butter** crumbles.
Once you are ready to serve, take your cheesecake out of the fridge, and sprinkle it with **1 Cup Peanut Butter** crumble and dollops of **2 Cups Yogurt**. Open the spring form and serve.

title: Keto Chicken Nuggets
instructions: Before you start, gather all your ingredients and tools. Ensure you have your minced **1 Cup Chicken (Minced)**, **2 Pieces Eggs**, **1 Cup Breading** mix, a bowl, and a baking tray ready. This will make the process smooth and quick.

In one bowl, beat your **2 Pieces Eggs** for the wet coating, and in another, place your **1 Cup Breading** mix for the dry coating. You’ll mix the **1 Cup Chicken (Minced)** nuggets first into the egg, then into the breading to get a nice even layer. Make sure the breading fully coats each nugget.

Combine your minced **1 Cup Chicken (Minced)** with the beaten egg in a bowl, mixing until well incorporated. This will help bind the chicken and make sure the **1 Cup Breading** sticks better. It’s the base of your nugget mixture, so make sure it’s evenly mixed.

Shape the **1 Cup Chicken (Minced)** mixture into small nugget-sized portions and place them on a lined baking tray. Bake in the preheated oven at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 10 minutes, then flip and bake for another 10 minutes for even cooking. You’ll have perfectly crispy, golden nuggets ready in no time.

title: Extra Moist Chocolate Zucchini Cake Recipe
instructions: Gather all the necessary ingredients, ensuring you squeeze **1/2 Cup Shredded Zucchini** before adding to the batter to prevent a watery cake. At the same time, heat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius or 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the **4  Eggs** and **1/4 Cup Sweetener** using a kitchen machine until well combined and fluffy.

Mix all the dry ingredients in a glass bowl - **1/2 Cup Almond **1/4 Cup Coconut Flour**** flour, **1/4 Cup Coconut Oil** flour, baking powder, and **1/4 Cup Cocoa**. Add **1/4 Cup Lemon Zest** zest for a burst of flavor. Gradually add this dry mixture to the **4  Eggs**, creating a smooth cake batter.

Fold in the **1/2 Cup Shredded Zucchini** with **1/4 Cup Coconut Oil** oil, making sure you distribute it evenly. Pour the batter into a prepared pan and bake the cake for 30 to 35 minutes in a preheated oven until a toothpick inserted comes out clean.

While the cake is baking, prepare the frosting using a hand immersion blender. Let the cake cool completely and spread the frosting evenly on top, and for a decorative touch, use an icing bag to create swirls or patterns. Finish by sprinkling freshly made **1/4 Cup Lemon Zest** zest on top for a delightful zestiness.

title: Baked Keto Chicken Wings
instructions: Before you start, ensure you have all your ingredients, including fresh **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings, avocado oil, and seasonings like **1/2 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic**, **1/2 Tablespoon Onion Powder** **1/2 teaspoon Chilli Powder**, **1/2 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika**, and **1 teaspoon Turmeric Powder**. Having everything ready will make the process smooth and easy. Don’t forget to prepare your baking tray with parchment paper for easy cleanup.

Whisk together the **1/2 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** garlic, **1/2 Tablespoon Onion Powder** **1/2 teaspoon Chilli Powder**, smoked **1/2 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika**, **1 teaspoon Turmeric Powder** powder, **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1 teaspoon Pepper**, chili powder, and avocado oil in a bowl. This will create a flavorful seasoning blend to coat the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings. Ensure all the seasonings are evenly distributed in the oil to give every wing that perfect flavor.

Take your **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings and brush each one generously with the seasoned oil mixture. Be sure to coat the wings evenly on both sides so that every bite is bursting with flavor. This step is key to getting that crispy, golden texture when baking.

Once the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** are coated, sprinkle a generous amount of **1/4 Cup Parmesan Cheese** cheese over the top. Then, place the wings on a baking rack set on a baking tray and bake at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 40 minutes, flipping halfway. This will make the wings crispy and golden with a cheesy, savory finish.

title: Low Carb Tuna Salad
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients.
Using a big mixing bowl, add **1  Tuna Can** in. Separate into small pieces and add **Half Onion**,  **1  Fresh Cucumber Small**, and cheese.
Finish up with squeezed **1/2  Lemon** and **2 Teaspoons Caviar**. Add caviar as last to avoid smashing. If you have used **1  Tuna Can** in water, add olive oil as well.
Gently mix all together and enjoy.

title: DIY Dry Ranch Seasoning
instructions: Gather all the ingredients and tools you’ll need before starting. Be sure to have a mixing bowl, whisk, and each seasoning pre-measured. Prepping everything first keeps the process quick and stress-free.

Add the **1/4 Cup Buttermilk Powder** powder and **1 Tablespoon Dried Parsley** **1 Tablespoon Dried Chives** to your mixing bowl. These two ingredients add creaminess and a fresh, herby flavor to your low-carb ranch base. Mixing them first helps create a smooth foundation for the rest.

Now, toss in the **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** garlic, garlic **1/4 Cup Buttermilk Powder**, black **1 Teaspoon Black Pepper**, dried **1 Tablespoon Dried Parsley**, and dried **1 Tablespoon Dried Dill**. These herbs and spices create that classic ranch flavor you know and love. Double-check that all the ingredients are in before moving on.

Use your whisk to mix everything until the seasoning is fully combined. Make sure there are no clumps and the blend looks uniform. Your DIY dry ranch seasoning is now ready to sprinkle on meats and veggies or make into ranch dips.

title: Tomato Powder Recipe
instructions: If your **2 Cups Tomatoes (Sliced)** are ready, ensure they are washed and cleaned before slicing them. You can use any type of tomato you want as long as they are fresh. Roma tomatoes are perfect, and even cherry tomatoes will do. Use a sharp knife to slice the tomato pieces, including the tomato skins, into thin slices for that extra fiber.

Spray the dehydrator trays with **1 teaspoon Olive Oil (Extra Virgin)** oil and spread the tomato slices onto them, making sure all are single-layered for the best drying result. You can optionally use an oven for this process, but make sure to attach parchment paper to the baking sheet before placing the **2 Cups Tomatoes (Sliced)** to prevent sticking. Set your dehydrator or oven to the lowest temperature and dehydrate the tomatoes for 5 to 7 hours. You can change the trays for uniform drying every 2 hours or less.

Once the **2 Cups Tomatoes (Sliced)** are completely dried, let them cool for a few minutes and grind them into a fine powder. You can use any gadget for grinding, such as a coffee grinder, normal blender or food processor.

After making a fine powder out of your dried tomato pieces, check their fineness using a tablespoon if there are still tomato bits left. If they are perfectly blended, they are ready for use and storage.

title: Chinese Five Spice Powder Recipe
instructions: Start by preparing all of the spices needed for the recipe. If you can, grow and dry them at home and powder them when you want to use them. But if impossible, try to get the freshest and best-quality ingredients, preferably organic and whole pieces.
Get your mortar and pestle ready. Place all the spices and break them to release the flavors. It is an excellent step to achieve better results before you powder them.

After breaking the ingredients, prepare the magic bullet or any spice grinder and transfer them in. You can also use a food processor or a coffee grinder for this step. Start crushing the spices into the magic bullet. Pulse the blender until all the spices are finely ground.
Once the spices are turned into a fine powder, transfer them into a glass container. Serve and use in your dishes and store them after.

title: How To Make Onion Powder
instructions: Pick your **2  Onions**. Fully clean all of the onions you are about to use. Peel the outer layer of skin and cut it in half. Cut out the stem and prepare your dehydrator.
Slice your **2  Onions** into flakes and separate each streak. Place slices of onion onto your dehydrator trays and dehydrate until fully dry.

Once **2  Onions** are dry, place them into your chosen gadget. You can also use a mortar and place the dried onions there. Pulsing dry onions in a food processor will give you nice tiny onion flakes. Letting the grinding process go further makes a perfect smooth powder out of the dehydrated onions.
Use immediately or store in your mason jars for later.

title: Homemade Chicken Powder Seasoning
instructions: For making a pure protein powder, all you need is **2 Cups Cooked Shredded Chicken**. I have used my recipe for making frozen chicken in an Instant Pot in 10 minutes, which you can follow.

Open your instant pot, place a rack and add one cup of water or broth. If you want to add some seasoning that goes well with **2 Cups Cooked Shredded Chicken**, you can do that now. Place your frozen chicken breasts into the Instant Pot. Close the lid, close the valve and set the pressure high for 10 minutes.

Shred the cooked **2 Cups Cooked Shredded Chicken** into small pieces using a fork or your hands. Place those on dehydrating trays and dry for 5 to 7 hours, depending on the size and thickness of your meat.
Once your **2 Cups Cooked Shredded Chicken** pieces are dehydrated, place them into the magic bullet, food processor, blender, or coffee grinder. Blend thoroughly until a smooth, dry powder forms.

title: Substitute for Curry Powder Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your spices. It would be best to have them all homegrown and dry and grind by you. But if not, try to get the freshest ingredients and as bio-quality as possible.

Start with **2 Tablespoons **1 teaspoon Ground black/white pepper** Turmeric**, which is one of the most important and gives you that beautiful color to the whole blend. Follow with **1 Tablespoon Garlic**, ground **1 Tablespoon Ground Cumin**, and **1 Tablespoon Ground Coriander**.
Continue with **1/2 Tablespoon Ground Ginger**, cardamom, **1 Teaspoon Nutmeg**, and **1 Teaspoon Fenugreek**.
Finish up by adding **1 teaspoon Clove**, **1 teaspoon Cinnamon**, **1 teaspoon Salt**, and black and white **1 teaspoon Ground black/white pepper**.
Using a spoon, mix all ingredients. Keep mixing until all of the spices blend into one another.

title: Homemade Mushroom Powder Seasoning
instructions: Gently clean all debris from each mushroom. Using a sharp knife, slice the **1 Cup Shiitake Mushrooms** into approximately half a millimeter or 1/4 of an inch thick slices.
Layer one by one all of the slices onto your dehydrating tray. Switch on the lowest temperature for approximately 5 to 7 hours.

Once all of your **1 Cup Shiitake Mushrooms** have been dried, let them fully cool. Place the dried **1 Cup Porcini Penny Bun** mushrooms, **1 Cup Champignons**, and shiitake into a Magic bullet, coffee grinder, blender, Vitamix, or a food processor. Blend and pulse a few times into smooth fine mushroom dust. Let the powder to settle, and open the lid. Transfer to an airtight container.

title: Granulated Garlic vs Garlic Powder
instructions: The first thing to do is to peel the whole cloves of **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** and wash them with clean water. Slice them into thin slices to dry them later in the dehydrator. They will dry faster if they are thinly sliced.

Prepare the dehydrator trays and attach a plastic silicone insert if possible so the chopped **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves** will be placed perfectly and not fall off. Spray a little **1  teaspoon Olive Oil** oil on the surface of the trays and spread it all around. Lay all the garlic slices on top of each other. Do not stack them on top of each other, as we do not want uneven drying. If you are preparing a large batch, use more trays. Close the lid, and dry at 70°C for 6-7 hours.

After drying the **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves**, prepare it for blending. Grind the dehydrated garlic slices by pulsing using the Magic Bullet Blender. Only press the blender fully if you want a finer consistency. Check if the size of the granules is okay. They should look like cornmeal but in garlic bits.

Follow the same process as I did for the granulated **10  Fresh Garlic Cloves**. Toss the dehydrated garlic slices into the blender and grind until powdered. Garlic powder has a finer consistency, so press that blender until fully powdered.

title: How To Make Garlic Powder
instructions: Pick your garlic. Fully clean all the garlic **10 Pieces Fresh Garlic Cloves** that you are using for this recipe. Peel each garlic clove and cut the base part at the bottom of the cloves, then prepare your dehydrator.

Slice the peeled **10 Pieces Fresh Garlic Cloves** cloves into thin slices and set aside. Attach a plastic silicone insert to the single-layer trays to hold the small slices while drying. Spray a small amount of **1 Teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil** oil and spread it around the tray. Place the garlic slices onto your dehydrator trays in a single layer and dehydrate for about 6 hours until garlic is dry fully.

Once the **10 Pieces Fresh Garlic Cloves** is completely dry, place it in your magic bullet or any of your chosen gadgets for grinding. Use a food processor or coffee grinder to make a fine powder. Mortar and pestle are also good options as they are used manually to grind food.
We want our **10 Pieces Fresh Garlic Cloves** powder to be smooth and fine, so ensure no coarse bits are left from the dehydrated garlic.

title: Keto Orange Chicken Air Fryer
instructions: Start by gathering all your ingredients so everything is within reach. This includes prepping your **1 Cup Orange Chicken Sauce** by cutting it into bite-sized pieces. Having everything ready makes the cooking process smooth and stress-free.

In one bowl, mix your dry coating ingredients, such as bread crumbs, **1 teaspoon Salt**, and black **1 teaspoon Black Pepper**. Whisk together an egg and **1 Tablespoon Heavy Cream** cream in another bowl to create a wet coating. These two coatings will help give your **1 Cup Orange Chicken Sauce** a golden, crispy crust.

Dip each **1 Cup Orange Chicken Sauce** **1 Piece Egg** into the wet coating first, then roll it in the dry mixture until evenly covered. Repeat for all pieces, ensuring no spots are left uncoated. This double coating helps lock in flavor and provides perfect crunch after cooking.

Place the coated **1 Cup Orange Chicken Sauce** pieces in your air fryer basket in a single layer. Lightly spray with **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil** oil to improve crispiness. Set the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) and cook for 10 minutes.

Flip the **1 Cup Orange Chicken Sauce** pieces and add 5-10 minutes of cooking to ensure they are evenly brown. Once cooked, pour hot homemade orange sauce into your crispy chicken to coat every **1 Piece Egg**. Sprinkle with **2 Tablespoons Sesame Seeds (garnish)** seeds and chopped green **3 Tablespoons Green Onions (garnish)** for a fresh finish.

title: Air Fryer Frozen Chicken Wings
instructions: Gather all your ingredients. Place the frozen wings in a large bowl, and prepare your **6  Chicken Wings (Frozen)** wings rub by measuring each seasoning, including the **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil, in small storage containers.

Place the frozen wings in a single layer and at the bottom of the air fryer basket and defrost at 200C or 400F internal temperature for 10 minutes until the **6  Chicken Wings (Frozen)** wings are thawed.
Once the **6  Chicken Wings (Frozen)** wings are defrosted, remove them and place them in a bowl. Drizzle the chicken wings with **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil.

Prepare the dry seasonings by mixing them all in a small container. Spread the seasoning onto the **6  Chicken Wings (Frozen)** wings and mix using tongs or using your bare hands. Make sure each chicken is evenly coated.

Place the seasoned **6  Chicken Wings (Frozen)** wings back into the air fryer baskets and cook for 8-10 minutes maximum. Do not forget to flip the wings for even cooking. After flipping the chicken wings, rub with the remaining seasoning using a kitchen brush. Place again for 5 more minutes cook time to get crispy skins.

title: Keto Coconut Ice Cream Recipe
instructions: With your choice of sugar **1 Cup Sugar Substitute**, whisk 2 cups of heavy **2 Cups Whipped Cream** until stiff peaks.
Add **1 Tablespoon Glycerin** to make it churn-free while freezing (if not using ice **2 Cups Whipped Cream** machine).
Add **1 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** to the low-carb ice creams to make the texture much creamier.
Add half the **4 Cups Coconut Milk** milk to the whipping **2 Cups Whipped Cream** and slowly mix it. Once mixed, add the rest of the milk and mix until all of the ingredients are combined.
You can pour the mix straight into your machine or a Cuisinart ice **2 Cups Whipped Cream** maker and let it run as instructed.
Serve this best ice **2 Cups Whipped Cream** right away and enjoy.

title: Easy Sugar-Free Eggnog Popsicles Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
Pour your **2 Cups Heavy Cream** cream with one tablespoon of powdered **3 Tablespoons Allulose Sweetener** into the tall glass container. Add **1 Teaspoon Vanilla Extract** extract.
Using your Hand Blender, whisk until stiff peak and place aside.
In another glass container, whisk egg whites until soft peaks. Place aside.
And a third glass jar with egg yolks and the rest of the powdered sugar. Whisk this super yummy combination until fluffy.
Using your spatula, gently fold all the 3 deliciousness into one triple delicious mixture.

Using your Popsicle Molds, start gently filling them all using your spoon or a spatula. As this mixture is very light, you might bang it against the kitchen counter to get rid of as many bubbles as possible.
Once all of your molds are filled, add into the middle of each popsicle a wooden stick.
Place into your freezer and freeze for 2-3 hours, best overnight.

You can dip a frozen Eggnog Popsicle into our Chocolate Magic Shell. Place it into a tall glass, which is wide enough for your popsicle to lightly be able to be dipped. Do not dip it into a hot chocolate mixture, as that might melt the popsicle.
You can also sprinkle the ends with pieces of almonds or our Homemade Keto Sprinkles.

title: Homemade Sugar-Free Keto Ice Cream Cones
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for easy preparation.

With regards to Whey Protein, you can either choose **1/4 Cup Unflavored Whey Protein**, where you have to add the sugar **1,5 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener** and vanilla extract or you can pick Vanilla Whey Protein, where those additional ingredients are included and therefore you can skip sweetener and vanilla.
Using your electric hand blender or mixer, place egg white in and whisk it until fluffy.

Once your egg whites are whisked, add sugar **1,5 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener** if you have not picked **Vanilla Extract** Whey **1/4 Cup Unflavored Whey Protein** and **1 Tbsp Heavy Cream** cream and whisk it again.
One by one keep adding all of the other ingredients except **1/4 Tsp Xanthan Gum** Gum and continue whisking until everything is fully combined.
As of last, **1/4 Tsp Xanthan Gum** Gum comes into the mixture. Whisk everything fully.
Heat your Pizzelle Maker. Slightly spray with oil and get ready for the Wafer making.
Add 1 tablespoon of batter into the middle of the iron, let it melt for few seconds, and press the pizzelle maker with slight pressure.
Gently lift the edges of the wafer making sure, nothing is stuck.
Using a wooden cone shaper or made on your own, wrap and shape the wafer around the cone shaper and let it cool slightly for about 2 to 3 minutes.
Let the wooden cone shaper inside the Wafer until you’re ready to move forward with the next ice **1 Tbsp Heavy Cream** cone.

title: Sugar Free Chocolate Peanut Clusters Recipe
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients. Try to select unsalted or lightly salted **1 Cup Peanuts** to have better control over the saltiness of the clusters. This allows you to balance the sweetness of the **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** coating. Set aside your peanuts and start chopping the chocolate into small pieces if you are using a bar. That way, it will be easier to melt them for the coating. You can use any chocolate you like.

Add water into your instant pot and switch to saute. Once the water starts cooking, place a glass bowl in it. Add the **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** with **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil and melt it all together. Stir with a stick until well combined, melted and smooth.

Once the **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** is melted, gently fold in the **1 Cup Peanuts**, ensuring they are evenly coated with the dark chocolate. You can stir it with a stick to combine them correctly for an even coating.

Prepare your mini cupcake liners or parchment-lined baking sheets and scoop the peanut mixture. Drop small clusters onto the cupcake liners using a spoon or a cookie scoop, forming bite-sized portions. Place the tray in the refrigerator until the clusters firm up, about 2 hours. Once set, you can enjoy your **1/2 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** and peanut snacks immediately.

title: Keto Taco Salad Bowl with Mexican Ground Beef
instructions: Prepare your ingredients to make an edible Keto Bowl for your Salad as the first step. If you would like to skip bowl making, you can just bear in mind that I have included the nutrition of the whole salad together with the bowl as well.

In a glass bowl, mix all 3 ingredients. Using a round shape Pizza Stone or a baking sheet covered with Parchment paper, gently spread the mixture into a rounded shape. Place into the oven and bake at 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit for approximately 10 minutes, just until the corners start browning.

While your **1/4 Cup Cheddar Cheese** bowl is baking in the oven, prepare 2 Bowls different sizes. Make sure the size is suitable to be able to place one bowl into another one. In the video, I have placed a smaller bowl on top of the Glass, so it is a little elevated. Gently spray smaller bowl from the outside and bigger bowl from the inside. Once your Keto Edible bowl is baked, take it from the oven, gently peel it from the parchment paper, and place it on top of the smaller bowl. Using your hands, gently shape and, using a bigger bowl, press on it to fully shape the bowl. Leave both bowls on top of each other with the Cheese edible bowl in the middle and let it cool down until the edible cheese bowl is hard and ready to be served.

Prepare all your ingredients for Low-Carb **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning** salad. Make sure your **1/2 Cup Chopped or Diced, Tomatoes**, **1/2 Cup Black Olives Sliced**, **1/2 Cup Avocado**, and onions are cut into smaller pieces.

Heat your skillet over medium-high, add oil, and cook the lean **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** beef for approximately 10-15 minutes. Once you see the color change and get brown ground beef, add taco **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning**, mix it thoroughly and let it cook for an additional 10 minutes.

As you see in the video, I have added first whole **2 Cups Shredded, Lettuce** leaves and then pre-cut lettuce to protect all the other moist ingredients such as **2 Tablespoons Taco Seasoning** **1 1/2 Cup Ground Beef** Beef or any dressing from softening the actual edible bowl. As next, add your Taco Mexican Ground beef, followed by **1/2 Cup Chopped or Diced, Tomatoes** and **1/4 Cup Chopped, Onion**.

Continue assembling, adding pieces of **1/2 Cup Avocado** and **1/2 Cup Black Olives Sliced**. Top it up with grated cheese. In our case, I have added **1/4 Cup Cheddar Cheese**. Sprinkle with Salsa Dressing if you like, or any of the toppings I have mentioned at the beginning of the post.

title: Keto Sausage Gravy
ingredients: 1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream
Spices - no need because they are already inside the sausage
instructions: First of all, prepare all of your ingredients. Regarding the **Spices - no need because they are already inside the sausage**, I have used our homemade keto sausage with sausage seasoning, and therefore there is no need to add any additional seasoning. Chop your **1/2  Onion** into small pieces, and prepare sour **1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream** and **2 Tablespoons Butter**.
Heat your saucepan over medium heat. Place **2 Tablespoons Butter** into your pot and let it melt.
Once the **2 Tablespoons Butter** is melted, add **1/2  Onion** and caramelize them until golden brown.

Depending on what type of **Spices - no need because they are already inside the sausage** you use, take the skin out and squeeze all mixtures into the pot. Start cooking the meat until the color changes, approximately 10-15 minutes.

Adding a thickening agent like **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum is the best to use at this step. Once you sprinkle Xanthan gum on the **Spices - no need because they are already inside the sausage**, mix it all.
Now it's time to add sour **1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream**. You can also use cream cheese or heavy cream if you wish to.

Mix all sour **1 Cup Sour Cream - can use heavy cream** into the **Spices - no need because they are already inside the sausage** and cook for another 4 to 5 minutes. Remember, the sauce will still thicken during the cooling process.

title: Korean BBQ Chicken Wings
instructions: Start by washing and patting dry the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings to ensure they are free of excess moisture. In a bowl, prepare your **1/2 Cup Korean BBQ Sauce** BBQ sauce.

Pour the **1/2 Cup Korean BBQ Sauce** into the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings**. Generously brush the chicken wings with the prepared BBQ sauce, making sure each **1 Piece Young Onion (chopped for garnish)** is evenly coated for maximum flavor. For extra flavor, you can even dip the chicken into the sauce for a thicker coating.

Cover the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings with plastic wrap and let them marinate in the fridge for 30 minutes to allow the flavors to infuse. The longer the wings marinate, the more intense the BBQ flavor. If you're short on time, you can skip marinating, but it will improve the flavor if done correctly. At the same time preheat oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit (200 degrees Celsius).

Line a baking sheet with parchment paper for easy cleanup. Place the **4 Pieces Chicken Wings** wings on the rack, making sure there is enough space between them for even cooking. Bake for 40 minutes, flipping halfway through, until the wings are crispy and golden brown.

title: Pumpkin Fries
instructions: Heat up the oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheits
Wash and clean the **1  Medium Size Pumpkin**
Cut it into half and clean out all of the seeds.
Cut the rest of the **1  Medium Size Pumpkin** into fries like slices. You do not have to peel the pumpkin. It will nicely soften in the oven

Optional: Soak the **1  Medium Size Pumpkin** fries in the water for overnight or if in a hurry half hour before baking. This will take **Extra Virgin Olive Oil** starch from Pumpkins and make them a bit crispier.
Optional: You can also boil it for 2-3 minutes to make them even crispier
Take the fries out of the water and dry properly
Once dried, place it in a bowl and sprinkle with **Extra Virgin Olive Oil** oil, salt, pepper and fresh parsley
Spread on a Baking sheet covered with Parchment paper
Place it into the oven and bake for approx 25 minutes

title: Sauerkraut Casserole Recipe with Ground Beef
instructions: Begin by gathering all your ingredients. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius (350 degrees Fahrenheit) so it's ready for your **3 Cups Sauerkraut** casserole.

To start building your casserole, use a brush to spread oil in a casserole dish lightly. Then, layer in 1 cup of **3 Cups Sauerkraut** at the bottom of a greased dish, **2 Cups Shredded Cheese** cheese, and **2 Cups Ground Beef** beef. These ingredients create a flavorful foundation for your dish.

Sprinkle finely chopped **5  Garlic Cloves**, salt, and **Salt & Pepper** over the first layer. Add another layer of **3 Cups Sauerkraut** to enhance the taste. Finally, cover everything with a smooth layer of sour **2 Cups Sour Cream**, which adds a delightful creamy touch.

For the finishing touch, sprinkle another layer of **2 Cups Shredded Cheese** on top. Cover the casserole with aluminum foil to keep the flavors in. Place it in the preheated oven and bake for about 45 minutes. This helps all the flavors meld together beautifully. You can take out the aluminum foil for the last 10 minutes and bake uncovered to get your cheese topping a nice crust.

title: Keto Chicken Bacon Ranch Casserole Recipe
instructions: First, preheat your oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit. Prepare all of your ingredients, such as pre-cooked **3  Cooked Chicken Breasts**, **1  Broccoli**, **2 Cups Grated Cheese** and crumbled **1 Cup Bacon** cut into small pieces or bacon bits. Ranch **2 Cups Ranch Dressing** is made using our recipe as it contains the least carbohydrates you can have.
Into a casserole of your choice, add the **1  Broccoli** as the base.
Onto the **1  Broccoli**, spread **3  Cooked Chicken Breasts** pieces.
Sprinkle in your **1 Cup Bacon** bits.
Add half of the ranch **2 Cups Ranch Dressing** and spread it all over the casserole.
Depending on the depth of your casserole, you can repeat the steps again.
On top of the casserole, lay all of your shredded **2 Cups Grated Cheese** and place it into the oven for 30 minutes.

title: Dill Pickle Dip
instructions: Gather all the ingredients you need and preheat the oven to 400° Fahrenheit (200° Celsius). Let the sour **2 Cups Sour Cream** soften a bit at room temperature for easier mixing. Prepping everything ahead of time keeps the process smooth and mess-free.

Add **1 Tablespoon Butter** and toast your **1/2 Cup Breadcrumbs** in a small pan over medium heat until golden and crisp. Stir them frequently to prevent burning. Set them aside once toasted, and they’ll add a delicious crunch on top of the dip.

In a large mixing bowl, combine the sour **2 Cups Sour Cream**, chopped dill **2 Cups Dill Pickles (Chopped)**, and seasonings. Stir everything together until it’s creamy and well mixed. This is where all the tangy dill pickle flavor comes to life.

Spoon the dip mixture into a small casserole or baking dish and spread it out evenly. Sprinkle the toasted **1/2 Cup Breadcrumbs** over the top for a crispy finish. You can also add a little extra shredded cheese if you like it extra cheesy.
In your preheated oven, bake the dip for 20 minutes. The top should be bubbly and golden when it’s ready. Serve warm with crackers, chips, or sliced veggies.

title: Homemade Sugar-Free Hot Chocolate Mix
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients for an easy mix. It is best to get the freshest ingredients you can.
In a mixing bowl, add all of the ingredients together and with a small whisk, mix them all until all of the ingredients mix fully, breaking all of the clumps you might have.
Place the rest of the mixture into a glass bottle or a mason jar and keep it in your pantry for later.
Pick one of your favorite nut milk alternatives and warm it up.
Pour your warm milk into a glass or self-stirring cup and add 1 **1 Tablespoon Cinnamon Powder** of the mixture.Mix it fully either with a small whisk, milk frother, or use the self-stirring cup.
Decorate with a bit of whipped cream on top and if you like, add a few of the keto marshmallows, sugar-free chocolate chips, or melted chocolate.

title: Keto Tortilla Recipe with 0 Net Carbs
instructions: Prepare your ingredients to make amazing keto and gluten-free tortillas. That is oat **10 Tablespoons Oat fiber**, **2  Eggs**, and mozzarella.
On your stove, heat up to mozzarella on medium heat. Using a wooden spoon, gently stir from time to time for all of the cheese to melt. Keep heating up until you have a smooth melted cheese.

Switch the heat off and add oat **10 Tablespoons Oat fiber**. Blend it in. Add **2  Eggs** and mix thoroughly. Keep mixing until you get a combined uniformed smooth dough. If you feel mozzarella needs to be melted again, switch the heat on low and keep blending.

Once you have the dough similar to my in the video, place it all on a silicone rolling sheet and using your hands keep working the dough. As you see on the video, I stretch and fold the dough several times. Keep stretching and folding until you get a really smooth consistency. The process might take somewhere between 5 to 8 minutes.

Once you are happy with the consistency, split your dough into 8 pieces. That is how many I managed to make. If you want to make smaller or larger tortillas, decide on the amount. Using a roller, roll one piece into a round flat sheet. Shape your tortillas using either a round, sharp bowl or anything similar. Place each wrap onto a baking sheet covered with parchment paper. At this time, you can heat the oven to 350 Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius. Once you have all the tortillas ready, place them into a preheated oven and bake the tortillas for 8 to 10 minutes until you see the edges starting to brown. I managed to fit 4 tortillas on each baking sheet.

title: Keto Fiber Tortillas Recipe
ingredients: Oat Fiber can be used as a replacement
instructions: Prepare a Fathead Dough. First, start melting the **2,5 Cups Shredded Mozzarella** cheese. Once that is fully melted add **Oat Fiber can be used as a replacement**, egg, and mix fully until all three ingredients are incorporated into one beautiful silky dough. (check Video)
Once the dough is fully mixed, place it onto the silicone mat and cut it into eight pieces.
Separate the dough into equal eight parts.
Once you have the dough separated, take one piece, and roll into a round shape. I like to use a small silicone roller but you can use a wooden one or just a wine bottle.
Roll the tortilla into the thinnest piece possible.
Once the dough is rolled into a round shape take one of the bowls you have at home in the shape and size you want your tortilla to be and press gently to make a perfectly round shape. (check Video)
After you have cut, sliced, rolled, and shaped your Keto Tortillas, gently place them onto a parchment paper.
Once all of the tortillas are rolled you can start getting ready for cooking them.
You can either place all of them into the oven( 200C° (400F) for about 10 to 12 minutes until slightly brown) which is also a choice, or cook them one by one on the stove.

title: Easy Keto Guacamole Dip with Sour Cream
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients.
Using a sharp knife, cut avocado lengthwise into half.
Scrape all of the **2  Avocados** into the bowl, where you will be mixing the whole avocado dip.
Mash all of the **2  Avocados** into as chunky as you like.
Immediately after your avocado is mashed, add your **1/2  Lime (Juice)** to prevent them from browning.
Followed with adding sour **1/4 Cup Sour Cream**, **2  Cherry Tomatoes** and Salt & **Salt & Pepper**
Using the same fork, mix all of the ingredients with mashed **2  Avocados**.

title: Crunchy Keto Muesli Granola Recipe
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 Celsius or 300 Fahrenheit
Cut the Whole **1 Cup Whole Walnuts** into smaller pieces
Mix all the dry ingredients
Mix one egg with a hand mixer and add it to the mixture
Add **2 Tbsp Coconut Oil** oil and mix everything properly.
Place it on a baking tray covered with a baking sheet and spread t he **1 Cup Whole Walnuts** mixture onto the tray.
Press it with your hands and place it into the oven for 25 minutes.
After they are baked, lower the oven temperature to 100 Celsius or 200 Fahrenheit, take out the tray and properly mix the granola and break it into smaller pieces
Once they are nicely spread on a tray, place it in the oven again for 35 minutes at a lower temperature to make them nice and crunchy.
Once done, let it cool, add dried **1/2 Cup Dried Berries** and enjoy.

title: Best Homemade Ground Beef Taco Meat Recipe
instructions: Prepare your **2 Cups Ground Beef** meat, in our case, it is ground beef.
Homemade Taco **4 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** can be made in minutes using our Recipe.
Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add a bit of Extra virgin Olive Oil.

Once your skillet is hot, add all the **2 Cups Ground Beef** beef and start cooking **4 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning** meat, mixing it from time to time until all the meat is fully brown. This should take approximately 10 - 15 minutes.
When your **2 Cups Ground Beef** beef is brown, switch the heat off and add homemade taco **4 Tablespoons Keto Taco Seasoning**.
Mix it all and you are done.

title: Almond Flour Keto Taco Shells
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius
Prepare all the ingredients.
Using a big Glass Bowl, add all ingredients one by one inside.
With a spatula, start gently mixing all the ingredients together.
Using your kid's compass or bowl with a pencil, make same size circles on a parchment paper.
Single layer all the **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese** mixture inside the circle, making sure no space in between is visible.
Using your hands, add or take out the **1 Cup Cheddar Cheese** mixture to have identically filled tacos.
Place into the oven and bake at 350 Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius for approximately 8 minutes.
Once you take tortillas out of the oven, using a spatula or your bare hands, take each of the shell and place on a prepared shaper.
Let them cool fully and take them out only once they have the shape and are cooled down.

title: Gluten Free Keto Taco Seasoning Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all of your ingredients or spices to be precise.
Using a bigger bowl, start adding all of the spices one by one into the bowl.
Start with **2 Tablespoons Chili Powder**, which is the highest in amount.
Add dry **1 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, **1 Tablespoon Dry Oregano**, smoked **1 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika** and **1 Tablespoon Cumin**.
Continue adding **1 Tablespoon Garlic Powder** **1 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, black **1 Teaspoon Black Pepper** and **1 Teaspoon Salt** as the last ingredient.
Using either a whisk or a spoon, start gently mixing and combining all of the spices for Taco seasoning.
Once fully combined, place into your spice jar, mason jar or any glass container, which you can fully close.

title: Keto Fried Chicken in Air Fryer
ingredients: 1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil (- spray)
instructions: Gather all your ingredients in one place, including **4 Pieces Chicken Leg Quarters** leg quarters, **2 Pieces Eggs**, **1/4 Cup Almond Flour** flour, **1 Cup Breadcrumbs**, and seasonings. This makes the process smoother and ensures you don’t miss anything while preparing. Make sure your air fryer is preheated to 430 Fahrenheit (220 Celsius).

In a dish, whisk together the **2 Pieces Eggs** for the wet coating. Combine the **1 Cup Breadcrumbs**, **1/4 Cup Almond Flour** flour, and seasonings like **1 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** **1/2 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, onion powder, smoked **1/2 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika**, **1 teaspoon Salt**, and **1 teaspoon Black Pepper** in another dish. This step ensures each coating is ready for a smooth and easy dipping process.

Dip the **4 Pieces Chicken Leg Quarters** leg quarters into the beaten **2 Pieces Eggs**, making sure they are fully coated. Then, coat the chicken in the dry **1 Cup Breadcrumbs** and **1/4 Cup Almond Flour** flour mixture, pressing lightly to ensure it sticks. Repeat for each piece of chicken, providing an even coating all around.

Spray a light coat of EVO oil inside the air fryer basket to prevent sticking and to help the **4 Pieces Chicken Leg Quarters** crisp up. Be sure not to over-spray, as too much oil can result in a greasy coating. The goal is a crisp, golden exterior.

Place the coated **4 Pieces Chicken Leg Quarters** leg quarters into the air fryer basket, ensuring they are not overcrowded. Set the air fryer to 430 Fahrenheit (220 Celsius) and cook the chicken for 15 minutes to crispy and golden brown. Flip the chicken halfway through and add 10 minutes more for even cooking on all sides.

title: Keto No Bake Blueberry Cheesecake
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients both for cheesecake filling as well as no-bake crust.

Starting with making a no-bake pie crust, place all of the nuts, **2 Tablespoons Coconut Oil**, **1 Tablespoon Cacao**, **4 Tablespoons Sweetener**, and coconut oil together with **1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice** juice into a food processor. Blend everything thoroughly until you get crumbled-like consistency.

Prepare a springform and cover the sides with parchment paper. Fill the base with a crumble mixture, and using your spatula or the back of the glass, push in for the crumble to set and form a perfect base. Place into the fridge for the base to set even more and for the **2 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** oil to harden.

Take your wild **1 Cup Wild Blueberries**, place them into a cooking pot, and together with **4 Tablespoons Sweetener**, let them cook for a while until they lightly burst open, soften a bit and release the liquid. Using an immersion blender, blend all of the blueberries into a smooth consistency sauce. Add your gelatine, mix it thoroughly and make sure there are no lumps left from the gelatine. Set aside.
Using your Kitchen machine, whip up heavy **1 Cup Whipped Cream** until firm and set aside.

Using a second bowl, whip your curd **2 Cups Curd Cheese (Quark)**. Add blueberry sauce and whisk fully. Once all combined, add **1 Cup Whipped Cream** heavy cream and fold it in until all colors combine. Pour the cheesecake topping onto the crust and place it into the fridge overnight.

title: Easy Stuffed Cabbage Rolls Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients. Clean **1  Head of cabbage** and **1  Onion**. Cut out the center thick part of the cabbage head. Regarding the filling, I have used our mini burger **Ground beef mixture**, which is a combination of ground **500 grams Minced Meat** and veggies to give you more volume. At the same time, heat the oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit.

Cook **1  Head of cabbage** leaves by submerging the whole cabbage into the pot of boiling water for a few minutes and removing softened leaves one by one. Last, dip the green ends of the spring **1  Onion** and cook for a few seconds. Cut the ends.

Take one **1  Head of cabbage** leaf and place some ground beef mixture on it. Roll the cabbage as seen in the video, and secure it by tying one spring **1  Onion** string. Place the cabbage rolls seam side down one by one onto a baking dish. You can pour some **Tomato soup or tomato-based sauce** sauce in the bottom of the baking dish.
Pour the remaining **Tomato soup or tomato-based sauce** over the **1  Head of cabbage** rolls in a baking dish.
Bake the **1  Head of cabbage** rolls for 60 to 90 minutes or until fully cooked and tender. Before serving, sprinkle with chopped spring **1  Onion** on top of cabbage rolls.

title: Keto Green Bean Casserole Recipe
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients and start preheating your oven to 400 F (200 C).
Trim the ends off the **4 Cups Green Beans** beans and blanch them in boiling water in a large skillet for at least 3-4 minutes. Drain them and transfer them into a bowl.
In a bowl, pour the cream of **2 Cups Cream of Mushroom Soup** soup into the blanched **4 Cups Green Beans** beans and mix until the green beans are all covered with the mushroom sauce.

After mixing the **4 Cups Green Beans** beans and **2 Cups Cream of Mushroom Soup** soup, transfer them to your casserole. Optionally, you can add more mushroom soup or sauce to make it more flavorful. Once assembled in the casserole, sprinkle the fried **3 Cups Fried Onions** on top.
Bake at 400 Fahrenheit (200 Celsius) for 10 minutes until the top of the casserole brown and gets crunchy.

title: Tofu Shirataki Noodles Stir-Fry Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all the ingredients for **1 Packet Shirataki Pasta or Noodles** **0,5 kilograms Chicken (breast preferably)** noodles. Cut your chicken into small pieces and chop an **1  Onion**. Slice your **1/4 kilogram Mushrooms** and cut **1/4 kilogram Asparagus** as well.
On the cooking pan, add **1 Tablespoon Coconut oil** oil and let it melt. Add your chopped **1  Onion** and let it caramelize.
Once your onions are caramelized, add **0,5 kilograms Chicken (breast preferably)** pieces, salt, pepper, and cook the chicken until almost done.
Once you see the **0,5 kilograms Chicken (breast preferably)** is done, add your sliced **1/4 kilogram Mushrooms** and mix while still cooking.
Freshly cut **1/4 kilogram Asparagus** added to the pan towards the end will ensure the asparagus is not overcooked.

Once your **1 Packet Shirataki Pasta or Noodles** noodles are thoroughly washed, you can add them directly into the dish as they will soak up all of the flavors from the **0,5 kilograms Chicken (breast preferably)** stir fry.

title: Keto Stuffed Peppers Recipe With Rice
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients.  Clean raw **12 pieces Green Peppers** and cut the stems and top of the peppers. Using your knife, clean all of the insides without breaking the peppers. Place aside and allow the peppers dry. If you are using **2 Packets Shirataki Rice** rice, make sure you wash them thoroughly under warm water.
Add in ground beef, **2  Eggs**, washed **2 Packets Shirataki Rice** rice, and dry ingredients into a big mixing bowl. Using your hand or a spatula, mix them all fully.

With your hand, fill each of the pre-cleaned pepper with a stuffing beef mixture to the top of the pepper. Make sure you stuff the **12 pieces Green Peppers** gently but firmly so they will not spread while cooking.
Using a big pot, caramelize your **1  Onion** with a bit of oil until golden brown.
Add **500 grams Tomato Paste** sauce and **1 Liter Tomato Juice** into the pot and bring it to a boil.

Add **3  Stevia Tabs** tabs, fresh stevia, or any of your favorite sugar sweeteners. At the same time, add a bit of fat-reduced **1 Tablespoon Un-fatened almond flour - Optional** flour and cook for another 5-10 minutes.

Using your hand blender, blend the whole sauce. It will not only ensure all of your **1  Onion** gets combined, but with this step, the color of your **500 grams Tomato Paste** sauce lightens up and gets into a beautiful red shade.
One by one, add filled **12 pieces Green Peppers** into the mixture and cook for approximately 1 hour.

title: Keto Friendly Sushi Rolls Recipe
instructions: Get all of your ingredients ready. Make sure **4 Slices Salmon** is fresh and great for sushi making. **1  Stevia Tablet** can be replaced with any sweetener.

Break **2 Cups Cauliflower** into smaller **2 Pieces Nori Sheets**. Add it into the Blender and add cold water, just to cover the cauliflower. Be careful not to fill it with the water entirely, otherwise, all will spill while mixing. Switch on the Blender and wait until cauliflower is cut into the desired tiny rice-looking pieces.

Add **2 Cups Cauliflower** with water into the pot and let it cook for 5 minutes. Add the **1 Tablespoon Vinegar** and **1  Stevia Tablet**. Once cooked, drain the cauliflower rice through the sieve. Run through with cold water so you are able to handle the heat afterward.

Once all of the water is drained, transfer the **2 Cups Cauliflower** onto the muslin cloth and squeeze it until all of the water is out. Please check the video for a better understanding. Place the cauliflower onto a bowl and prepare your Nori **2 Pieces Nori Sheets**.

Once your Nori sheet is prepared, add the cauli rice as you would in traditional sushi making. Add your desired veggies and fish at the end of the **2 Pieces Nori Sheets**. We made it with **4 Slices Salmon** and **0,5  Medium Avocado**. Water the end of the nori a bit so it will hold once rolled.
Roll the sushi and place it aside. Follow the same instruction with the second roll. Once done, cut with a sharp knife and set it for serving.

title: Pork Tenderloin Medallions with Onions
instructions: Prepare by gathering all the ingredients needed for the recipe, including the pork **4 oz Pork Tenderloin (Whole Loaf - 12 slices)**, **8  Onions**, and the **Spices for marinade:** needed for the marinade mixture. You can also prepare the pan and the other equipment you will use for easy preparation and cooking.

Take your whole loaf of **4 oz Pork Tenderloin (Whole Loaf - 12 slices)** and cut the pork into 1-inch thick medallions. After cutting the pork tenderloin, gently pound the medallions using a kitchen hammer to thin the meat. Doing this step will make the pork even more tender. Marinate the cuts of pork overnight with all the **Spices for marinade:** and **1/4 Cup Olive Oil** oil for the best flavor.
Before cooking the **4 oz Pork Tenderloin (Whole Loaf - 12 slices)** medallions from the marinade mixture, cut your white **8  Onions** into thin slices and set them aside.

Heat your pan or skillet over medium-high heat, and once hot, start adding the **4 oz Pork Tenderloin (Whole Loaf - 12 slices)** medallions without adding any oil. Sear the medallions dry and flip them using a wooden spatula to make sure they are cooked on both sides. Once the pork is cooked, add the onion slices and cover. Let it cook for approximately 20 minutes until you get the perfectly tender pork medallions. Season with salt and **2 teaspoons Salt & Pepper** and serve with rosemary or thyme on top.

title: Cheesy Cabbage Beef Keto Casserole Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. Cut meat into small pieces, which will help you to cook the **1 Pound Beef** fully tender. Slice the **10 Ounce Cabbage** into the thinnest possible slices. **1 Cup Mushrooms** should also be cut into small, tiny pieces so they are easily spread over the dish. Add spices all into a bowl for easier cooking. And remember to grain the **2 Cups Mozzarella Cheese** or your favorite cheese with a grater.
Heat the skillet and add oil. Once the oil is hot, add onions and let them caramelize.
Once the onions are cooked, add pieces of meat and cook for approximately 10 minutes until all of the sides of the pieces are cooked.
Once the meat is brown from all sides, add **1 Cup Mushrooms** cut into small pieces and cook for another 5-10 minutes.

When it is time to add spices, switch off the cooking process for this step. Some spices, especially sweet **2 Tablespoons Sweet Paprika Spice**, tend to burn very fast, and when added to cooking meat, they can change the taste. They become bitter. Once you add all the spices, mix them thoroughly into the meat and **1 Cup Mushrooms**.

At the same time, add the **1/2 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and mix thoroughly. There is no need to add any of the liquid, be it water of broth, since cooking this casserole dish for longer, meat and **10 Ounce Cabbage** will add more moisture, which will be enough for the dish.

Now is the time to switch the heat on again. When the meat, spices, and **1/2 Cup Tomato Sauce** are thoroughly mixed, add top sliced **10 Ounce Cabbage**, cover with the lid, set the cooking to medium-low and let it cook for approximately one hour. Depending on your **1 Pound Beef** size, you can adjust the cooking time accordingly.
After approximately an hour, mix the **10 Ounce Cabbage** with meat and check if the meat is tender enough. If you are more of a visual person, check out our video with complete steps.

Once all the **10 Ounce Cabbage** is fully mixed with **1 Pound Beef**, top it up with grated **2 Cups Mozzarella Cheese** and place it into the oven for 10 – 15 minutes. Here, you only need the mozzarella to melt and brown a bit. Watch out; baking cheese can turn beautifully melted to burned in minutes.

title: Best Keto Stir Fry Recipe
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Sesame seeds (on top as deco)
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Cut **2  Chicken Breasts** into small pieces and all of the vegetables into slices. Clean and cut **1/2  Broccoli head** into small florets and the rest of the stem into small cubes.

Heat your skillet and add **2 Tablespoons Sesame seeds (on top as deco)** oil. Once that is heated, add **1/4  Green onion** and **3  Garlic Cloves** and caramelize both.  Add the **2  Chicken Breasts** pieces into the pan and stir all together. Cook the chicken on a medium-high for about 10 minutes, depending on the size while mixing regularly.

Once your **2  Chicken Breasts** is cooked halfway, season it with salt and pepper. Add soy **1/4 Cup Soy sauce**, **1 Cup Broth**, and **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan gum** gum. Mix and cook for another 5 minutes or until the chicken is golden brown.

When your **2  Chicken Breasts** is fully cooked, we add all the fresh veggies. First goes all of the colorful **1  Red/**1/4  Green onion**/yellow Bell Peppers (of each)** which we mix. Followed comes **1/2  Broccoli head**. Combine stir fry together and let veggies soften slightly.  As last, add chopped green onions and **2 Tablespoons Sesame seeds (on top as deco)** seeds.

title: Baked Sausage and Sauerkraut
instructions: Prepare two ingredients only for our baked **3,5 Cups Sauerkraut** and sausage recipe. All you need is a sausage which you can make your own with our homemade sausage recipe. Regarding the sauerkraut, you can either use everything together with the liquid coming from the sauerkraut or you can also wash the sauerkraut. At the same time, preheat the oven to 180C or 350 Fahrenheits.
Using a cast-iron or any pan that could be placed into the oven, start roasting the **2  Sausages**.
Place all of your **3,5 Cups Sauerkraut** around the **2  Sausages**. And add the liquid.

Cover your cast-iron with aluminum foil, as I have done since I do not have a cover, or use a lid for the particular pot you are using. Place into the oven and bake for 40 minutes at 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit.

title: Feta Cheese Eggs Bites
instructions: Gather everything you need for the recipe to make the process smoother. Make sure you have your block of **1  Feta Cheese (block)**, **8  Eggs**, **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil (spray)** oil spray, and **1 Tablespoon Italian Seasoning** herbs ready. Preheat oven so it’s hot and ready to go.

Place the block of feta **1  Feta Cheese (block)** in the center of your baking dish or pan. Pour a light layer of **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil (spray)** oil over the cheese to help it brown beautifully in the oven. This step helps bring out that creamy texture and adds a touch of flavor.

Crack your **8  Eggs** into the center or directly around the block of **1  Feta Cheese (block)** in the baking dish. Be sure to keep the egg white —they add volume and hold everything together. Sprinkle your mixed **1 Tablespoon Italian Seasoning** herbs over the top to bring in that delicious flavor. This step creates a tasty, protein-packed base for your egg bites.

Place the dish in the oven and bake at 400 Fahrenheit (200 Celsius) for 15-20 minutes, until the **8  Eggs** are fully set and the **1  Feta Cheese (block)** becomes soft and creamy. Check on it occasionally to ensure it doesn’t overcook, as you want the texture to stay perfect. Baking it right will give you a delicious blend of fluffy eggs and melty feta.

Once baked, take a fork and gently mix the baked **1  Feta Cheese (block)** **8  Eggs** while everything is still warm. The heat will help the crispy feta eggs blend beautifully, creating a creamy and flavorful mixture. This step makes sure that every bite is evenly seasoned and delicious.

Scoop the mixture into a bowl to make it easier to handle. Using an ice cream scoop or your hands, shape the mixture into small, bite-sized circles and place the **1  Feta Cheese (block)** egg on a serving plate. These little bites are now ready to enjoy or save for later.

title: Mexican Slow Cooker Shredded Chicken
ingredients: 1 Piece Red Bell Pepper (or orange, sliced into ½-inch wide and 2-inch long strips)
1 Piece Green Bell Pepper (sliced the same way)
1 Piece Onion (peeled and cut into strips)
instructions: Start by gathering all your ingredients so they’re within easy reach. Slice the red or orange bell **1 Piece Green Bell Pepper (sliced the same way)**, green bell pepper, and **1 Piece Onion (peeled and cut into strips)** into uniform strips for even cooking. Dissolve the **2 Pieces Chicken Bouillon Cubes** cubes in 1 cup of **1 Cup Water** or simply set them aside with the measured water for later use.

Place the boneless, skinless **2 Pieces Chicken Bouillon Cubes** **2 Pounds Chicken Breasts (boneless skinless)** **1 Piece Onion (peeled and cut into strips)** the bottom of your slow cooker. Sprinkle half of the taco **1 Packet Taco Seasoning** and **1 Packet Ranch Dressing Mix** dressing mix over the top. Flip the chicken and coat the other side with the remaining seasoning mix for full flavor coverage.

Arrange the **1 Piece Red **1 Piece Green Bell Pepper (sliced the same way)** Pepper (or orange, sliced into ½-inch wide and 2-inch long strips)** onions and bell peppers on top of the seasoned **2 Pieces Chicken Bouillon Cubes**. Spread them out evenly so they cook and release flavor throughout the dish. These veggies will soften beautifully as they slow cook and infuse the chicken with color and taste.

Add the **2 Pieces Chicken Bouillon Cubes** cubes directly to the pot, then pour in the **1 Cup Water** around the edges. Cover the slow cooker with the lid and set it to cook. You can cook on low for 6–8 hours or on high for 4–6 hours. The chicken should be tender and easy to shred when done.

Once fully cooked, use two forks to shred the **2 Pieces Chicken Bouillon Cubes** right in the pot. Stir everything together so the meat soaks up the flavorful juices and mixes well with the tender veggies. Serve them warm.

title: BBQ Bacon Burger Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together for an easy assemble.
Place minced meat into a bigger ball, where you can mix everything else later on. Cut 10 to 12 slices of **10 slices Bacon** strips into small pieces.
Heat your skillet to medium-high heat and caramelize the **1  Onion**. Cut it into small squares as the first step.
Once you caramelize the **1  Onion** halfway, add **10 slices Bacon** pieces and freshly cut **6 cloves Garlic**.

Cook the **10 slices Bacon** with **6 cloves Garlic** on a skillet over medium heat until the bacon is fully cooked. Once all onions, chopped bacon, and garlic are fully cooked, let them cool and add into a big bowl with bacon grease where you have already placed your **500 grams Ground Beef** beef.
Add all the spices from the recipes, such as **1 teaspoon Dried Marjoram**, **1 teaspoon Dried Oregano**, **1 teaspoon Curcuma Powder (Turmeric)**, salt, and **Salt and Pepper**.
Using a wooden spatula, thoroughly mix the meat mixture with **10 slices Bacon**, onions, **6 cloves Garlic**, and all the herbs.
Once thoroughly mixed, use your hands to shape the mixture into 6 equal burgers.

Depending on where you’re planning to grill, heat the grill or oven and place the burgers on a grill grate for grilling. Grill burger buns for approximately 10 minutes, cook time, and turn the sites. Cook the patties for another 10 minutes internal temperature on your thermometer reaches 155°F, and you are done.

Once all the burgers are grilled, it is time for you to decorate. Use whatever vegetables you would like to add, some salad leaves, tomatoes, cucumbers, pickles, cheese, basil pesto as I have used in our case, and whatever additional you desire.

title: Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breast Recipe
instructions: Gather all the ingredients for the recipe, including boneless **4 Pieces Chicken Breasts** breasts, frozen **1 Cup Spinach  (Frozen)**, **1 Piece Buffalo Mozzarella** cheese, and any additional seasonings or spices you may want to add for flavor. Ensure the chopped spinach is thawed and drained and the mozzarella cheese is sliced or shredded and ready to use. At the same time, preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 400 degrees Fahrenheit.

Take each **4 Pieces Chicken Breasts** breast and carefully slice it in half horizontally, creating a butterfly shape. Use a sharp knife for a great cut. This technique involves making a horizontal cut along the side of the chicken breast but not cutting all the way through. Once you open the chicken breast like a book, use a meat hammer or a rolling pin to gently pound it to an even thickness. This step helps tenderize the meat and ensures even cooking.

Lay the butterflied **4 Pieces Chicken Breasts** breasts flat on a clean work surface. Stuff each chicken breast with a layer of thawed **1 Cup Spinach  (Frozen)**, followed by **1 Piece Buffalo Mozzarella** cheese slices or shredded cheese. Carefully roll up each chicken breast from the spinach and cheese filling end. Be generous with the spinach cheese filling, but make sure it does not overflow.

Take a casserole dish, skillet, or baking pan and arrange four **4 Pieces Chicken Breasts** in the dish, seam side down. Add extra **1 Cup Spinach  (Frozen)** leaves and **1 Piece Buffalo Mozzarella** cheese slices on top of the stuffed breasts for an extra burst of flavor and presentation. Cover the dish with aluminum foil, ensuring it is tightly sealed to trap the moisture inside. Place the dish in the preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes. During the final minutes of baking, remove the foil to allow the cheese on top to melt and slightly brown.

title: Air Fryer Cabbage Recipe
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients needed. Start by cutting the **1  Cabbage (Whole head)** into at least 1-inch thick wedges or slices. Ensure you do not cut them too big for a crunchier result once cooked. Aside from the cabbages, prepare all the spices to season the cabbage.

Combine all the spices and seasonings in a mixing bowl, starting with liquid ingredients like **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil** oil and **1  Lemon** juice. Then add spices like **1 Teaspoon Smoked Paprika**, onion **1 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, **1 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** garlic, **1 Teaspoon Salt**, and black **1 Teaspoon Black Pepper**. Mix well using a whisk until thoroughly combined.

Once the seasoning mixture is ready, place **1  Cabbage (Whole head)** slices in a single layer in the air fryer basket. Season your cabbage pieces by brushing them with the seasoning mixture you prepared earlier. Make sure to coat them entirely.
Add the **1  Cabbage (Whole head)** into the air fryer and cook for 8-10 minutes at 200C(400F), turning the steaks halfway through. Cook until the edges are crispy and the cabbage is tender.

title: Frozen Chicken Nuggets in Air Fryer
instructions: Take your frozen **14 Pieces Chicken Nuggets (Frozen)** nuggets out of the freezer and let them sit for a few minutes while preparing your air fryer. Prepare the air fryer basket with some EVO oil to prevent sticking. Don't forget to preheat the air fryer if needed.

If you’re storing leftover **14 Pieces Chicken Nuggets (Frozen)** or batch prepping, place them in a Ziplock bag. Use a straw to suck out the air, creating a vacuum seal that keeps the nuggets fresher for longer. Label the bag with the date so you can track its freshness easily.

Arrange the **14 Pieces Chicken Nuggets (Frozen)** nuggets in a single layer in the air fryer basket, ensuring they don’t overlap. This allows the hot air to circulate evenly and cook them to crispy perfection. Set the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) and cook for 8 minutes.

Carefully flip the **14 Pieces Chicken Nuggets (Frozen)** halfway through the cooking time using tongs. This makes sure both sides are golden and crispy, like french fries. Cook for another 4 minutes or until they’re heated and perfectly crunchy.

title: Air Fryer Crispy Chicken Fries
ingredients: 2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)
instructions: Start by gathering all your ingredients. Ensure you have your **2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)** breast, **1 Cup Breadcrumbs**, **2 Pieces Eggs**, seasonings like smoked **1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika**, **½ teaspoon Garlic **½ teaspoon Onion Powder**** powder, onion powder, **¼ teaspoon Salt**, black **1/4 teaspoon Black Pepper**, and EVO oil for spraying. Preheat the air fryer to 430 Fahrenheit (220 Celcius).

In one bowl, whisk the **2 Pieces Eggs** to create your wet coating. In another bowl, combine **1 Cup Breadcrumbs** with your seasonings—smoked **1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika**, **½ teaspoon Garlic **½ teaspoon Onion Powder**** powder, onion powder, **¼ teaspoon Salt**, and black **1/4 teaspoon Black Pepper** to make breading. This dual-coating method ensures the **2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)** fries are flavorful and crispy on the outside.

Cut the **2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)** breast into thin strips resembling fries. Take one of your breaded chicken strips, coat it in the egg, and then your pork rind mixture. Set on a plate. Repeat this process with each piece of chicken.

Spray a light coat of EVO oil in the air fryer basket to prevent sticking and ensure the **2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)** fries cook evenly, like french fries. Place the coated chicken strips into the air fryer in a single layer, ensuring space between each piece. Spray the EVO oil into the chicken and cook for 12 minutes.

Halfway through the cooking time, use tongs to carefully flip the **2 Pieces Chicken Breast (cut into thin strips lengthwise)** fries so they cook evenly on both sides. This helps achieve a crisp texture all around. Once done, check for golden brown perfection.

title: Crispy Air Fryer Chicken Bites Low Carb Version
instructions: Start preparing all the ingredients by washing and cutting the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** into small bite-sized pieces. Set all the seasonings and coating ingredients aside for easy preparation.

Beat the egg in a medium-sized bowl and toss the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts**. Coat them evenly with the egg and prepare the dry breading separately. For the dry mixture, combine the **1/2 Cup Breadcrumbs** and all the seasonings in one bowl until thoroughly combined.

Once you have the dry mixture ready, start coating each **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** piece. If you do not want to use your hands, use a tweezer. The image shows that I prepared a chopping board with paper tissue on top for the coated pieces.

After coating all the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** pieces, place them in the air fryer in a single layer. Make sure to leave tiny spaces between each piece to cook them evenly. Do the same with the rest of the batch and spray olive oil on the breaded chicken bites.

Set the internal temperature of the air fryer to 200C or 400F and cook the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** until golden brown, 8 minutes at most. Cooking time depends on the size of your bites. When it starts looking crunchy and golden brown like this, take them out of the air fryer and serve.

title: Keto French Fried Onions
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients. Start by peeling and slicing your **3  Large Onions** thinly and separating them into individual thin layers. Set them aside, and prepare your **2 Cups Buttermilk**, whey **1 Cup Whey Protein**, and baking powder.

Place all the thinly sliced **3  Large Onions** in a large bowl and pour in the **2 Cups Buttermilk**. Let the onions soak for a few minutes to help them tenderize and infuse them with flavor. While waiting, prepare the coating by combining the whey **1 Cup Whey Protein** and baking powder in a separate bowl. Mix well until thoroughly combined.

Remove the onion rings from the **2 Cups Buttermilk**, shake off any excess, and dredge them in the gluten-free flour mixture until evenly coated. Prepare cutting boards or a baking sheet with parchment paper to place your coated **3  Large Onions** aside before frying them.

Heat oil in a deep fryer or skillet to 350°F (175°C). You can do that while coating the **3  Large Onions** to avoid wasting time. Carefully drop the coated onions into the hot oil in batches, ensuring not to overcrowd them so they cook evenly. Fry until crispy and golden brown, and serve.

title: Low Carb Italian Gluten Free Breadsticks Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients needed for making the best homemade gluten-free breadsticks.
Shred the **3 Cups Mozzarella Cheese** and place it into the nonstick pot. Heat it, and while mixing it slowly with a spatula, ensure all mozzarella is fully melted.

Once your **3 Cups Mozzarella **4 Tablespoons Cream Cheese**** is soft, add **1 Tablespoon Butter** and cream cheese and combine while still hot. In this step, I switch off the heater and mix it thoroughly until I am satisfied with the dough.
Switch off the heat and slowly, one by one, add all of the other ingredients. Mix best with a plastic spatula, combining all ingredients into a soft gluten-free dough.
At this stage, add all of the **4  Eggs**. I added them straight into the dough and kept mixing until all came together.

Once all is combined, separate the fathead dough into eight pieces. Take each part and, with your hand, roll it into tiny buns. In this step, you can still work each of the buns into a smoother consistency for you to be able to roll the breadsticks easier. Once done, let the dough sit at room temperature for 15-30 minutes. You can chill the dough in the fridge for this time if it is too difficult to work with. In the meantime, heat the oven to 218 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit and prepare your baking sheet covered with parchment paper or a silicone sheet. Roll each bun into a log and place it onto a prepared baking sheet.

When you split all the fathead dough into 8 logs, season it with extra **1 Tablespoon Italian Seasoning** herbs and coarse **1 teaspoon Sea Salt**. In addition, you can brush with melted **1 Tablespoon Butter** for an extra touch. Bake the breadsticks for approximately 15 minutes or till golden brown and enjoy.

title: Sesame Keto Crackers Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for crispy crackers.
Melt the **2 Cups Shredded Mozzarella** cheese in a pot until fully combined. Check the video for better understanding

Add **1 Cup Almond Meal** meal or flour. Combine the almond flour with your spatula until the almonds are combined fully and properly into a soft dough. At this time you can add herbs, **1/2 Tablespoon Garlic Powder** in our case.
Once your cracker dough is blended, add an egg and keep incorporating it into the dough. It takes a while to mix it all, but the time is worth it. In the meantime heat up the oven on 200C or 390F
Once you have worked the dough, place it onto a piece of parchment paper or a silicone sheet and roll it with your baking roller until completely thin.
Once you are happy with the square shape, take a small bowl and add 1 egg to it. With your fork, mix it thoroughly, and with a baking brush, brush it all over the entire dough.
Now it's time to sprinkle the **1/2 Cup Sesame Seeds** seeds.
Make the shapes and sizes you wish with your pizza or pastry cutter.
Move the dough onto a baking sheet and bake in your oven for 8-10 minutes.

title: Keto Dumplings Recipe
instructions: Gather all the ingredients by placing each of them in small containers for easy preparation.
Using your hand mixer, mix the **2  Eggs** until it turns smooth and fluffy.

Once the egg is smooth, add the rest of the ingredients, including the **1 Tablespoon Psyllium Husk** husk, which will be the ingredient that will turn the mixture into a dough. Just keep mixing until the consistency is no longer liquid. After mixing all the ingredients, place the dough into a bowl and rest. Cover with plastic and place in the fridge for 30 minutes.

Take the dumpling dough from the fridge and portion it into small pieces. Shape the portioned dough into small dough balls and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet, ensuring each has spaces between them.

Start preparing the steamer after shaping them to your desired size and shape. No need to worry about not having a steamer because you can use any large pot in your kitchen and add water at the bottom. Bring the water to a boil and place the steaming stand on top. Add parchment paper on top with oil on the surface and add the dumpling balls. Cover the pot and let it steam for 15 minutes.

title: Crispy Keto Popcorn Chicken Recipe
instructions: Wash and cut the **2  Chicken Breasts** into bite-sized pieces or small cubes. You can look at the video for this recipe so you will know the exact size of how I cut them. Prepare the **2  Eggs** and all the dry ingredients by placing each of them in a small storage container. Doing this as a preparation part makes the whole process easier.

Prepare separate bowls for the **2  Eggs** and dry coating mixture. Whisk up at least two eggs in a bowl and set aside. Start preparing the dry mixture by combining all the dry ingredients, starting with the whey **1/2 Cup Whey Protein** and baking **1 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, followed by all the seasonings needed: **1 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** garlic, onion powder, **1 Teaspoon Smoked paprika**, and **2 Teaspoons Salt** and **2 Teaspoons Black Pepper**.

Since this recipe does not need marinating, you can directly coat these **2  Chicken Breasts** pieces with egg and breading. Start by dipping them one by one into the egg and transfer the chicken onto the dry mixture to dredge. Make sure to coat them evenly. After that, dip the coated chicken again into the egg and repeat with the rest of the chicken pieces for double coating. This process helps the chicken get more crispy and crunchy once fried. Once they are all coated, place the breaded popcorn chicken on a baking sheet with a paper towel and start heating your oil in the pan.

Place the breaded **2  Chicken Breasts** into the hot oil and fry until golden brown. Add the chicken in batches and fry until golden brown and crispy on all sides. Use the strainer to check if they are cooked and super crispy.

Once fried, remove the **2  Chicken Breasts** from the oil and transfer it to a paper towel-lined plate using the strainer to drain excess oil. Let the chicken dry for a few minutes and serve with your favorite dipping sauces.

title: Steamed Artichoke
instructions: Wash the whole **1  Artichoke**
Cut the base and with scissors cut all the spikes of the petals
Clean the middle if you desire
Spread the **Lemon juice from 1 lemon** juice over the whole **1  Artichoke** to prevent browning
Boil the water, add rest of the **Lemon juice from 1 lemon** juice and salt
Once the water is boiling, steam it in the basket with the stem facing up
Steam it for circa 25 – 30 minutes
Serve with butter and garlic.
Bon Appetite

title: How To Make Crispy Keto French Fries
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients for easy maneuver. Make sure you have boiling water on the side as well.
In a glass bowl or a mixing jar, place all of the dry ingredients in and mix until fully combined.
Once all of the ingredients are fully combined and lumps are taken out add the hot water.
Using your spatula, mix all of the dry ingredients with the boiling water until a smooth dough has been formed.
