Once everything is combined, place the dough onto a silicone sheet or parchment paper and work it out further.
Using a rolling pin, roll the dough into a rectangular shape, approximately a quarter of an inch thick.
Once you have a rectangular shape with approximately a quarter of an inch thick using either a knife or cake scraper cut the dough into half and then a really thin slice like french fries.
When all of the dough is cut into french fries, placed them one by one into the preheated pan with oil.
Fry at a low to middle heat slowly turning the fries onto all sides.
After all of the keto french fries are brown and crispy, placed them one by one onto a plate covered with a paper towel.

title: Keto Potato Salad Recipe
instructions: Peel the **2  Turnips** entirely. Cut all the turnips into bite sized pieces with a sharp knife, as regular potatoes typically do. At the same time, cut fresh **3  Carrots** and place them all into a bowl ready for cooking.
Cut **1  Onion** and all the **1 Jar Pickles** into small tiny squares and place them aside. At the same time, prepare your other ingredients.

In a big glass bowl, add **1 Cup Greek Yogurt** with **1/2 Cup Mayonnaise** and approximately 1/3rd of a cup of liquid left from your **1/4 Cup Pickle Water** jar. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper and mix.
Place **2  Turnips** and **3  Carrots** into a cooking pot, add boiling **1/4 Cup Pickle Water**, bring to a boil and let it cook until tender for 15 minutes maximum.

Once your **3  Carrots** and **2  Turnips** are boiled, strain them through a strainer and pour a very cold pot of **1/4 Cup Pickle Water** to shock them, so they immediately stop the cooking process.
Add all remaining ingredients in a large mixing bowl, such as the **1  Onion**, **1 Jar Pickles**, and **1 Cup Green Peas** peas. Pour the whole dressing you have stored in the fridge.
Using two spatulas, gently mix the ingredients and salad dressing together. Refrigerate for at least 2 to 3 hours before you are ready to serve.

title: Keto Stuffed Mushrooms Appetizer
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients beforehand.
Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**: Start with your **1   Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves**. Place them into a cooking pot sprinkled with olive oil and caramelize for few minutes.

Once caramelized, add **0,5 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook for 15 minutes. Add diced **1 Tbsp Fresh Marjoram** **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
**20  Small Mushrooms (white and brown)**: Fully wash or clean your mushrooms.
Take out all of the stems. You can add chopped mushroom stems into your mixture as this will still bake together in the oven.
At the same time Preheat your oven to 200C or 400F.
Place your **20  Small Mushrooms (white and brown)** Cups either onto the casserole or a baking sheet.
Stuff each mushroom with your bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** mixture and top up each of the **20  Small Mushrooms (white and brown)** with **1/4 Cup Grated Cheese** cheese.
Bake at 200C or 400F for approximately 20 minutes.

title: Chocolate Chaffle Cake with Peanut Butter Mousse
ingredients: 1/4 Cup Cream Cheese (or Mozzarella or 2 Tbsp Heavy Cream)
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for **1/4 Cup Peanut Butter** Butter Mousse as well as Chocolate Chaffles
Whisk all of the ingredients for Chocolate Chaffles in a glass bowl or jug.
Heat your Dash mini waffle maker.
Once heated, spray lightly with oil to prevent chaffles from sticking.

Pour 1 to 1 1/2 tablespoons of the mixture onto your Chaffle maker and using the back of the spoon gently spread the mixture throughout the whole Chaffle maker. Gently close the lid and let it cook for approximately 4 to 5 minutes until the light goes off or you can easily open the Chaffle maker without sticking.Place Chocolate Chaffles aside and let them fully cool.

Using your Electric Hand Blender, whisk **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese (or Mozzarella or 2 Tbsp Heavy Cream)** **0,5 Cup Keto Whipped Cream** with sweetener until stiff peak. Add **1/4 Cup Peanut Butter** Butter and on a medium speed, gently whisk all together into a perfect fluffy Peanut Butter Mousse.
Fill your piping bag with the mousse for easier assembly.
Start by choosing your Cake stand or a plate you will be serving your Chaffle Cake in. Place one Chocolate Chaffle in the middle.
Take your **1/4 Cup Peanut Butter** butter and cut the end of the piping bag.
Gently push the mousse onto the chocolate chaffle.
Using the back of the spoon, spread the mousse evenly to cover the whole Chaffle.
Top with a second Chaffle and repeat the process until you are satisfied with the height of the Chaffle Cake.

Place the whole Chocolate Chaffle Cake with **1/4 Cup Peanut Butter** Butter Mousse into the fridge until you are ready to serve. Few hours is the best solution. This will help the mousse to settle and thicken and it will be much easier to cut.

Top up the Chaffle cake with your favorite decoration. Be it a few berries, **0,5 Cup Keto Whipped Cream** Sprinkles, candles for a birthday cake, cinnamon powder, crushed nuts, or simple powdered sweetener.

title: Chicken Salad Recipe
instructions: Start by finely chopping the **2 Pieces Sticks of Celery (finely chopped)** and red **1/2 Piece Red Onion (diced)** and mincing the **1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder** **3 Pieces Garlic Cloves (minced)**. Measure out all your spices: **1 teaspoon Oregano**, **1 1/2 teaspoons Salt**, **1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper**, garlic powder, and set them aside. Chop the fresh **2 Tablespoons Parsley (chopped fresh)** and get the **1/2 Cup Mayonnaise** ready in a small bowl.

Use your hands or two forks to shred the **3 Cups Shredded Rotisserie Chicken** chicken into bite-sized **2 Pieces Sticks of Celery (finely chopped)**. You’ll need about 3 cups for this recipe. Place the shredded chicken into a large mixing bowl.

Add the chopped **2 Pieces Sticks of Celery (finely chopped)**, red **1/2 Piece Red Onion (diced)**, **1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder**, spices, **2 Tablespoons Parsley (chopped fresh)**, and **1/2 Cup Mayonnaise** into the bowl with the **3 Cups Shredded Rotisserie Chicken**. Mix everything together until fully combined and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed before chilling or serving.

title: Mexican Taco Soup Slow Cooker
instructions: Gather all the ingredients you'll need: **1 Pound Chicken Breast** **8 Cups Chicken Stock**, chicken breasts, canned diced **2 Cans Diced Tomatoes (14 oz, drained)** (drained), **½ Head Cabbage (sliced thin)**, **1 Pound Ground Beef** beef, and seasonings like **1 teaspoon Garlic **1 teaspoon Onion Powder**** powder, **1 teaspoon Cumin**, **1 teaspoon Paprika**, onion powder, **1 teaspoon Salt (or to taste)**, and **1 teaspoon Black Pepper (or to taste)**. You can also prepare your favorite toppings like **1  Avocado (sliced)**, **1  Cilantro (chopped)**, **1  Lime Juice**, sour **1  Sour Cream**, or **1  Shredded Cheese** cheese. Having everything ready makes the layering process quick and easy.

Form the **1 Pound Ground Beef** beef into small meatballs, about 1 to 1.5 inches in size. Sprinkle them with **1 teaspoon Salt (or to taste)** and black **1 teaspoon Black Pepper (or to taste)** to bring out their flavor. These little meatballs will cook right in the soup, adding a hearty texture and richness.

Slice the **½ Head Cabbage (sliced thin)** into thin, even shreds to help it cook down and blend into the soup. A half-head of cabbage should be sufficient, but you can adjust the amount according to your preference. Set it aside once it's prepped and ready to go.

Place the **1 Pound Chicken Breast** breasts at the bottom of your slow cooker. Add the meatballs, sliced **½ Head Cabbage (sliced thin)**, diced **2 Cans Diced Tomatoes (14 oz, drained)**, **1 teaspoon Garlic **1 teaspoon Onion Powder**** powder, **1 teaspoon Cumin**, **1 teaspoon Paprika**, onion powder, **1 teaspoon Salt (or to taste)**, and **1 teaspoon Black Pepper (or to taste)**. Pour in the chicken **8 Cups Chicken Stock** last, covering all the ingredients.

Cover the slow cooker with the lid and cook on low for 7–8 hours or high for 4–5 hours. The **1 Pound Chicken Breast** should be tender enough to shred easily with a fork. Serve hot and let everyone top their bowls with **1  Avocado (sliced)**, **1  Lime Juice**, **1  Cilantro (chopped)**, sour **1  Sour Cream**, or **1  Shredded Cheese** if desired.

title: Easy Homemade Keto Gnocchi
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for a quick and easy assembly.
Whisk a whole egg in a bowl, you are planning to make your dough.
Once your egg is whisked, add cream **1/2 Cup Cream Cheese** and salt and mix it fully until all is combined into one smooth consistency. Have a look at the video for easier visual instructions.
Add **1 TBsp Coconut Flour** flour and whisk it again fully until combined.
Before you add **2,5 TBsp Guar Gum** Gum, remember, that the dough is going to thicken very fast at this stage.
Take one of the spatula and with your hand mix the **2,5 TBsp Guar Gum** gum into the dough until fully combined. Let it sit for approximately 10-15 minutes.
On a silicone mat, work out the dough once again with your hands until it forms one whole piece.
Separate with a knife or a cake scrapper into 4 parts.
Take one part and roll it into a thin log. Using your knife or cake scraper, cut identical pieces out of the log and continue until all 4 parts of the dough are cut.
Using either your hands or Gnocchi wooden Board, shape gnocchi as you wish.
Once you have all shaped into Gnocchi, place them into boiling water, where you have sprinkled a bit of oil. This will prevent the Gnocchi from sticking together once ready.
Cook for approximately 5 minutes, depending on the size and shape. nth Step. Enjoy
Take it out of the water and serve it straight with your preferred sauce.

title: Keto Cream of Mushroom Soup
instructions: First, prepare all the needed ingredients. Clean and chop the **2 Cups Mushrooms** to your desired size, and cut the onions into small pieces.
Prepare your cooking pot and saute the onions in the melted **2 Tablespoons Butter** until caramelized. Add the **2 Cups Mushrooms** and cook until they release their moisture.

Once the onions and **2 Cups Mushrooms** are cooked, add the **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream**, bone **1 Cup Broth**, and salt and **Salt & Pepper**. Bring the mixture to a boil, reduce to medium heat, and let it simmer for about 10 minutes. For an extra creamy texture, blend all using an immersion blender.
If the soup is not thick enough, sprinkle a bit of **1/4  teaspoon Xanthan Gum (Optional)** gum, stir well and cook for another minute or two.

title: Keto Ramen Noodles
instructions: Prepare your ingredients.
Rinse your **2 packets Tofu Shirataki Noodles** under a warm water fully.
Roast the **2 packets Tofu Shirataki Noodles** noodles on **1  Medium Carrot** heat in a pan or dutch oven.
Take a few pieces of fresh **200 grams Chicken** and cook them in a pan as you would typically for other dishes.
Place all the veggies you plan to use into the boiling water and let it simmer for 1-2 minutes.
Once your veggies are softer, place them into a strainer and quickly run through with cold water. That will retain the color, and the veggies will stop cooking immediately.

Ensure all ingredients (except **2 slices Avocado**) are warm and your **1 Liter Bone Broth** is boiling. Add the **2 packets Tofu Shirataki Noodles** into a ramen bowl first. Layer all other ingredients and add the **200 grams Chicken** broth or soup stock as last.

title: Cauliflower Pumpkin Puree Recipe
instructions: Begin by gathering all the necessary ingredients, including a fresh **1/2  Pumpkin** of your choice, **1/2  Cauliflower**, garlic, **1 Cup Cottage Cheese** cheese, and Greek **2 Tablespoons Greek Yogurt**. Cut the pumpkin in half with a sharp knife and scrape out the seeds with a spoon. At the same time heat oven to180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit.
With the **1/2  Pumpkin** halves ready, cut them into smaller, manageable pieces, along with the **1/2  Cauliflower** and garlic. This will help in even roasting and ensure they cook thoroughly.

Place **1/2  Pumpkin**, **1/2  Cauliflower**, and garlic into a bowl, and generously drizzle with oil, sprinkling a dash of salt and **Oil, Salt & Pepper** to taste. Mix the vegetables well, ensuring they are evenly coated. Place them onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper to prevent sticking, and then slide the sheet into the preheated oven to roast for 25 minutes.

Once the roasted **1/2  Pumpkin**, **1/2  Cauliflower**, and garlic flesh is soft and cooked to perfection, let them cool briefly before transferring them into a blender or food processor. Here comes the exciting part: add a dollop of **1 Cup Cottage Cheese** cheese to the mix, which adds a luscious creaminess to the puree. Place the pumpkin halves and everything else into the food processor and puree until smooth and velvety texture. If you prefer a softer consistency of pureed pumpkin, add one to two **2 Tablespoons Greek Yogurt** of Greek yogurt into the blend, achieving your desired level of creaminess.

title: Keto Chicken and Dumplings
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients. Cut the **2 Cups Chicken** into small cubes or pieces, and chop your vegetables, such as **2  Carrots**, **1  Zucchini**, and leeks, into sliced pieces. Make sure to wash the vegetables first.

Heat your pot and add **1 Tablespoon Butter**. Add the chopped onions and **3  Garlic Cloves** once the butter has melted. Once they are caramelized, add the **2 Cups Chicken** and stir them all together in the pan, cooking on low heat.

Slowly add the **2  Carrots**, **1  Zucchini**, and leeks when the **2 Cups Chicken** is cooked. Mix and add the **3 Cups Broth**. Cover with a lid and let it simmer until the vegetables, especially the carrots, are cooked.

After simmering the vegetables, you can add the **1 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum by dissolving it in hot water or from the hot **3 Cups Broth** in the pot. Mix it in and pour it into the soup. Continue by adding the **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream. Mix again until the cream combines with the broth and has a creamy soup texture. Lastly, add the **6  Keto Dumplings** into the simmering soup, cover, and let it simmer again for 10 minutes to cook the dumplings.

title: Easy Chocolate Covered Nuts Recipes
instructions: Prepare all the **2 Cups Nuts**. To make preparation easier, chop your **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** bar into small pieces and melt them easily later.
Using the instant pot and a glass mixing bowl, melt the **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** with **4 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** oil in boiling water until entirely melted.
Add the peanuts and almonds to the melted **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** and stir them with a stick or spoon to coat them all with chocolate.

For the **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate**-coated **2 Cups Nuts** and almonds, remove each nut from the chocolate mixture and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Make sure to leave some space between each nut so they won't stick to each other.

To make **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** clusters, form small clusters using a spoon and place them on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Like the first ones, give each cluster a space to prevent sticking while they are still soft.

To make **2  Cups Sugar-Free Chocolate** bark, you will need a chocolate bar mold. The chocolate nut bark needs to be shaped like a fresh chocolate bar. Prepare the mold and start pouring the chocolate nut mixture into it. Use a spoon to remove excess chocolate from the sides. Fill the mold with chocolate so the cookies will turn out perfectly once they are chilled and hardened.

title: Cranberry Fruit Leather Recipe
instructions: The first thing you need to do is prepare your **2 Cups Cranberries** by washing them thoroughly and getting them ready for blending.
Add the **2 Cups Cranberries** and **2 Cups Water** to the blender or food processor and blend until smooth. To taste, you can add citrus to your favorite fruit, lemon juice, or sweetener.

Prepare your dehydrator for making the fruit leather. Spread the cranberry pulps or your fruit puree onto the baking sheet and ensure they are evenly spread to get an equal thickness when you cut them later. Once they are assembled and ready, dehydrate them for approximately eight hours.

After dehydrating your cranberry pulps, allow it to dry for several hours until the fruit leather is set and no longer sticky. Peel off the fruit leather from the parchment paper and roll them up. Cut into bite-sized pieces, and your cranberry fruit leather is ready.

If you plan to make a massive batch of cranberry fruit leather, another way of cutting and serving them is to spread them all out on a baking sheet or wax paper and put another sheet on top. You can use a ruler or anything to help you cut the fruit leather to your desired width. After cutting, roll them up without removing the baking sheet so you can still consume them later.

title: Hibiscus Powder Recipe
instructions: Prepare your dried **1 Cup Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** flowers and the equipment you will use for grinding. If you use fresh hibiscus, you can dry it at home by air-drying or oven-drying.

Transfer the dried **1 Cup Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** to your magic bullet blender or coffee grinder and prepare to grind. Pulse the blender until the dried petals turn into a fine powder. You can check the powder after pulsing a few times to see if it's okay with you, but if you want a finer powder, add a few more pulses.
Once you are good with the powdered **1 Cup Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)**, gently open the lid and transfer your powder to any spice container. Enjoy it and start using it for your dishes.

title: Chocolate Covered Almonds Recipe
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients needed. Start by ensuring your high-quality **1 Cup Almonds** are dry. If they have any moisture, it can affect the **1 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** coating later. Spread them out on a baking sheet and let them fully air dry.

Prepare your Instant Pot and melt the dark **1 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** in a medium bowl with **2 Tablespoons Coconut Oil** oil. You can use a double boiler or microwave to melt the chocolates. Stir in between until completely melted and smooth using a stick or spoon.

Once the **1 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** is silky and completely melted, pour the **1 Cup Almonds** into the chocolate bowl. Ensure each almond is generously covered with the chocolate to avoid uneven coating. Use a stick or spoon to dip the whole almonds in. After ensuring they are coated, use a sieve to get all the almonds and prevent waste of the excess chocolates. If you do not have a small sieve, you can use a fork to get the almonds individually.

Place the **1 Cup Sugar Free Chocolate** coated **1 Cup Almonds** in a tray with parchment paper using long tweezers or any dipping tool. Make sure to place each almond one at a time and make spaces from each piece to prevent the chocolates from sticking. And for the perfect flavor contrast, sprinkle a little sea salt over the almonds while the chocolate is still wet. It is only **Sea Salt - Optional**, you can leave yours unsalted if you want. Dry for at least 30 seconds before chilling it in the refrigerator.

title: Almond Cake
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°Fahrenheit (180°Celsius) and line an 18cm (8-inch) springform pan with parchment on the bottom and sides, making sure the base releases easily.
Whip egg whites with cream of **1/4 teaspoon Cream of Tartar** until medium-stiff peaks form, stopping once they hold their shape to avoid overmixing.
Beat egg yolks with **1/4 Cup Sweetener** for 2–3 minutes until pale and creamy, then mix in the **2 Tablespoons Almond Slices** **1/2 Tablespoon Almond Extract**.

Mix **2 Tablespoons Almond Slices** **1 1/4 Cup Almond Flour** into the yolk batter until thick, then gently fold in the meringue in stages, starting with a small portion to loosen the batter and finishing carefully to keep it airy.
Spread the batter evenly in the pan, tap lightly to release bubbles, top with sliced almonds, and bake for 35 minutes until golden. Cool completely before removing from the pan.

title: Classic Borscht Soup with Cabbage and Beets
ingredients: ½ Piece Small Green Cabbage (thinly sliced (about 4 cups))
instructions: Gather and prep all ingredients before starting: grate **2 Pieces Beets (medium, peeled and grated)** and **2 Pieces Carrots (medium, grated)**, dice **½ Cup Onion (diced)**, mince **2 cloves Garlic (minced)**, thinly slice **½ Piece Small Green Cabbage (thinly sliced (about 4 cups))**, and measure **6 Cups Broth**, **1 Tablespoon Tomato Paste** paste, **1 teaspoon Vinegar**, and seasonings.
Thinly slice half a head of green **½ Piece Small Green Cabbage (thinly sliced (about 4 cups))** into even strips, about 4 cups total, and set aside so it can be added later without overcooking.

Add beef **6 Cups Broth**, grated **2 Pieces Beets (medium, peeled and grated)**, **1 Tablespoon Tomato Paste** paste, bay **1 Piece Bay Leaf**, and a pinch of **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)** to a large pot. Bring to a boil, then reduce to a steady simmer to let the beets release color and sweetness.

Cook grated **2 Pieces Carrots (medium, grated)** and diced **½ Cup Onion (diced)** in oil over medium heat for 8–10 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Stir in **2 cloves Garlic (minced)** and cook briefly until fragrant.

Add the sautéed vegetables and **½ Piece Small Green Cabbage (thinly sliced (about 4 cups))** to the pot and simmer 15–20 minutes until the cabbage is tender but still textured. Finish with **1 teaspoon Vinegar**, adjust seasoning, and serve with sour **1 Tablespoon Sour Cream (for serving)** and fresh **1 Sprig Fresh Dill (for serving)**.

title: Creamy Vegetable Chowder Bowl
instructions: Set out all chopped vegetables, **1 Cup Vegetable Broth**, **½ Cup Water**, **¼ Cup Coconut Flour** flour, **2 Cups Whole Milk**, **6 Tablespoons Butter (cubed)**, and shredded **½ Cup Cheddar Cheese (shredded)**. Make sure the **1¼ Cups Broccoli Florets**, **½ Cup Onion (grated)**, **1 Cup Yellow Carrots (diced)**, and **2 Pieces Celery Ribs (diced)** are evenly cut for even cooking.

Add **1¼ Cups Broccoli Florets**, **½ Cup Onion (grated)**, **1 Cup Yellow Carrots (diced)**, **2 Pieces Celery Ribs (diced)**, **1 Cup Vegetable Broth**, and **½ Cup Water** to a Dutch oven over medium heat. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook 10–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables soften.

Melt **6 Tablespoons Butter (cubed)** in a saucepan over medium heat, whisk in **¼ Cup Coconut Flour** flour, then slowly add **2 Cups Whole Milk** while whisking. Cook until smooth and thickened, seasoning with **½ teaspoon Salt** and **⅛ teaspoon Pepper**.
Stir the thickened sauce into the vegetables, lower heat, and simmer 10 minutes. Add shredded **½ Cup Cheddar Cheese (shredded)**, stir until melted, adjust seasoning, and serve.

title: Best Keto Zucchini Lasagna
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) and gather all ingredients: **1 Pound Ground Beef** beef, zucchini, cheeses, egg, **1 Cup Marinara Sauce (sugar-free)**, and seasonings so assembly is quick and organized.
Slice the zucchini thinly, sprinkle with **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)**, let sit 10 minutes to draw out moisture, then pat the slices dry to prevent a watery lasagna.

Brown the **1 Pound Ground Beef** beef, drain the grease, then stir in **1 Cup Marinara Sauce (sugar-free)** and Italian **1 teaspoon Italian Seasoning** and let it simmer briefly to deepen the flavor.
Combine **1 Cup Ricotta Cheese**, egg, **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)**, and **1 Pinch Pepper (to taste)** in a bowl until smooth to create the creamy white layer for the lasagna.

Brush a baking dish with **1 teaspoon Olive Oil (for brushing)** oil, then layer zucchini, **1 Cup Ricotta Cheese**, meat **1 Cup Marinara Sauce (sugar-free)**, and **1½ Cups Mozzarella (shredded)**, repeating until used up and finishing with mozzarella and **½ Cup Parmesan Cheese (grated)**.
Cover with foil and bake 25 minutes, uncover and bake 15 more until bubbly and golden; rest 10 minutes so the slices hold together.

title: Oven Baked Salmon and Asparagus
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) and line a baking sheet with parchment. Wash and chop the **1/2 Piece Yellow Pepper (2.82 oz)** bell pepper into cubes and slice the **5 Pieces Asparagus (5 oz)** into 3–4 pieces each.

Place **2 Pieces Salmon Fillet (8.4 oz)** fillets on one side of the sheet and spoon low-carb **4 Tablespoons Sweet Chili Sauce (low carb)** chili sauce over each, letting some drip onto the veggies for extra flavor.

Arrange the vegetables around the **2 Pieces Salmon Fillet (8.4 oz)**, drizzle with **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil (15 ml)** oil, and toss to coat. Bake for 20 minutes or until the salmon flakes easily and the veggies are tender.

title: Tender Bites from Air Fryer Steak
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 5 minutes and gather your seasonings, oil, and melted **2 Tablespoons Butter (melted)**.
Slice the **1 Pound Ribeye Steak** into evenly sized bite-sized cubes and place them in a mixing bowl.

Season with **1 teaspoon Salt**, **1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, black **1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper**, **1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil** oil, and **1 Tablespoon Worcestershire Sauce**, then toss to coat well.
Spread the cubes in a single layer and cook at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 6–8 minutes, flipping halfway for even browning.
Melt **2 Tablespoons Butter (melted)** in a small dish and add a pinch of **1 teaspoon Salt** if desired for extra richness.
Let the **1 Pound Ribeye Steak** rest 2 minutes, then drizzle with the melted **2 Tablespoons Butter (melted)** and finish with parsley before serving.

title: Classic Italian Eggplant with Parmesan Casserole
ingredients: 2 Pices Eggplants (large, sliced into ½-inch disks)
instructions: Gather and measure all ingredients, then preheat the oven to 325°Fahrenheit (162°Celsius) so everything is ready for layering and assembly.
**3 Tablespoons Salt (divided)** the eggplant slices and press them for about an hour to draw out moisture, then rinse or wipe and pat them completely dry.
Heat **1 Cup Olive Oil (divided)** oil in a skillet and fry the eggplant slices until golden on both sides, then transfer to paper towels to drain excess oil.

Layer **3 Cups Marinara Sauce**, fried eggplant, cheeses, **¼ Cup Fresh Basil (torn)**, and seasonings in a baking dish, top with **1 Pound Mozzarella Cheese (shredded)**, and bake 50–60 minutes before resting and serving.

title: Cauliflower Rice Recipes
instructions: Prepare to rice the **4 Cup Cauliflower Rice** by separating the florets from the cauliflower stems. This way, it is easier to grind the cauliflower later on.

Add the **4 Cup Cauliflower Rice** florets into the blender and add cold water. Close the lid and start pulsing the blender for 15 to 20 seconds. As it blends, you will notice the cauliflower pieces being cut in small sizes and wait until they turn more like rice. After mixing, get a fine sieve and drain the rice.

Once you have stored some of your homemade **4 Cup Cauliflower Rice** rice, prepare it for cooking. If you want to bake it, place it on a baking sheet, and if you cook it in a pan, cook it in a skillet or a pan. It is also great for making mashed cauliflower; you can prepare it in a pot.
Finalize your chosen recipe, rolling it into sushi, blending it into mashed cauli or making roasted **4 Cup Cauliflower Rice**. Serve and enjoy.

title: Sweet and Spiced Pickled Watermelon Rind
ingredients: 4 Cups Watermelon Rind (skin removed and cut into 1-inch cubes)
instructions: Start by peeling off the tough green outer skin from the **4 Cups Watermelon Rind (skin removed and cut into 1-**1 inch Fresh Ginger (thinly sliced)** cubes)** rind. Once peeled, cut the **1 Cup White Vinegar** rind into 1-inch cubes for even pickling. Set the prepared **3 Pieces Whole Cloves** aside while you prepare the rest of the ingredients.

Bring **1½ Cups Water** to a boil in a saucepan and add the **4 Cups Watermelon Rind (skin removed and cut into 1-inch cubes)** cubes. Blanch them for 5 minutes to slightly soften their texture and remove any bitterness. Drain the rind and set it aside while you make the brine.

In the same pot, combine **1½ Cups Water**, white **1 Cup White Vinegar**, sugar **¾ Cup Sugar Substitute**, **1 Tablespoon Kosher Salt** salt, **1 Piece Cinnamon Stick** stick, whole **3 Pieces Whole Cloves**, **1 teaspoon Mustard Seeds** seeds, **1 teaspoon Black Peppercorns**, **½ teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper (optional)** red pepper (if using), and sliced **1 inch Fresh Ginger (thinly sliced)**. Stir well to dissolve and bring the mixture to a boil. This spiced brine gives the pickles their tangy, aromatic flavor.

Add the blanched **4 Cups Watermelon Rind (skin removed and cut into 1-inch cubes)** back into the hot brine and reduce the heat. Let it simmer for 10–15 minutes until the rind becomes slightly translucent. Transfer the mixture to a sterilized jar, let it cool to room temperature, seal, and refrigerate for at least 24 hours before enjoying.

title: Easy Chicken and Veggie Bake with Italian Herbs
ingredients: 2 Pieces Boneless Chicken Breasts (cut into cubes)
1 Piece Red Bell Pepper (chopped into chunks)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) and line a baking sheet with foil or parchment. Cut the **2 Pieces Boneless Chicken Breasts (cut **1 Piece Red Bell Pepper (chopped into chunks)** cubes)** into even cubes and chop the **1 Piece Medium Zucchini (sliced into half-moons)**, red **1 Piece Small Red Onion (thinly sliced)**, and bell **1 Pinch Ground Black Pepper (to taste)** into bite-sized pieces.

Add the **2 Pieces Boneless Chicken Breasts (cut into cubes)** and vegetables to a large bowl, drizzle with **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil, season with **2 teaspoons Garlic Powder** powder, Italian **2 teaspoons Italian Seasoning**, **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)**, and **1 Pinch Ground Black Pepper (to taste)**, then toss until everything is evenly coated.

Divide the mixture between two foil sheets, seal **1 Piece Red Bell Pepper (chopped into chunks)** packets with a **1 Piece Small Red Onion (thinly sliced)** opening for steam, and bake for 25–30 minutes until the **2 Pieces Boneless Chicken Breasts (cut into cubes)** is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.

title: Sugar Free Apricot Jam Recipe
instructions: First of all, prepare all the ingredients needed for the recipe. Wash and pit the **2 Cups Apricots**. Cut them into small pieces and prepare the rest of the ingredients, such as **1/2 Cup Water**, **1 Tablespoon Lemon juice** juice, and **1 Teaspoon Cinnamon**. Since the **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum (optional)** gum is optional, it is your call whether to use it to thicken your jam at the end.

Combine the **2 Cups Apricots**, **1/2 Cup Water**, **1 Tablespoon Lemon juice** juice, and **1 Teaspoon Cinnamon** in your heated pot. Bring them to a boil over medium heat and cook for 20 minutes until the water evaporates, stirring frequently.

After the cooking time, stir the jam mixture and add 1/2 **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum (optional)** of xanthan gum if you want it to have a thicker consistency. Continue to cook once you add the thickener.

Once you notice that the jam is getting thick, take the hand blender and blend the sauce until it turns into a smooth jam consistency. Remove the jam from the heat and allow it to cool before transferring it to your storage jars.

title: Instant Pot Keto Cold Start Greek Yogurt
ingredients: 2 Tablespoons Organic Greek Yogurt with live cultures
instructions: Prepare your ingredients that is, whole **4 Cups Organic Milk** and yogurt. If you are using store-bought yogurt, make sure it has live **2 Tablespoons Organic Greek Yogurt with live cultures**.

Pour the **4 Cups Organic Milk** into the Instant Pot. Add two **2 Tablespoons Organic Greek Yogurt with live cultures** of live cultured Greek yogurt into the inner pot of the Instant Pot. Using a whisk, whisk the yogurt starter into the milk as much as possible. This will ensure your yogurt will become smooth. Close the lid, switch on the yogurt function and off you go.

Once your Instant Pot beeps, that is the sign **2 Tablespoons Organic Greek Yogurt with live cultures** is done and ready. Remove the inner pot out of the Instant Pot and let the yogurt **4 Cups Organic Milk** to cool a bit. Cover with cling film and place the inner pot into the fridge for the finished yogurt to cool down thoroughly and thicken even more.

title: Rose Tea Recipe
instructions: Prepare the ingredients needed. Since this recipe only needs two ingredients, prepare your rose **2 Tablespoons Rose Petals (Dried)** and freshwater before the tea-making process. You can already boil the **2 Cups Water** while preparing the flowers, making the process easier and straightforward.

Separate the **2 Tablespoons Rose Petals (Dried)** from the dried rose buds, and once you are done plucking them, gather them and crush them using a mortar and pestle. Make sure to do it very gently and do not crush the flowers too much. This process releases the aroma and rose essence from the flowers before making the tea.

Ready your glass mug and start placing all the crushed rose **2 Tablespoons Rose Petals (Dried)** inside the glass into the infuser. Add hot **2 Cups Water** by pouring it higher so the flowers crush even more and extract more flavor.

Once the **2 Cups Water** is added, close the lid of the glass mug and let it steep for about 20 minutes. After steeping, pour the tea into a cup and serve with one mini **2 Tablespoons Rose Petals (Dried)** inside to make it look more elegant.

title: Sugar-Free Lavender Lemonade Recipe
instructions: Ready all the ingredients needed. Prepare your **1/4 Cup Lavender Syrup** together with your fresh **1/4 Cup Lemon Juice** juice. It is better if you extract the lemon juice in advance and set it aside for easy preparation. The amount of lavender syrup will depend on how sweet you want your lemonade to be, so measure just enough for the batch.

Prepare your large glass pitcher. Start adding the **1/4 Cup Lemon Juice** juice, **1/4 Cup Lavender Syrup**, and lavender syrup. Fill the pitcher up by pouring **4 Cups Water** over the lavender lemon mixture and adding some lemon slices.
Mix until all the ingredients are combined. Give it a good stir up to the bottom of the pitcher and mix everything, ensuring the sweetener is blended well.
Steep the lemonade for 2 hours and drain it by straining the **1/4 Cup Lavender Syrup**, leaving only the juice. Garnish your glass cup with more **1/4 Cup Lemon Juice** slices and serve over ice.

title: Cold Brew Hibiscus Iced Tea
instructions: Prepare your dried **1/4 Cup Hibiscus Flowers Dry** flowers with the **4 Cups Water** you will use. You can prepare the ice **1 Cup Ice Cubes** at the end when you have already served the iced tea.

Prepare your clean mason jar and add the dried **1/4 Cup Hibiscus Flowers Dry**, crushing them in your hands for easy steeping. After the flowers are in, fill the jar with **4 Cups Water** and cover it tightly with the lid. Shake to mix and steep the tea overnight.

After the infusion, once the tea turns red from the petals of the **1/4 Cup Hibiscus Flowers Dry**, start straining the tea with a fine strainer and transfer it to another jar. Serve it over ice by adding ice **1 Cup Ice Cubes** to your glass cup and pouring the tea to fill it up. You can optionally add some lavender syrup to taste; just like that, your hibiscus cold tea is ready to serve.

title: How To Make Cranberry Juice Recipe
instructions: The first thing to do is prepare your ingredients. Get your **2 Cups Cranberries** and **2 Cups Water** ready for blending.

Add your **2 Cups Cranberries** into the blender, followed by 2 cups of **2 Cups Water**. The amount of water you put in depends on how strong you want your juice to be. Close the lid and blend the cranberries.
It is essential to check if your **2 Cups Cranberries** are blended well. If you see some bubbles on top of the mixture, let the juice sit for a few minutes, and the foam will settle.
Strain the juice through a fine mesh sieve or cheesecloth if you have it. Press the **2 Cups Cranberries** to extract all the liquid to maximize flavor and juice.

To add some extra beauty, serve your homemade cranberry juice, as you see on cocktails in fancy restaurants. Moist the rim of the glass with lemon and dip it into a fruit powder of your choice, or best if you have cranberry powder at home.

title: The Best Flavored Water Infused with Sparkle
instructions: Prepare fruits and herbs you wish to use.
Fully clean all of your fruits. If you wish, you can submerge them into the water with a teaspoon of baking soda to get rid of all inpurities. Wash with cold water. Cut into **1/4 Cup Lemon Slices**.
Either use one big jar or separate single glasses. Fill each with few berries and mint **6  Mint Leaves**. Pour over with drinking or sparkling water.

title: Best Blueberry Pie Recipe
instructions: Gather all crust ingredients and add the dry ones to a food processor, pulsing briefly to combine. Add the egg and cream **3 Tablespoons Cream Cheese**, then blend on high for 10–30 seconds. Preheat the oven to 350°Fahrenheit (180°Celsius).

Mix **4 Cups Blueberries**, **3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice** juice, **½ teaspoon Stevia Powder** powder, and **¼ teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum until the berries are evenly coated and the mixture thickens slightly. Set aside while preparing the crust.

Transfer the dough to a plastic bag, press out the air, and chill for at least 1 hour. Divide in half, keep one portion chilled, and roll the other between parchment into a circle large enough for a 9-inch pie plate.
Flip the rolled dough into the pie plate, press gently into place, remove parchment, and trim the edges. Pour the blueberry filling evenly into the crust.

Roll out the remaining dough and use it to cover, lattice, or decorate the pie, chilling again if needed. Brush with egg wash and bake at 350°Fahrenheit (180°Celsius) for 45 minutes until golden and set.

title: Easy Sausage Egg Casserole
ingredients: ¾ teaspoon Butter (or Oil for greasing)
instructions: Gather all ingredients, preheat the oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius), and lightly grease a 9×9-inch baking dish to prepare for assembly.
Cook the **1 Pound Ground Breakfast Sausage** in a skillet over medium heat until browned and crumbly, stirring often, then drain the excess grease.
Spread the cooked **1 Pound Ground Breakfast Sausage** evenly in the baking dish, sprinkle chopped **1 Cup Spinach (fresh, chopped)** on top, and set aside.

Whisk **8 Pieces Eggs (large)**, **½ Cup Heavy Cream** cream, **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)**, and **1 Pinch Pepper (to taste)** in a bowl, pour evenly over the **1 Pound Ground Breakfast Sausage** and **1 Cup Spinach (fresh, chopped)**, top with **1½ Cups Cheddar Cheese (shredded)**, and bake for 25–30 minutes until golden and set.

title: Fresh Lavender Tea Recipe
instructions: To make this tea, prepare your **2 teaspoons Lavender (Fresh)** flowers and **4 Cups Water**, as these are the only ingredients needed for this recipe. If you like, you can also add some sweeteners like simple syrup or any homemade sugar-free sweeteners.

Prepare your glass pitcher and the ingredients. First, place the **2 teaspoons Lavender (Fresh)** flowers into the pitcher, followed by pouring hot **4 Cups Water** until the pitcher is filled. Cover with the lid right after filling it with hot water and let it steep until the lavender extract blends with the water.
Prepare your glass cups for serving and pour the tea. Serve and enjoy by adding more **2 teaspoons Lavender (Fresh)** flowers on top.

title: Cinnamon Cream Cheese Sweet Keto Chaffle Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
Add an egg, **1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon** and your **1 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute** sweetener into the bowl. Using your hand mixer, beat until light and fluffy.
Once your egg, **1 teaspoon Ground Cinnamon** and **1 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute** are fully mixed, add the rest of the ingredients and mix once again.
Add a few drops of **1/2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** extract into the mixture and make sure everything is fully incorporated.
Once you prepare the mixture, you can switch on your Dash Mini Maker. Ensure it heats up thoroughly, and you can start making keto chaffles.

Spray your dash mini maker with extra virgin olive oil, add scoop of the mixture, close the lid and wait until the green light switches off - ready and heated. Once the green light switches off and you see the steam reduce it is a sign your chaffle is ready. Continue after all of your chaffles are done.
Serve it as you would normally enjoy waffles. Pour **1 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute**-free liquid honey or maple syrup.

title: Blueberry Galette
instructions: Gather all ingredients and preheat the oven to 350°Fahrenheit (180°Celsius). Line a baking sheet with parchment for easy transfer and cleanup.

Pulse the **1.5 Cups Almond Flour** flour, **1/2 Tablespoon Coconut Flour** flour, **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum, baking powder, and **1/2 teaspoon Salt** in a food processor. Add the cream **3 Tablespoons Cream Cheese** and egg, processing until a smooth dough forms. Seal it in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour.

Mix the **2 2/3 Cups Blueberries ((fresh or frozen))**, **2 Tablespoon Lemon Juice** juice, **2 Tablespoon Sweetener**, and **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum until slightly thickened. Set the filling aside near your workspace.
Roll the chilled dough into a rough circle on parchment. Add the blueberry filling to the center, then fold the edges inward in sections, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the dough edges with eggwash, then sprinkle sliced **1/4 Cup Sliced Almonds** and **1/2 teaspoon Cinnamon**. Bake for 45 minutes until the crust is golden and the filling is bubbling.

title: Keto Chia Seed Chocolate Pudding
ingredients: 0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for quick and easy maneuver. All you need is your Chia **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok**, sugar **0,5 Cup Sweetener**, raw **1/4 Cup Cocoa (4 Tbsp)** and nut **2 Cups Nut Milk** of your choice.
In the Magic Bullet or a Coffee Grinder, grind Chia **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok** into a powder. This will give the Chocolate Chia Seed Pudding this Mousse looking and tasting feature.
Once your Chia **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok** are grind, keep them aside and prepare a glass jar, in which you can hand mix all of the ingredients together.
One by one, start with mixing first the powdered sugar **0,5 Cup Sweetener** together with cacao.
Prepare your hand blender and start pouring the **2 Cups Nut Milk** slowly into the glass jar, while mixing the pudding.
Once all of the **2 Cups Nut Milk** is mixed, start adding the Chia **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok** as the pudding will thicken immediately.
Using your hand mixer, make sure all of the powdered chia **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok** are mixed into the pudding and you do not have any crumbles.

Once your mixture is fully combined pour pudding into the glass containers you are going to serve it in as this Keto Chocolate **0,5 Cup Ground Chia Seeds dark is ok** Pudding will still thicken a bit and set.
Once you’re ready to serve top it up with either a Greek yogurt or a whipped cream.
Sprinkle the top with raw cacao, berries, nuts, sugar-free sprinkles or anything you like on top of a pudding.

title: Homemade Keto Sugar-Free Chocolate Chips
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients for a quick and easy assembling.
At the same time prepare your double boiler on the stove and set it to low heat. You can also use an Instant Pot with a glass bowl as you see in our video.
Once your double boiler is set, place a **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder** **1/2 Cup Cocoa Butter** into the glass bowl and let it melt fully.
When your **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder** **1/2 Cup Cocoa Butter** is melted fully, add your **1 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener** in our case Allulose. Using a silicone spatula mix it fully in until it dissolves.
When both cocoa **1/2 Cup Cocoa Butter** and **1 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener** melts together and fully dissolves add Cocoa **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder** and start incorporating that into the mixture.
Adding Vanilla Extract is **Vanilla Essence - optional** but it adds into the flavor of our homemade sugar-free chocolate chip greatly.
Depending on your silicone mold, pour the melted chocolate onto the mold and make sure all the chocolate is spread evenly.
Place into the refrigerator and let it cool and hardened fully.
Once your Sugar Free Chocolate Chips are fully hardened, pop them out of the silicone mold and store them either in a Mason Jar or an Airtight Container in your refrigerator.

title: How To Make Homemade Sugar-Free White Chocolate Bar
instructions: First of all, prepare all of the ingredients. As a **2 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener**, I have used Allulose, as this gives additional smoothness to those sugar-free white chocolate bars.**2.50 ml Vanilla Extract** extract is really optional just make sure you put only a few drops as this might soften the texture even more.
Cook **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** Cream until Thick at a low temperature for a good 10 - 15 minutes until it reduces in size and fully thickens.
Prepare a double boiler to melt the cacao **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter**.
Melt cocoa **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter** fully.
Once your cocoa **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter** is fully melted, take it out of the double boiler and you can start slowly adding one by one all other ingredients in.
First, add Allulose into the bowl with melted cocoa **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter** and mix it until the sugar **2 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener** fully dissolves.
Once both of the ingredients are fully dissolved, add the thick and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and a few drops of **2.50 ml Vanilla Extract** extract if you wish.
Mix all of the ingredients until they are fully absorbed and melted together.
Once everything is fully melted and incorporated, pour the mixture into your silicone mold.
Place it into the refrigerator and keep it set and chill overnight, best 24hrs.

title: Homemade Keto Dark Chocolate Bar Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
At the same time prepare your double boiler either the traditional way over the stove with a Bowl or a smaller pot above a big pot of boiling water.
Heat up your double boiler and make sure the water is simmering and the bowl is warm.
Into the dry bowl add your **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder** **1/2 Cup Cocoa Butter** and let it melt fully.
Once your **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder** **1/2 Cup Cocoa Butter** is completely melted, add your **1 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener** and let that melt into the liquid fully.
With your Cocoa **2 Tbsp Cocoa Powder**, I would suggest adding it only once you take the bowl out of the double boiler.
As this step is very **Vanilla Essence - optional** it is up to you if you would like to add a few drops of vanilla or not.
Once everything is fully melted pour into your Silicone Chocolate Bar Molds and place it into the refrigerator.
With a dark chocolate bar, it should be ready after about 2 to 3 hours but I usually keep it always cool down overnight and only then store it wherever planned.

title: Sugar-Free Ice Cream Sandwich
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for ice **2 Cups Heavy Cream** cones to make your wafers.

Whisk all of the ingredients together and as of last add **1/4 Tsp Xanthan Gum** Gum.If you would like more detailed information I would suggest visiting a post I have written about Ice **2 Cups Heavy Cream** Cones with full step-by-step’s as well as video.
Using a Pizzelle Maker make wafers one by one as you see in the video.
Immediately when one of the wafers is ready using scissors, cut them into a square shape as they harden and are more difficult to cut later on.
Prepare all of the ingredients for the actual ice **2 Cups Heavy Cream** sandwich making.
First off, whisk a **2 Cups Heavy Cream** cream together with **3 Tbsp Sweetener** until a stiff peak forms and place it aside.
In another bowl, whisk egg whites until fluffy.
Lastly, whisk egg yolks together with **3 Tbsp Sweetener** until you get a beautiful light yellow fluffy consistency. Once done, place aside.
Using a big bowl, place **2 Cups Heavy Cream** cream, egg whites, and egg yolks into it and gently combine them all together.

Once both, the ice-**2 Cups Heavy Cream** wafers and actual ice cream are prepared you can start the assembly. Prepare a square baking pan preferably silicone as that is much easier to take out from once frozen.
Place 4 square wafers onto the bottom of the baking pan.
On top of the wafers, gently scoop out the mixture.
On top of the mixture place another 4 square wafers and cover with cling film.
Place into the freezer overnight.
Once your **1,5 Tbsp Sugar Sweetener**-free ice **2 Cups Heavy Cream** sandwiches are fully frozen and you’re ready to serve, take them out of the freezer.
Let the Ice **2 Cups Heavy Cream** Thaw for a while and place it onto a cutting board, and cut it into smaller portions.

title: How To Make Sugar-Free White Chocolate Chips
ingredients: Optional - few drops of Vanilla Extract
instructions: First of all, prepare all of your ingredients.
On the stove, medium-high heat, cook your **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream until it reduces in size to about half.
Using a double boiler or an Instant Pot, as I did in my video, melt your cocoa **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter** in a big glass bowl.

Once your cocoa **2,5 Tbsp Cocoa Butter** is fully melted, add reduced whipping **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** and sugar **2 Tbsp Allulose Sweetener** (allulose in our case), and make sure all is fully dissolved.
At this stage, you can add a few drops of **Optional - few drops of Vanilla Extract** extract.
Pour all into your chocolate chip mold, making sure each of the tiny holes is filled up fully with the chocolate mixture.
Place into the refrigerator for 24 hours to let the sugar-free white chocolate chips harden fully.

title: How To Make Keto Brown Sugar
instructions: Prepare two Ingredients for making Homemade **1 Cup Crystalized Sugar Sweetener** Free Brown Sugar.
Place a cup of your crystallised **1 Cup Crystalized Sugar Sweetener** into a mixing bowl.
Add one **1 Tablespoon Yacon Syrup** of Yacon Syrup on top of the crystallised **1 Cup Crystalized Sugar Sweetener**.
Using your spatula, start incorporating your **1 Tablespoon Yacon Syrup** into the **1 Cup Crystalized Sugar Sweetener** substitute. Keep mixing and combining for a while.
Keep mixing until you see every single crystal being covered and brown.

title: How To Make Easy Keto Chocolate Fudge Brownies
instructions: Prepare all ingredients together.
Start with adding **1/2 Cup Butter** into your medium heat cooking pot. Let the butter melt and cook it for 2-3 minutes before it browns.
Once your **1/2 Cup Butter** has been cooked for a few minutes, start adding other ingredients.
Let the whole mixture cook for 2-3 minutes, making sure all is incorporated.
Switch the heat off and let the bubbling stop.
Add **1/4 Cup Cocoa** powder and whisk thoroughly.
When all is mixed together, add a few drops of **1 teaspoon Vanilla** extract to add the flavor.
Pour into your prepared Silicone baking container and place it into the fridge overnight.
Once your fudge has been settled and hard, take it out of the fridge and gently peel it from the silicone baking dish.
Place it onto the Parchment Paper, and using a long sharp knife, cut into your desired shapes.

title: How To Make Sugar Free Caramel Sauce
instructions: Prepare all your ingredients for making the best **1/2 cup Brown Sugar Sweetener**-Free Caramel Syrup.
Place **1/4 cup Butter** into your cooking pot and cook for a few minutes on medium heat.
Lower the heat and add brown sugar **1/2 cup Brown Sugar Sweetener**. Whisk until fully dissolved.
Add **1/2 cup Heavy Cream** cream and whisk together once all of your **1/2 cup Brown Sugar Sweetener** sugar has melted.
Return the heat to a medium-high and start cooking your low-carb caramel sauce.
Cook for approximately 10 - 15 minutes until you see the sauce thickening.
Once you see the sauce has thickened, switch the heat off completely.
Add a few drops of **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** Extract and whisk into the mixture.

title: How to Make Sugar Free Maple Syrup
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients you are going to use.
Start by switching your stovetop on.  Add **1 Cup Water** and sweetener into a cooking pot and whisk until all melts.
Let the whole mixture cook for approximately ten to fifteen minutes total time. The minutes depend on how thick you wish your **1 1/2 Tablespoon Maple Extract or Flavoring** syrup to be.
Once you see a part of the **1 Cup Water** has evaporated, it is time to start whisking in **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** Gum. Whisk until you see that all of the Xanthan Gum has been dissolved.

Switch the heat off and add your Maple **1 1/2 Tablespoon Maple Extract or Flavoring**. Depending on the consistency and how much color you would like to add to your maple syrup, add one to two tablespoons of Maple Extract.
Once all is mixed, you can let it cool in the pot to see your desired consistency. Pour it into a pourable jar or simple Mason jar for storage.

title: How To Make Sugar Free Chocolate Syrup
instructions: Super simple to prepare, get your **1 Cup Water (or almond milk)**, cocoa **1/2 Cup Cocoa Powder**, and sweetener on the kitchen counter.
Into your cooking pot, pour **1 Cup Water (or almond milk)** and sweetener. Whisk together.
Switch the heat on a medium-low and start the cooking process.
Add your cocoa **1/2 Cup Cocoa Powder** and whisk all together for the cocoa to incorporate into the simple syrup.

As the sweeteners melt and **1 Cup Water (or almond milk)** starts to bubble, you will realize that some of the water will evaporate. Depending on how thick or thin you want your keto syrup to be, cook for approximately 10 to 15, maybe even 20 minutes. It is advisable to cook it longer on medium heat than shorter on high heat to prevent low carb syrup caramelizing and burning.
When you are happy with your syrup, switch the heat off. Now is the time to add either **1 Teaspoon Vanilla Extract** Extract or any of the additional flavors mentioned above.

title: How To Make Sugar Free Condensed Milk
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients.
Start melting the **1/4 Cup Butter** in your saucepan over medium heat. To prevent the butter from burning, cooking on medium heat is best while watching butter at all times.
Switch the heat entirely and immediately add your sugar **1/2 Cup Sweetener** and mix. Add your **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream.
Whisk all together. Make sure all sugar melts and incorporates into **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and **1/4 Cup Butter**.
Pinch by pinch, add your **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum - optional** Gum, and whisk in between thoroughly, making sure Xanthan gum is fully incorporated.

Switch the heat on and start cooking. Let it cook for approximately 5 minutes until you have a smooth consistency. Once you are happy with the consistency - it will thicken as it cools - switch the heat off.
Add a few drops of **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** Extract, whisk again, and pour into a Mason Jar or any bottle with the lid.

title: How To Make Keto Peanut Butter Fudge
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.

Heat your stove to medium and add **1/2 Cup Butter** into it. Let it slightly melt and add **1/4 Cup Sweetener** as well. Using your whisk, let all sugar sweeteners melt and whisk, so both ingredients get combined.

Add your homemade or store-bought **1 Cup Peanut **1/2 Cup Butter**** butter and whisk again until thoroughly combined. Here you have the option of adding **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** extract if you wish so.

Using a smaller baking sheet, pour the whole mixture and slightly bang against the kitchen counter to eliminate all bubbles. Here I would suggest Silicone Flat-form as it will be much easier to take out later on. Place into the fridge for 3-6 hours, best overnight.

Once your **1 Cup Peanut **1/2 Cup Butter**** Butter Sugar-Free Fudge is hard, gently take it out of your silicone form and place it onto the baking paper. Using a sharp knife, cut into a smaller candy-like shape.
This step is optional, but if you want to pack each fudge, you can simply cut your parchment paper and pack each, as you see in my video.

title: Keto Avocado Popsicles
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients for making the best homemade popsicles. That is avocado, sweetener, **2 Tablespoons Lime Juice**, and **1 Cup Unsweetened Almond Milk** milk in our case.
Add all ingredients into the magic bullet or a blender and blend it thoroughly.

Once fully blended, pick your molds for our healthy popsicles and fill each one of them. You can slightly bang it against the counter to eliminate all of the bubbles. Add a wooden popsicle stick and freeze fully overnight.

If you want to continue adding **2/3 Cup Low Carb Chocolate**, you can melt one of the low-carb chocolate together with cocoa **2 teaspoons Cacao Butter** over a double boiler. Once melted, dip your avocado frozen popsicles in and coat with chocolate. You can also use our Magic Shell recipe for coating if you wish to.

title: Sugar Free Strawberry Jam Recipe
instructions: Prepare ingredients for making your own sugar-free strawberry jam.
Into a pot, add fresh **2 Cups Strawberries**, and start cooking them on medium-high. Stir them regularly to prevent burning on the bottom.
Once you see that your **2 Cups Strawberries** are soft and most of the water has evaporated, using a potato masher, mash them until the texture you like.
Once mashed, add chia **2 Tablespoons White Chia Seeds** or thickener of your choice and cook for about 5 additional minutes.
Pour into your storage container, let it cool, serve and enjoy.

title: Rainbow Keto Chia Pudding
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients, in our case, **2 Cups  Almond Milk** milk and chia **1/2 Cup Chia Seeds**. If you plan to make colorful chia pudding, prepare berries of your choice.

Using our chia pudding ratio of 3 tablespoons of chia **1/2 Cup Chia Seeds** to one cup of **2 Cups  Almond Milk** milk, place it all into the bowl and mix. After about 10 minutes, remix it as some of the chia seeds might accumulate together and form thick uneven balls.
For making our rainbow palette, pick your chosen berries and bring them to boil. Cook them on medium heat, ensuring most of the water evaporates, and you have thick consistency left.

Pour your cooked berry sauce each separately into a glass jar through the sieve to get rid of all the skin and **1/2 Cup Chia Seeds** from the berries.  Depending on the number of colors you have chosen, split your **White - nothing** base chia pudding into glass jars and fill each with the berry sauce selected. Mix until the sauce is incorporated into the pudding and forms a beautiful color.
To start layering, pick your colors and, one by one, start layering your colored **1/2 Cup Chia Seeds** pudding into the serving glasses.
Once your glass is layered with **1/2 Cup Chia Seeds** pudding, you can decorate it with berries or chosen toppings I have mentioned above.

title: Purple Pickled Daikon Radish Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients: fresh **2 Cups cubed daikon**, **1/4 Cup sweetener** of your choice, **1/2 tablespoon salt**, and **3/4 Cup water**. **3/4 Cup white vinegar** is best to have white pure and clear for the color. **1/2 Cup blueberry liquid** juice should be the purest you can get. I have blended my wild blueberries, which I always have in the freezer.

First of is, fully clean and cut your **2 Cups cubed daikon**. Peel the Daikon radish using a vegetable peeler. Take out all of the outer layers of the skin of the radish. Cut the daikon into thicker pieces and cut into same-size radish cubes. Place into the bowl for later.

Our brine does not have to be cooked in a small saucepan, which is great, as more healthiness stays in. Mix the same amount of **3/4 Cup water** and **3/4 Cup white vinegar**. Add **1/4 Cup sweetener** and **1/2 tablespoon salt**. Mix it thoroughly using a whisk until all the cloudy water disappears, the sugar and salt are dissolved, and the liquid is back to clear. Add your **1/2 Cup blueberry liquid** juice and mix once again. The amount of blueberry juice depends on how deep the color you wish to have.

Once your **3/4 Cup white vinegar** mixture is ready, fill your mason jars or airtight container to about 3/4 with **2 Cups cubed daikon** squares. Pour the vinegar mixture making sure all of the cubes are fully submerged. Close the lid entirely and let it sit and marinate at room temperature for a couple of hours for the pickling process to start. Later on, refrigerate for 2 to 3 days.

title: Pickled Daikon Radish Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for preparing pickled **2 Cups Cubed Daikon**.

Fully clean your radish. Using a vegetable slicer, clean the outer skin and remove any impurities. Using a sharp knife, first cut radish into approximately half an inch thick slices. Once you have sliced, cut again into long stripes, again half-inch thick. Those stripes are cut into cubes again half an inch.

Prepare your liquid. It is super easy to make. In a jar, mix **1 Cup Water** with **1 Cup White Vinegar** and add **1/2 Cup Sweetener** and **1/2 Tablespoon Salt**. Mix everything thoroughly using a whisk until all is dissolved and the liquid becomes clear again.
Using either mason jars or airtight glass containers, fill those with **2 Cups Cubed Daikon** cubes to approximately 3/4. Pour the liquid into each jar to fully cover the cubes.

Gently move all the jars onto a kitchen counter. Let sit for approximately an hour for all to set and start the pickling process. Later on, fully close and place the jars to refrigerate. Let it marinate for two to three days to get the best flavor.

title: Sugar-Free Keto Cranberry Sauce Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients.
First goes heating up the **1/3 Cup Brown Sugar Substitute** sugar. Be careful not to overheat it. Using low heat, let the sugar melt fully.
Once you see the brown sugar **1/3 Cup Brown Sugar Substitute** almost melted, quickly add **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries**.
Using a silicone spatula, gently coat all of the **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** with melted **1/3 Cup Brown Sugar Substitute** sugar.
Once you have coated the **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** with melted **1/3 Cup Brown Sugar Substitute** sugar, add a bit of **1/2 Cup Water** and start the cooking process.

Let **2 Cups Fresh Cranberries** cook together with **1/2 Cup Water** on slow heat. This takes approximately 10 minutes. Press on all cranberries to crack them open and release the extra sauce. Switch the heat off and let the sauce to thicken.

title: Keto Meringue Frosting - Sugar Free Swiss Meringue
instructions: Prepare both ingredients and set up your double boiler. ch you add a bowl of a stand mixer as I have made it. You only need one egg white, which is best at room temperature.
Pour your **3/4 Cup Simple Syrup Clear** syrup onto the bowl on top of simmering water. Using a hand mixer, start whisking the syrup.
Once you see bubbles forming, add the egg white and beat on medium speed. Be careful not to burn the mixture.
Keep mixing until you get frothy consistency and see that the texture is not changing anymore and frosting is smooth and is fully incorporated.
Clean up the bottom of the bowl with a kitchen towel and place it immediately onto the kitchen machine. Turn the mixer on high and whisk until full stiff peak forms and your frosting become glossy.

title: Best Keto Eggnog Recipe
instructions: Prepare your egg yolks, sweetener, **2/3 Cups Heavy Whipping Cream** cream, **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** of your choice, rum, **Xanthan Gum - Optional** gum, and vanilla extract.
In a big bowl, place all raw egg yolks together with a sweetener.
Using either a hand whisk or hand mixer, whisk all the egg yolks together with sweetener until you get a beautiful creamy yellow egg mixture.

Start adding **2/3 Cups Heavy Whipping Cream** cream once your egg yolks are whisked together with sweeteners. Keep whisking and adding cream until everything is combined. Next comes **1/2 Cup Almond Milk** milk or a milk of your choice, which you just pour into the bowl and mix again.
Add a splash of **Vanilla Extract** rum and mix together. Adding xanthan gum is **Xanthan Gum - Optional** depending on whether you would like your eggnog thick.
Using a sieve, let the whole liquid run through it, making sure you catch all the lumps, which might sometimes appear while adding **Xanthan Gum - Optional** Gum.

title: Keto Almond Crescent Cookies
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients and place them one by one into a large bowl big enough to mix them all. At the same time, heat the oven to 160 degrees Celsius or 320 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a silicone spatula, mix the ingredients properly into one smooth dough.
Once the dough is mixed, place it into the medium bowl in the refrigerator for 30 minutes to 1 hour. For the dough to roll and shape, it needs to be cold.
Take only ¼ of the dough and place it on parchment paper for rolling. Keep the rest in the refrigerator until you are finished.

Roll 1/4 of the dough into a log. Using your spatula, separate that log into smaller pieces the same size. One by one, take each piece, roll it with your hand into a small log, and form a crescent shape. Place each on a prepared baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Once you are finished, take another ¼ of the dough and repeat the steps.
Once all moon-shaped cookies are on the baking tray, place them in the preheated oven and bake for 10 minutes until lightly golden brown.

After the cookies are baked, take them from the oven and while still warm, dust them with **1/2 Cup Vanilla Whey Protein Powder** protein powder using a sieve. Dusting the cookies while still warm will help the protein coating stick onto the cookies and stays put. Do not touch the cookies while warm. They will crumble in your hands. They need to cool on the pan thoroughly to harden a bit.

title: Easy Instant Pot Keto Cheesecake
instructions: Using a mixer, beat on low speed **4 Cups Plain Greek Yogurt** of your choice and sugar **1 Cup Sugar Substitute** to get a smooth batter.
Pour the cheesecake mixture into the baking pan, which fits into the Instant Pot. I always line the bottom of the pan with parchment paper for easier cleaning afterward.
Make sure the top of the pan is fully covered. I also add the tissue just underneath to soak part of the moisture.
Folding aluminum foil into a long sling and placing it underneath the baking pan will allow you to easily manoeuver the baking pan into and from the Instant Pot.

Place the trivet that came with your Instant Pot into the pressure cooker pot and add 1 cup of water. Place the baking pan onto the trivet and close the lid. Switch on high pressure and pressure cook for 40 minutes.

Once done, release any remaining pressure. Open the pot and remove the cheesecake. Your cheesecake should be jiggly. Allow to cool, change the paper towel from inside and refrigerate the cheesecake to cool. Chill the cheesecake for at least a few hours. Best overnight.

title: Sugar Free Keto Meringue Cookies Recipe
instructions: First, turn the oven to a low temperature. Start preparing all of your ingredients which are only a **3/4 Cup **1 Tablespoon Powder Sugar Alternative (optional)**-Free Simple Syrup** liquid sweetener and an egg white.
Using a double boiler, or as you see in the video, in my case, a cooking pot with the bowl from the kitchen machine, bring it all to boiling.
Once the ball is warm, place your liquid sweetener and egg white, and using a hand whisk, beat the egg whites until you get a white foamy consistency.

Once you get the white foamy consistency, stop the double boiling process and dry your bowl from the outside. Place it into your kitchen machine and continue to beat on a medium speed to high until you get a beautiful stiff white peak.
Prepare your piping back with a tip you prefer.

Using a piping bag with a tip, add meringue mixture to a piping bag and start piping little meringue cookies onto your parchment paper lined baking sheet. Allow the cookies to set for a minute or two. Place into the oven and bake at 90 Celsius or 195 Fahrenheit for 2 to 3 hours. Depending on which liquid sweetener you have used, your meringue cookies might get only partially dry. You can either keep baking it for longer in the oven or place them into a dehydrator to fully dry and crisp.

title: Keto Lemon Curd Recipe
instructions: First, prepare all of your ingredients. Make sure you use fresh **1/4 cup Freshly Squeezed lemon juice** juice and lemon **1/2  Lemon zest** from the organic lemons.
Add the **1/4 cup Butter** with a **1/4 cup Sweetener** - allulose in our case - into a saucepan over low heat.

Once the sugar and **1/4 cup Butter** are melted, add **1/4 cup Freshly Squeezed lemon juice** **1/2  Lemon zest**, lemon juice, and 3 egg yolks. Whisk it all together and cook on low heat until it thickens. Be aware that the thickening will intensify after cooling much more. Remove from heat and let it cool.

title: Korean Pickled Radish
instructions: Prepare all ingredients together. The amount of **1/2 Cup pure beetroot juice** juice depends on the color you want to achieve. For very light pink, use only half.
Using a vegetable peeler, clean the outer layer of the skin of your radish. With a sharp knife, cut the radish into thick slices and then sliced radish into squares, as you see in the video.

To prepare your brine, you will need the same amount of **3/4 Cup water** and white **3/4 Cup white vinegar**. Add sugar and **1/2 tablespoon salt** to those, and use a whisk or a spoon. Mix it all until the water becomes clear again, and both salt and **1/4 Cup sweetener** fully dissolve.
Into the whole **3/4 Cup white vinegar** mixture, add **1/2 Cup pure beetroot juice** juice. This will add a bit of sweetness and color to your radish once they are all done.
Add the radish cubes into your jars to about 3/4. Pour the **3/4 Cup white vinegar** mixture and close the lid. Place into the fridge and let it pickle for at least 2 to 3 days.

title: Dalgona Coffee Keto Chia Pudding
instructions: As a first step, prepare all of the ingredients for the **1/4 Cup Chia Seeds White** pudding and **2 Tablespoon Instant Coffee** topping.
Add the Chia **1/4 Cup Chia Seeds White** into a magic bullet or food processor and grind.

Once your chia **1/4 Cup Chia Seeds White** are blended into a powder, add a nut **1.5 Cup Nut Milk** to the same container and **2 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute** sweetener. Close the lid and remix it.
Pour into the glasses in which you plan to serve your pudding and store in the refrigerator until you are done with topping.

Place **2 Tablespoon Instant Coffee** coffee, **2 Tablespoon Sugar Substitute** sweetener, and boiling water in equal parts into the food processor and start mixing it. It will take approximately 3 to 4 minutes until the foam begins forming.

title: Keto Peanut Butter Cookies Recipe
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients together for easy assembly. At the same time, preheat the oven to 180 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit to prepare everything.
Prepare a large mixing bowl. Add all of the ingredients in and prepare for mixing.
Combine **1 Cup Peanut Butter** butter with all ingredients using either a hand mixer or a silicone spatula and mix to smooth cookie dough.

Using a cookie scoop, a mini ice cream scoop, or two teaspoons, scoop all the cookie dough balls onto a baking cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone baking sheet. Make sure you keep space in between, as you will still have to flatten them down. Using a fork, you can slowly press on each cookie, giving them the famous criss-cross design. You can also use your hand. Make sure your hands are moist, as the mixture might stick on. You can decorate them in the middle with one piece of a **1 Cup Peanut Butter**.
Bake the cookies in the oven for approximately 15 minutes. Once removed from the oven, allow the cookies to cool completely before touching them.

title: How To Make Sugar Free Marshmallows
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
If you’re using gelatin **4  Gelatine Sheets**, place them into the **3 Tablespoons Water** for a few minutes to soften.

Melt the **100 grams Sugar Sweetener - Xylitol** with **3 Tablespoons Water** in a saucepan and place it on the stove. Let it boil for 2-3 minutes in a saucepan over medium heat, and add your softened gelatin **4  Gelatine Sheets** without the remaining water. Make sure that the gelatin dissolves entirely.

Once your hot syrup is prepared and the gelatin mixture is fully dissolved, pour everything into your bowl of a stand mixer with whisk attachment and turn the mixer on a high speed. At this stage, you can add the vanilla extract for extra flavor. Keep mixing until the liquid triples in the size and the marshmallow fluff forms.
Here you see the picture of how the marshmallow fluff is supposed to look. In this step, you must work fast as the marshmallow mixture gets thick easily and quickly.

Have a square container or any container prepared in advance and covered with cling foil. Pour the whole marshmallow fluff into the container and ensure everything is evenly smoothed. Try to use a rubber spatula. Allow the mixture to sit on the kitchen counter to set for at least 8 hours or overnight.
Cut into the desired shape and enjoy it. Toast them over a fire whenever ready.

title: Currant Fruit Keto Fluff Dessert
instructions: Gather all the necessary ingredients for your red **1/2 Cup Red Currant** keto fluff dessert. It includes fresh red currants, your choice of powdered **1/4 Cup Sweetener** and separate egg whites.
Combine the fresh red currants and powdered **1/4 Cup Sweetener** in a magic bullet or blender. Blend them until you have a smooth and well-combined mixture.
In a separate mixing bowl, beat the egg whites with **1/4 Cup Sweetener** until they reach stiff peaks. Next, gently fold the prepared fruit mixture into the whipped egg whites.
Transfer the fluff mousse mixture into a piping or plastic food storage bag.
Pipe the red **1/2 Cup Red Currant** fluff into individual serving dishes or dessert cups. As a final touch, garnish each portion with a few pieces of fresh red currants on top.

title: Chocolate Ripple No Bake Keto Cheesecake Recipe
instructions: To make the cheesecake, prepare all ingredients in advance.
Depending on the **12 Sheets Gelatine** you will use, prepare it in advance. Heat your **2/3 Cup Heavy Cream** cream on the stove or microwave and pour it into the jar you will mix with gelatine.
Add **12 Sheets Gelatine** or gelatine sheets into the jar, and mix it thoroughly with **2/3 Cup Heavy Cream** cream with your hand blender.
Place it on the side.

To make the filling, take a big bowl filled with yogurt and add the sugar **3/4 Cup Sweetener** of your choice. Hand mix the powdered sugar into the yogurt first ( so it does not dust your whole kitchen) and switch on your hand mixer. Mix fully. Slowly add the **2/3 Cup Heavy Cream** cream **12 Sheets Gelatine** mixture to the yogurt and keep mixing. Ensure the mixture is not hot; otherwise, your yogurt will become very liquid.

In this step, you can prepare three different jars big enough for your hand mixer to fit. If you will use the exact measurements of our yogurts, place 1,5 cups into the biggest jar—3/4 of a cup of yogurt into the second jar and half a cup into the smallest. Next to it, prepare a bowl with half a tablespoon of cocoa for the biggest jar, two **5 Tablespoons Cocoa** for the middle, and 2 1/2 tablespoons for the smallest jar.
When all three of the jars are filled, pour the rest of the remaining yogurt mixture into your prepared baking form.

Add **5 Tablespoons Cocoa** inside each jar, and with your hand mixer, start mixing it. You should be able to whip up three different colors of brown. The biggest jar should have the lightest color, and the smallest one should have the darkest color.

Once the jars are thoroughly mixed and you are satisfied with the colors, we can start pouring and making the ripple design. Take the baking form with the white yogurt insight and start with the lightest brown color. Pour it slowly on top of the white yogurt directly into the middle. Do not shake or touch or move. Just pour all the mixture into the center. Once the first mixture is poured, take the second one and start pouring again into the middle of the baking form. Follow the last step the same way and pour the darkest brown into the middle. In this step, the last parts are getting too thick to pour. Place it into the microwave for a few seconds, and the mixture should liquidize again.

To help the bubbles disappear and let the cake set a bit, slightly bang the whole cake against the table. Make sure the colors will not mix. Check the video for a better understanding. Gently lift from the table and refrigerate the cheesecake to cool down for at least 5 to 8 hours, best overnight.

title: Keto Meringue Frosting - Sugar Free Swiss Meringue
instructions: Prepare both ingredients and set up your double boiler. ch you add a bowl of a stand mixer as I have made it. You only need one egg white, which is best at room temperature.
Pour your **3/4 Cup Simple Syrup Clear** syrup onto the bowl on top of simmering water. Using a hand mixer, start whisking the syrup.
Once you see bubbles forming, add the egg white and beat on medium speed. Be careful not to burn the mixture.
Keep mixing until you get frothy consistency and see that the texture is not changing anymore and frosting is smooth and is fully incorporated.
Clean up the bottom of the bowl with a kitchen towel and place it immediately onto the kitchen machine. Turn the mixer on high and whisk until full stiff peak forms and your frosting become glossy.

title: Sugar Free Keto Simple Syrup Recipe
instructions: First, prepare your ingredients. For a **1/2 Cup Powdered Sweetener**, I suggest allulose, monk fruit, or xylitol. It is best to have either in a powdered version as it will dissolve much easier. If you only have a crystallized version, blend it in your blender, or coffee grainer. **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan** gum is optional, but it gives you a more significant volume of this fantastic low-carb simple syrup.
Start by switching your stovetop on. Add **1/2 Cup Water** and **1/2 Cup Powdered Sweetener** into a cooking pot and whisk until all melts.

Let the whole mixture cook for approximately 15 minutes total time. The minutes depend on how thick you wish your simple sugar to be. If you want to add **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan** gum to thicken a bit and have a more clear liquid, 15 minutes is about the time. If you do not wish to add xanthan gum, keep cooking on a lower heat until most of the **1/2 Cup Water** dissolves, and you will be left with a beautiful, thicker consistency.
