Once your 15 minutes are over, and you see the sugar mixture slightly reducing in volume, add pinch by pinch **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan** gum. At this stage, you must keep whisking vigorously for xanthan gum to dissolve. Otherwise, you might have a few lumps left. It is not a problem, and in my tips and tricks below, I have mentioned the solution. Pour into a glass jar or any of your glass containers and enjoy.

title: Sugar Free BBQ Sauce Recipe
instructions: The first thing to do is prepare all your ingredients. For the **1/4 Cup Worcestershire Sauce** sauce, homemade is always the best choice for recipes like this. If you do not have **1 Cup **2  Tablespoons Brown Sugar Sweetener** Free Ketchup** ready, a sugar-free tomato sauce is okay, or make your own by blending tomatoes using fresh tomato, dried tomatoes, or tomato powder. For the seasoning, mix and match garlic powder, onion powder, or **1 Tablespoon  Smoked Paprika Powder** to suit your taste preference for the BBQ sauce.

Mix the ingredients in a cooking pot on medium heat, starting with the **1/4 Cup Worcestershire Sauce** sauce and then add brown **2  Tablespoons Brown Sugar Sweetener**, **1 Tablespoon Tabasco**, and **2 Tablespoons Vinegar**. Mix with a whisk until they are thoroughly combined. Make sure that you are using medium heat only.

Add the **1 Tablespoon  Mustard** after the **1 Cup Sugar Free Ketchup**, and then mix again. You can use any mixing tool, but a whisk is perfect for easily mixing the thick ingredients and combining them with the runny ones. Simmer the **1/4 Cup Worcestershire Sauce** for a minute for the ingredients to combine.

The last to go is the smoked **1 Tablespoon  Smoked Paprika Powder**. Add it in, wait for it to dissolve, and mix again for the last time, then cook. Bring the **1/4 Cup Worcestershire Sauce** to a boil and cook for a few minutes until the sauce starts getting thicker.

title: Low Carb Taiwanese Popcorn Chicken Recipe
instructions: First, prepare your **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** by washing and chopping it into small pieces for a perfect popcorn chicken size, but keep it manageable. Prepare the seasonings in a small storage container with the right measurements. This will make it easier for you to prepare the whole recipe. Do the same for the liquid ingredients like soy **2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce**, **1 Tablespoon White Wine** wine, and egg whites. Also, prepare the ingredients for coating the chicken and just set them aside. You can prepare them for later when the chicken is marinating.

In a bowl, add all the seasonings to marinate the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts**. Add the soy **2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce** first, followed by all the dry seasonings. Add the egg whites and **1 Tablespoon White Wine** wine last, then mix well with a whisk until all the ingredients are fully combined.

After making the seasoning mixture, pour into the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** pieces and mix using a rubber spatula until they are evenly coated. Seasoning the chicken is essential as the taste of the final dish should be infused with each chicken piece. Cover with a plastic or cling wrap and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for maximum flavor.

While the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** is marinating, prepare the coating by adding the **1/2 Cup Breadcrumbs**, **1/2 Cup Ground Almond Flour** pork **1/2 Cup Ground Pork Rinds**, almond meal, and baking **1/2 teaspoon 5 Spice Powder** to a separate mixing bowl. Whisk them all together until fully combined. Once the marinated chicken pieces are ready, toss them into the mixture and coat them evenly. I use a tweezer to coat each chicken and set it aside before frying. You can also coat them with your bare hands. Set aside the coated chicken and prepare your frying pan with enough oil, which must be deep-fried.

After heating the olive oil to 350°F (175°C), fry the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** one by one until they turn golden brown and crispy. Do it for about 3-4 minutes per batch. Make sure to make some space for them to be fried evenly. While frying, gently add the **1 Cup Fresh Basil** leaves and fry them with the chicken.

Drain the excess olive oil using a strainer once the **2 Pieces Chicken Breasts** pops are cooked and super crispy. Remember to include the fried **1 Cup Fresh Basil** leaves when you take out the chicken popcorn. You will serve them together. Place them in a bowl, and they are ready to enjoy.

title: Sugar Free Lavender Simple Syrup Recipe
instructions: Prepare first all the ingredients needed for a smooth and easy process later. You can use allulose, monk fruit, or xylitol as sweeteners. They are all good, but make sure to use powdered ones because they dissolve easily.

Start heating your pot and add the **1/2 Cup Water** and **1/2 Cup Sweetener (Powdered)**. Mix them with a whisk until the powdered sugar completely melts. I am using 1/2 cup of water, but if you want to make a bigger batch, you can do 1 cup or 2.

Once you are done with the **1/2 Cup Water** mixture, add three tablespoons of **4 TBS Lavender (Food Grade)** to the pot. Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture simmer for about 15 minutes. Heat and allow the lavender to infuse its flavor. After the cooking, use the filter to strain the lavender buds or flowers from the pot. Strain half of them and leave the other half in there.

After straining half of the flowers, add enough **1/2 Teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum and 1 tablespoon of fresh **4 TBS Lavender (Food Grade)** to color the syrup. Mix until the xanthan gum dissolves, and then switch off the heat. Close the lid and let it steep for 30 more minutes for the best flavor.

title: Sugar Free Rainbow Pickled Daikon
instructions: Prepare all the ingredients needed. Start by peeling the **6 Cups Daikon (Cubed)** radishes and slicing them into small cubes. I suggest using any sugar-free sweeteners, we need one that dissolves quickly. Prepare distilled **1.5 Cup Vinegar (White)** for brighter daikon colors. Place the **1/2 Cup Beetroot liquid** juice and **1/2 Cup Blueberry liquid** liquid in small containers and prepare enough amount for the color you want to achieve.

In a container, combine the same amount of **1.5 Cup Water** and **1.5 Cup Vinegar (White)** for the brine and add the sugar and **1/2 tablespoon Salt**. Mix it with a whisk or spoon until the salt and sweeteners dissolve and the water turns clear again. Once the brine is prepared, divide it into separate bowls and add the **1/2 Cup Beetroot liquid** and **1/2 Cup Blueberry liquid** liquids to the two bowls, leaving the other white. After preparing the pickling liquid, place the sliced **6 Cups Daikon (Cubed)** into jars and pour the different colored brine over the radishes, ensuring they are fully covered.
Seal the jars tightly and refrigerate them for at least 24 hours. The longer they sit, the more flavorful they will become.

title: Orange Chicken Sauce
instructions: Before you start, gather all your ingredients. Having everything prepped will make the cooking process smoother and more efficient. Measure out the **1/4 Cup Broth**, rice wine **3 Tablespoons Rice Wine Vinegar**, soy **2 Tablespoons Soy sauce**, sweetener, and spices to ensure you have everything on hand.

Set the pan on medium-high heat. Pour 2 tablespoons sesame oil and sauté the minced **3 Pieces Garlic Cloves (Minced)** until fragrant. This step adds a rich flavor base to your **2 Tablespoons Soy sauce**, infusing it with a savory depth. Stir frequently to prevent burning and keep it moving.

Add the sweetener, chicken **1/4 Cup Broth**, **2 Tablespoons Orange Zest** zest and fresh **1/4 teaspoon Ginger (Fresh)**. Continue to cook together for a minute, allowing the citrus and spice to meld beautifully. This improves the overall aroma of the **2 Tablespoons Soy sauce** and sets the foundation for its bold taste.

Pour in the rice wine **3 Tablespoons Rice Wine Vinegar** and soy **2 Tablespoons Soy sauce**. Whisk well to combine. Then, add **1/4 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum to thicken the sauce. Keep stirring as the mixture simmers to avoid clumps and ensure everything blends smoothly.

Using an immersion blender, blend the **2 Tablespoons Soy sauce** until it reaches a smooth consistency. If you prefer a chunkier sauce, you can blend less. This step is essential to create a creamy, rich sauce that perfectly coats your fried chicken **3 Pieces Garlic Cloves (Minced)**.

title: Korean Sauce For BBQ
ingredients: 3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Maple Syrup (or Liquid Sweetener)
instructions: Gather all your ingredients and measure them out to ensure a smooth cooking process. Mince the **3 Pieces Garlic Cloves (Minced)** and **2 teaspoons Grated Ginger (Fresh)** for easy sautéing. Keep everything within arm’s reach for a hassle-free experience.

Heat **2 teaspoons Sesame Oil** oil in a cooking pot over medium heat until aromatic. Add the minced **3 Pieces Garlic Cloves (Minced)** and sauté until fragrant, being careful not to burn it. This step infuses the oil with rich flavor, creating the base for your **1/4 Cup Soy Sauce**.

Slowly pour the **1/2 Cup Broth** into the pot, stirring constantly to combine. Sprinkle in the red **1/4 teaspoon Red Pepper Flakes (Crushed)** flakes. Slowly add **1/2 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum while whisking to prevent lumps, and let the mixture simmer until it thickens slightly. This creates the silky texture characteristic of Korean BBQ **1/4 Cup Soy Sauce**.

Add soy **1/4 Cup Soy Sauce**, **3 Tablespoons Sugar-Free Maple Syrup (or Liquid Sweetener)** syrup, **2 teaspoons Grated Ginger (Fresh)**, and rice **1 Tablespoon Rice Vinegar** to the pot. Stir well and let the sauce simmer for a few minutes to melt the flavors together. Once done, taste and adjust the seasoning before transferring the sauce to a bowl for serving or storing.

title: Sugar-Free Strawberry Ice Cream
ingredients: ½ Cup Powdered Xylitol (or Allulose Sweetener)
instructions: Start by placing your ice cream maker bowl in the freezer overnight or for at least 10 hours. This ensures the bowl is properly frozen and ready to churn your ice cream smoothly. While it chills, gather all your ingredients, including **3 Cups Heavy Cream** cream, **½ Cup Powdered Xylitol (or Allulose Sweetener)** Xylitol or Allulose Sweetener, pure **¾ teaspoon Pure Stevia Powder** powder, **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract** extract, **1 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum, **2 Pieces Whole Eggs**, and **1½ Cups Strawberries (fresh or frozen)**.
Crack the **2 Pieces Whole Eggs** and the extra yolk into a mixing bowl and whisk until smooth and fully combined. This will form the rich base of your ice **3 Cups Heavy Cream**.

In a small saucepan, combine the **3 Cups Heavy Cream** cream, sweetener, **1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract**, and **1 teaspoon Xanthan Gum** gum. Heat over medium until the mixture starts to bubble; do not let it boil. Once you see the first signs of bubbling, turn off the heat right away.

Slowly pour about ½ cup of the hot **3 Cups Heavy Cream** into the whisked **2 Pieces Whole Eggs** while stirring constantly to temper them, then return the mixture to the pot and whisk until fully combined. Pour the warm custard base into a large bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let it cool at room temperature for 2 hours. Afterward, transfer it to the fridge and chill for at least 2 more hours until completely cold.

While your base chills in the fridge, chop your **1½ Cups Strawberries (fresh or frozen)** into small, bite-sized chunks. Keep them refrigerated so they’re cold when added later. This helps them blend more evenly during the churning process.

Once your base is thoroughly chilled and your bowl is frozen, attach the ice **3 Cups Heavy Cream** maker to your machine. Pour the base into the frozen bowl and churn for about 20 minutes, or until it reaches soft-serve consistency. Add in the chopped **1½ Cups Strawberries (fresh or frozen)** during the last few minutes of churning.

If you don’t have an ice **3 Cups Heavy Cream** maker, stir the chopped **1½ Cups Strawberries (fresh or frozen)** directly into the cold base. Pour the mixture into a freezer-safe container. If using **½ Cup Powdered Xylitol (or Allulose Sweetener)**, freeze directly and thaw slightly before serving.

title: Low Carb Berry Cream Dessert Cups
ingredients: 1 Handful Low Carb Cookies (Optional: or almonds, crushed handful)
instructions: Wash and slice the **1 Cup Strawberries (sliced)**, and rinse the **1 Cup Blueberries (fresh)**. Let the berries drain well so they don’t water down the dessert. Set out the **1 Cup Heavy Whipping Cream** cream, softened cream **½ Cup Cream Cheese (softened)**, powdered **2 Tablespoons Sweetener (Powdered)**, **1 teaspoon Vanilla extract** extract, and optional toppings like crushed keto **1 Handful Low Carb Cookies (Optional: or almonds, crushed handful)** or almonds.

In a mixing bowl, combine the softened cream **½ Cup Cream Cheese (softened)** with the powdered **2 Tablespoons Sweetener (Powdered)** and **1 teaspoon Vanilla extract** extract. Beat everything together until the mixture becomes silky and smooth. This creates the base for your creamy dessert filling.

In a separate bowl, pour in the **1 Cup Heavy Whipping **½ Cup Cream Cheese (softened)**** whipping cream. Use a hand mixer or whisk to beat the cream until stiff peaks form. This step adds lightness and volume to the final dessert.

Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream **½ Cup Cream Cheese (softened)** mixture. Use a spatula and a light hand to avoid deflating the whipped cream. The result should be a fluffy and airy cream base, perfect for layering.

In your serving glasses or jars, spoon in a layer of the **½ Cup Cream Cheese (softened)** mixture, followed by sliced **1 Cup Strawberries (sliced)** and **1 Cup Blueberries (fresh)**. Repeat the layers if your cup size allows. Finish with a sprinkle of crushed keto **1 Handful Low Carb Cookies (Optional: or almonds, crushed handful)** or almonds on top and chill for at least 1 hour before serving.

title: TikTok Viral Onion Boil Recipe
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190 °Celsius) and prepare a baking dish. Gather your ingredients and have everything measured and ready. Set aside foil for wrapping the **2 Pieces Sweet Onions (large )** later.

Peel the **2 Pieces Sweet Onions (large )** and cut a 1-inch opening at the top of each one. Use a small spoon to scoop out the center, creating a deep well about halfway down. Drop ½ tablespoon of **2 Tablespoons Butter (divided)** into the hollow center of each **2 teaspoons Chili Onion Crunch**.

In a small bowl, melt the remaining tablespoon of **2 Tablespoons Butter (divided)**. Stir in the chili onion **2 teaspoons Chili Onion Crunch**, **1 teaspoon Garlic (minced )**, **1 teaspoon Paprika (smoked or regular)**, Old Bay, Cajun **1 teaspoon Cajun Seasoning**, **1 teaspoon Italian Herbs** herbs, **½ teaspoon Salt**, and **½ teaspoon Black Pepper**. Pour this flavorful mixture over each onion, filling the wells and coating the outsides.

Wrap each tightly in foil and place the **2 teaspoons Chili Onion Crunch** into the baking dish. Bake for 50–60 minutes or until the **2 Pieces Sweet Onions (large )** are fork-tender, adding more time if needed. For a caramelized finish, unwrap and broil for 2–3 minutes before serving.

title: Keto Onion Rings
instructions: Start by gathering your ingredients and ensuring your air fryer is ready to go. Slice the **2 Pieces Onions** into thick rings, making sure they're uniform in size. Preheat your air fryer so it's hot and ready when you're finished prepping.

Combine the **3 Tablespoons Almond Flour** flour, **1/2 Cup Breadcrumbs**, **1/2 Tablespoon Granulated Garlic** **1/4 Tablespoon Onion Powder**, onion powder, **1/4 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika**, **1/2 teaspoon Salt**, and black **1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper** in a bowl. Whisk the eggs until well-beaten in a separate bowl to create your wet coating. This will give your onion rings the crispy texture and flavor you want.

Dip each **1/4 Tablespoon Onion Powder** ring into the egg wash, making sure it’s fully coated. Then, dip the ring into the dry mixture and press gently to ensure an even coating. Repeat with all the onion rings, ensuring they’re fully coated with wet and dry layers.

Preheat your air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) and lightly grease the basket with EVO oil to prevent sticking. Arrange the coated **1/4 Tablespoon Onion Powder** rings in a single layer, ensuring they are not overcrowded for even cooking. Air fry for 8 minutes, allowing them to crisp up and turn golden brown.

Carefully flip each **1/4 Tablespoon Onion Powder** ring using tongs to ensure an even crisp on both sides. Continue air frying for another 5 minutes at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) until they are perfectly crispy and golden. Remove from the air fryer and serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauce.

title: How To Sautee Kale
ingredients: 1 ½ Pounds Kale (chopped and stems discarded)
instructions: Start by heating a splash of **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Let the oil warm up until it shimmers—that’s your sign it’s hot enough. This sets the stage for the flavors to really bloom.

Toss in red **1 teaspoon Pepper (to taste)** **1 teaspoon Crushed Red Pepper Flakes (optional)** and let them sizzle for just a few seconds. This releases their spicy aroma into the oil. If you’re a fan of heat, this small step makes a big impact.

Add the **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (thinly sliced)** and sauté until it’s just fragrant, don’t let it brown. Stir constantly to keep it moving and prevent burning. This infuses the oil with garlicky goodness.

Crank the heat to high and toss in the **1 ½ Pounds Kale (chopped and stems discarded)** along with your **½ Cup Vegetable Broth (or Water)** stock. Give everything a good stir, then cover the skillet and let it steam for about 5 minutes. Remove the lid and cook uncovered until most of the liquid has evaporated and the kale is nice and tender. Season with **1 Pinch Salt (to taste)** and **1 teaspoon Pepper (to taste)** to taste. Finish with a drizzle of **2 Tablespoons Balsamic Vinegar** vinegar. Serve it warm and enjoy the bold, savory flavor.

title: Easy Way To Reheat Fried Chicken in Air Fryer
instructions: Take the leftover fried **2 Pieces Fried Chicken** out of the fridge and let it sit briefly at room temperature. Preheat the air fryer to 430°Farenheit (220°Celsius).
Arrange the **2 Pieces Fried Chicken** in a single layer in the basket without overlapping so the hot air can circulate evenly.
Air fry for 4 minutes, flip, then cook for another 4 minutes until hot and crispy, checking the internal temperature before serving.

title: How To Make Hibiscus Tea
instructions: Prepare the dried **2 Tablespoons Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** and boil enough **4 Cups Water (Boiling)** to infuse the tea later.
Using a mortar and pestle, gently crush the dried **2 Tablespoons Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** to release its flavor even better. Do not crush too much. Gently squeeze their flavor.

Place the **2 Tablespoons Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** onto the infuser or middle of the glass pitcher and add the boiling **4 Cups Water (Boiling)**. Pour the water a little bit higher so that the pressure of the water will break the dried flowers and extract more juice from them. Let it steep for 10 minutes and wait for the color and flavor to mix the hibiscus flower and water through the tea infuser. If you don't have infusing equipment, you can also use a fine mesh strainer to extract the hibiscus juice.
After the infusion, remove the **2 Tablespoons Hibiscus Flowers (Dried)** and enjoy the tea with a squeeze of lime juice or lemon juice, depending on your taste preference.

title: Crispy Pork Chops in an Air Fryer
instructions: Pat the pork **2 Pieces Bone-in Pork Chops** dry and preheat the air fryer to 380°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) for 3 minutes so it’s hot and ready.

Stir together oil, **1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar Substitute** sweetener, **1 teaspoon Dried Sage**, **1/4 teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, **1.5 teaspoons Salt**, and **1/4 teaspoon Black Pepper** until well combined.
Rub the mixture over both sides of the pork **2 Pieces Bone-in Pork Chops** and let them sit for 10 minutes to absorb the flavor.
Cook in a single layer at 380°ahrenheitF (190°Celsius) for 5 minutes per side until the internal temperature reaches 145°Fahrenheit (63°Celsius), then rest 3–5 minutes before serving.

title: Cold Green Bean Salad with Dijon Vinaigrette
ingredients: ½ Piece Romaine Lettuce (head, thinly sliced into ribbons)
instructions: Boil **1 Pound Green Beans (ends trimmed)** beans in salted water for 2 minutes until crisp-tender, transfer to an ice bath to stop cooking, then drain and pat dry.

Whisk **3 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil, Dijon **1 teaspoon Dijon Mustard**, **½ teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, apple cider **1 Tablespoon Apple Cider Vinegar**, **1 teaspoon Sugar-Free Honey**, **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)**, and **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)** until smooth and emulsified, then set aside.

Slice the **½ Piece Romaine Lettuce (head, thinly sliced into ribbons)**, trim the **1 Pound Green Beans (ends trimmed)** beans, thinly slice the red **¼ Cup Red Onion (thin slicess)**, and prepare the **¼ Cup Fresh Basil (loosely packed)** leaves so everything is ready to assemble.

Combine **½ Piece Romaine Lettuce (head, thinly sliced into ribbons)**, **1 Pound Green Beans (ends trimmed)** beans, **¼ Cup Fresh Basil (loosely packed)**, and **¼ Cup Red Onion (thin slicess)**, toss with half the dressing, then top with goat **2 ounces Goat Cheese (crumbled)**, **2 Tablespoons Almonds (sliced)**, **2 Tablespoons Walnuts (chopped)**, remaining dressing, and a final sprinkle of **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)** and **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)**.

title: Portobello Mushroom Keto Burger
instructions: Prepare and wash **Portobello Mushrooms**. Clean them well and fully dry.
Take out the stem of each mushroom and with your spoon or hands clean all of the dark grills underneath.
Place all of the **Portobello Mushrooms** on the grill.

Depending on what type of Grill you have, make sure the top of the grill does not touch the **Portobello Mushrooms** otherwise you will get the lines which you do not really want for beautifully looking buns.
Once the mushrooms are done you can start assembling the whole keto **Portobello Mushrooms** mushroom **Keto Burger**.
Place one **Portobello Mushrooms** as a base on a plate
Add all of the vegetabels you like, **Salad leaves**, **Slice of Tomato**, **Slice of Cheese**, **Keto Burger** etc
Top with **Portobello Mushrooms** Bun
Brush up with BBQ sauce and sprinkle with Sesame Seeds

title: Low Carb Sauerkraut Chicken
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for our delicious **35 oz Sauerkraut** **17 oz Chicken Breasts​** dish. Chop **1  Onion** into tiny pieces and cut your chicken into smaller cubes.
Into the cooking pot, add a scoop of **1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil** oil, and let it melt. Into it, add your chopped **1  Onion**, and cook on medium heat until it caramelizes.
Once the **1  Onion** is caramelized, add your **17 oz Chicken Breasts​** pieces, salt, **Salt & Pepper**, and cook for approximately 5 to 7 minutes.
Add your **35 oz Sauerkraut** with the liquid as well. Mix it and close the lid. Cook on medium heat for approximately 20 to 25 minutes until your sauerkraut is cooked.
Once the **35 oz Sauerkraut** is cooked and finished, switch the heat off. Add all of the yogurts in
Once the **5 Tablespoons Greek Yogurt** is in, there is no need to cook your **17 oz Chicken Breasts​** **35 oz Sauerkraut** dish anymore. Gently mix everything and serve immediately.

title: Keto Baked Feta Pasta with Palmini Noodles
ingredients: Half of the whole Garlic head
instructions: Heat up the oven to 200C or 400 F.
Prepare all of your ingredients.
Wash your **1 Can Palmini Noodles** noodles to get rid of the acidic flavor.
Into your baking casserole place cherry **1,5 Cups Cherry Tomatoes**, feta **1  Feta Cheese** in the middle, and half **Half of the whole Garlic head**.
Sprinkle with your favorite extra-virgin olive oil and add black **1 tsp Black Pepper** and dry **1 Tbsp Dry Oregano**.
Mix cherry **1,5 Cups Cherry Tomatoes** with olive oil and placed the **Half of the whole Garlic head** baking dish into the oven for 25 minutes up to half an hour on 200C or 400F.
Once everything is baked, take all the **Half of the whole Garlic head** from the skin and gently using your fork to mash **1,5 Cups Cherry Tomatoes** and garlic together.
Gently mash the feta **1  Feta Cheese** as well.
Mix everything.
Once everything is mixed together you can add your choice of Keto noodles, in our case **1 Can Palmini Noodles** Angel Hair.
Sprinkle with freshly cut basil leaves which will give a wonderful flavor to baked **1  Feta Cheese** pasta.
Enjoy straight out of the cast iron or services accordingly.

title: Keto Gnocchi with Fresh Spinach Sauce Recipe
instructions: Prepare your Gnocchi by mixing all of the Ingredients and shaping into your desired type as per our Keto Gnocchi Post.
Prepare all of the ingredients.
In a pot with boiling water, add a little bit of oil and **Salt & Pepper** and cook gnocchi for approximately five minutes depending on the size.
In a cooking pot start cooking **5 Cloves Garlic** together with oil of your choice until garlic gets beautifully golden brown.
Once your **5 Cloves Garlic** is cooked into golden brown, add fresh **3 Cups Fresh Spinach** leaves mix it, and let it cook on medium heat.
Once you see your **3 Cups Fresh Spinach** leaves have been steamed and have shrunk, you can add sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream** and mix them all.

Using your Magic Bullet or any other hand blender or mixer, pour all of the **3 Cups Fresh Spinach** and sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream** mixture in and fully blend until everything is mixed into one beautiful green creamy texture.
Pour all of the creamy **3 Cups Fresh Spinach** mixtures onto your Low Carb Gnocchi.

title: How To Make Homemade Keto Spaghetti
ingredients: 2 Tbsp Bamboo Fiber (alternative Oat Fiber 1 Tbsp)
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients.
Using a magic bullet or a blender you have at home, place **3  Eggs**, cream **1/4 Cup Cream Cheese**, **2 Tbsp Bamboo Fiber (alternative Oat Fiber 1 Tbsp)**, and salt together.
Blend fully until you get a smooth consistency.
Using a silicone baking sheet with edges pour the mixture onto the sheet and spread it as thin as possible.
Place into the oven for eight minutes at 160 Celsius or 320 Fahrenheit.
Once your pasta sheet is baked, turn it upside down and peel the silicone sheet gently.
If you’re going to use a pasta machine, cuts your sheet into the stripes to exactly fit the width of the pasta machine.
Depending on the thickness of your cooked pasta, you might have to decide the thickness level in the machine.
Let it go through the smooth rollers, just to condense the keto pasta sheet together a tiny bit more.
For Spaghetti, feed it into the cutting rollers. Let it makes its way into the roller. Don’t try to force it through.
Use immediately or store it in the refrigerator for later.

title: Keto Stuffed Zucchini Mini Bites
instructions: Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**: Place your **1  Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves** into a Pot and using olive oil caramelize for few minutes.
Once it’s getting brown, add **1/5 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook for 15 minutes.
Add diced **1 Tablespoon Fresh Marjoram** **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
Filling **4  Zucchini**: Wash your zucchini and cut the ends. Using a sharp knife, cut each zucchini into approximately 2 inches or 5 cm in length.
Using either a **1  Small Onion** spoon or a scoop as I have used, make a small hole in the middle of **4  Zucchini** to have them shaped into a cup-like mini bite.
Place them into the casserole dish, which is oven safe, or a baking sheet covered with parchment paper.
Fill each of the **4  Zucchini** cups with bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** and top it up with **1/4 Cup Grated Cheese** cheese of your choice. I have used parmesan cheese.
Place into the oven and bake at 200C or 400F for approximately 30 minutes

title: How To Make Easy Keto Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Prepare 3 various colors of Bell **3  Bell Peppers Various Colors** for that beautiful Rainbow Colors.
With regards to the ingredients for Bolognesses **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** with Keto Ground **1 Cup Minced Beef**, try and dice all of the ingredients into **1  Small Onion** pieces.
Start with your **1  Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves**. Place them into a cooking pot sprinkled with olive oil and caramelize for a few minutes.
Once caramelized, add **1/2 Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook for 15 minutes.
Add diced **1 Tablespoon Fresh Oregano** **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook over medium heat for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
Cut top of each of the **3  Bell Peppers Various Colors** pepper and place on the side to use later.
Clean all of the insides from **3  Bell Peppers Various Colors** pepper and scoop out all of the seeds.
Fill Each of the **3  Bell Peppers Various Colors** pepper with Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** up to the top.
Top it up with grated cheese of your choice, be it parmesan cheese, any hard cheese, or mozzarella.
Once all of the toppings are done, cover with the precut tops of the **3  Bell Peppers Various Colors** Pepper.
Bake in the oven at 200C or 400F for approximately 40 minutes.

title: Keto Sausage Balls
instructions: Heat your oven to 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit. Prepare your **500 grams Sausage**, sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream**, **1 Cup Almond Flour** flour and **1 Cup Shredded Cheese** of your choice.
As you see in the image, I have used our homemade **500 grams Sausage**. Place all of the sausages into a big bowl where you will be mixing our cheesy sausage balls.

Once your **500 grams Sausage** is in the bowl you can start adding all of the other ingredients which is **1 Cup Almond Flour** flour **1 Cup Shredded Cheese** cheese as well as sour **1/2 Cup Sour Cream**. Mix all together, making sure everything is well combined.

To make the sausages exactly the same in size, it is easiest to use either a spoon or if you have an ice **1/2 Cup Sour Cream** scoop. Using a scoop take the amount from the mixture, and using your hands, roll nicely into a bowl.
Layer all **500 grams Sausage** balls onto the cast iron and bake at 200 Celsius or 390 Fahrenheit for approximately 25 minutes.

title: Keto Sausage Recipe
instructions: If you have already made sausage **4 Tablespoons Homemade Sausage Seasoning** beforehand, it is super easy to prepare all other ingredients. All you need is ground **1 kilogram Minced Meat** of your choice and fresh, natural casing you get from the butcher shop.
Wash your natural casing.

Using a big mixing bowl, start **4 Tablespoons Homemade Sausage Seasoning** the **1 kilogram Minced Meat**. Place your ground meat into the mixing bowl and add homemade sausage seasoning. Mix it until all of the spices and herbs are incorporated into the meat.

I believe, by now, you have already picked the funnel you’re going to use for stuffing the **4 Tablespoons Homemade Sausage Seasoning**. If you have your sausage-making kit, make sure it is all prepared. Oil your funner or add water for the **Natural Casing** to slide easier on and off.  Take one end of the casing and gently roll all of it onto the funnel. Using a threat, tie the end of the casing before starting to fill up and make the sausages. For better understanding, look at the video I have made for you.
Whatever gadgets you’re using to fill your sausages, start gently filling them.
Once you’re finished filling the **4 Tablespoons Homemade Sausage Seasoning**, tie the end with a string
Twisting your sausages into a specific size is optional. You can also keep the whole long **4 Tablespoons Homemade Sausage Seasoning** depending on what you’re going to use it for.

title: Baked Keto Stuffed Eggplant Boats
instructions: Prepare all of your ingredients beforehand.
Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**: Start with your **1  Small Onion** and **2  Garlic Cloves**. Place them into a cooking pot sprinkled with olive oil and caramelize for a few minutes.
Once caramelised, add **0,5  Cup Diced Bacon** and **1 Cup Minced Beef** meat, mix and cook for 15 minutes.
Add diced **1 Tablespoon Fresh Oregano** **1/2 Cup Diced Fresh Celery**, herbs, salt & pepper, and mix and cook over medium heat for another 10 minutes.
As of last add **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** sauce and **1/2 Cup Heavy Cream** cream and fully combine.
Cover with the lid and cook for approximately 40 minutes at a medium temperature.
Preheat your oven to 200C or 400F.

Cut Eggplant in half lengthwise using a sharp knife. With a **1 Tablespoon Fresh Oregano**, hollow the middle of the eggplant flesh as you see in the video. Depending on how restricted you are with carbohydrates, you use leftover chopped eggplant flesh in the bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce**. Cut into **1  Small Onion** cubes and add into the sauce before filling the vegetable.

Place all of the eggplant shells into the baking dish or a Casserole, which you are going to use. Fill each of the **2  Eggplants (Melanzani, Aubergine)** with Bolognese **1/3 Cup Tomato Sauce** up to the top.
Top each of the Melanzane with Grated Cheese. You can also top it up with keto breadcrumbs or **0,5  Cup Diced Bacon** bites.
Bake at 200C or 400F for approximately 40 minutes.
Top it up with Italian Seasoning and enjoy.

title: Easy Baked Zucchini with Ground Turkey
ingredients: 2 Pieces Zucchinis (medium, halved and hollowed out)
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) and grease a baking dish. Halve **2 Pieces Zucchinis (medium, halved and hollowed out)** lengthwise, scoop out centers leaving 1/4 inch border, and arrange cut side up.
Brown **1/2 Pound Ground Turkey** turkey with chopped **1/4 Cup Onion (finely chopped)** in a skillet over medium heat for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Stir in **1/2 teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, **1/2 teaspoon Dried Basil**, and **1/2 Cup Sugar-Free Marinara Sauce** sauce; simmer 1–2 minutes until heated and combined.
Fill zucchini halves with **1/2 Pound Ground Turkey** mixture, top with **1/2 Cup Shredded Mozzarella**, and bake 20 minutes until tender and bubbly.

title: Broccoli Casserole with Cheddar Cheese
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) and grease an 8×8-inch dish. Steam fresh **4 Cups Broccoli Florets (fresh or frozen)** or cook frozen as directed, then drain well to prevent excess moisture.
Add **4 Cups Broccoli Florets (fresh or frozen)** to a bowl and stir in the cream of **1½ Cups Cream of Mushroom Soup** soup until evenly coated.
Sprinkle in **2 Cups Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese** cheddar and fold gently to distribute without breaking the **4 Cups Broccoli Florets (fresh or frozen)**.
Spread into the baking dish and bake uncovered 20–25 minutes until melted and bubbly, then let rest briefly before serving.

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Mash with Parmesan
ingredients: 1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425°Fahrenheit (220°Celsius). Slice the **1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)** in half, remove seeds, brush the cut sides with oil, season with **Pinch Salt** and **Pinch Black Pepper (freshly ground)**, flip them cut-side down, and poke the skin a few times.
Roast the **1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)** for 60–75 minutes until tender and caramelized, checking occasionally to ensure even cooking.

Turn the oven to broil, then scoop the soft **1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)** into a bowl, leaving a small border inside the skins so they stay sturdy for filling.

Mash the scooped **1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)** with **¾ Cup Parmesan (grated)**, Greek **¼ Cup Greek Yogurt (plain)**, **½ teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, **Pinch Salt**, and **Pinch Black Pepper (freshly ground)** until smooth and creamy.

Refill the **1 Piece Large Butternut Squash (around 3½–4 pounds, sliced in half and deseeded)** shells with the mash, broil 1–2 minutes until lightly browned, then top with toasted nuts and scallions before serving warm.

title: Easy Cauliflower Vegetable Fried Rice Bowl
ingredients: 1 Piece Cauliflower (medium head, riced (yields about 4 cups))
instructions: Gather riced **1 Piece Cauliflower (medium head, riced (yields about 4 cups))**, **½ Cup Peas**, **½ Cup Carrots (diced)**, **2 Tablespoons Sesame Oil** oil, soy **3 Tablespoons Soy Sauce (or tamari)** or tamari, **2 Pieces Eggs (large, lightly beaten)**, **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (minced)**, **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)**, **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)**, and green **2 Pieces Green Onions (thinly sliced)**. Beat the eggs and mince the garlic so everything is ready before heating the pan.

Heat 1 tablespoon **2 Tablespoons Sesame Oil** oil in a skillet over medium heat, cook the **½ Cup Carrots (diced)** and **½ Cup Peas** until tender, then stir in the **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (minced)** for **1 Piece Cauliflower (medium head, riced (yields about 4 cups))** 1 minute.
Push the veggies aside, pour in the **2 Pieces Eggs (large, lightly beaten)**, and scramble until set, then mix them with the vegetables.

Add the riced **1 Piece Cauliflower (medium head, riced (yields about 4 cups))** and remaining oil, stir to heat through, then drizzle with soy **3 Tablespoons Soy Sauce (or tamari)**, season, and top with green **2 Pieces Green Onions (thinly sliced)** before serving.

title: Cheesy Broccoli and Cauliflower Casserole
ingredients: 1 Piece Broccoli (large head, chopped into small florets (about 5 cups))
1 Piece Cauliflower (small head, cut into florets (about 5 cups))
1 Cup Low Carb Crackers (crushed buttery low carb)
instructions: Blanch **1 Piece Broccoli (large head, chopped into small florets (about 5 cups))** for 2 minutes and **1 Piece Cauliflower (small head, cut into florets (about 5 cups))** for 2–3 minutes, drain well, and let dry while preheating the oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius).
Cook sliced **6 Slices Bacon (thick)** in a skillet until crispy, transfer to a plate, and keep about 1 tablespoon of bacon fat in the pot.

Melt **4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter (divided)** **1 Piece Cauliflower (small head, cut into florets (about 5 cups))** the reserved fat, stir in **2 Cloves Garlic (finely minced)**, **Lemon (zest)** zest, **1/4 teaspoon Cayenne**, and **1 teaspoon Salt (plus more to taste)**, then whisk in **1 Cup Milk (full-fat)** until gently thickened.
Crush **1 Cup Low Carb Crackers (crushed buttery low carb)** and mix with melted **4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter (divided)** and smoked **1/2 teaspoon Smoked Paprika**, then set aside for topping.

Remove the pot from heat, stir in cream **4 Ounce Cream Cheese (softened and cubed)** and **2 Cups Cheddar Cheese (shredded)** until smooth, then fold in the blanched veggies and **1 Piece Broccoli (large head, chopped into small florets (about 5 cups))** **6 Slices Bacon (thick)**.
Spread the cheesy veggie mixture in a buttered dish, top with crumbs, cover and bake 20 minutes, then uncover and bake 20–25 **1 teaspoon Salt (plus more to taste)** until golden and bubbly.

title: Old Fashion Squash Casserole
ingredients: 2 Pounds Yellow Squash (about 5, sliced into ⅓-inch rounds)
½ teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°Fahrenheit (190°Celsius) and grease a 2-quart dish; dice the **½ Cup Sweet Onion (diced )**, measure cheeses, and crush the keto **1 Sleeve Keto Crackers (about 25 crushed)**.
Cut **2 Pounds Yellow Squash (about 5, sliced into ⅓-inch rounds)** squash into thick rounds and place in a large bowl so they hold their texture while baking.

Sauté **½ Cup Sweet Onion (diced )** in **4 Tablespoons Butter (melted)** until soft, then stir in **4 Ounce Cream Cheese (softened)** **8 Ounce Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese (divided)** until melted and smooth.

Mix the **½ Cup Sweet Onion (diced )** blend with **10.5 Ounce Cream of Mushroom Soup** soup, egg, half the **8 Ounce Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese (divided)**, **½ teaspoon Salt**, and **½ teaspoon Freshly Ground Black Pepper**, then toss gently with the **2 Pounds Yellow Squash (about 5, sliced into ⅓-inch rounds)** to coat.
Stir crushed **1 Sleeve Keto Crackers (about 25 crushed)** with melted **4 Tablespoons Butter (melted)** and remaining **8 Ounce Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese (divided)** to create a crunchy topping.
Spread mixture in the dish, top evenly, and bake 20–25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

title: Keto Taco Casserole Recipe with Ground Beef
instructions: First of all, prepare all the ingredients for your **2  Keto Taco Cups** casserole.

Heat your skillet over medium-high, add olive oil and cook the **2 Cups Ground Beef** beef for approximately 10-15 minutes. Once you brown the ground beef, season it with **2  Keto Taco Cups** mixture, mix it thoroughly, and let it cook for an additional 10 minutes.

First place **2  Keto Taco Cups** meat, making sure it covers the whole base of the casserole dish. On top of that goes sour **1 Cup Sour Cream**. As a third layer goes shredded **1 Cup Mozzarella Cheese** which has been granted just before.
Place the prepared casserole into the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes at 300 Fahrenheit or 180 Celsius.

This step will start placing all the toppings you have prepared for our low-carb **2  Keto Taco Cups** casserole. Start with salad leaves, broken-up taco cups shells, **1/4 Cup Black Olives**, and diced **1/4 Cup Tomatoes**.
Lastly, sprinkle with **1/2 Cup Avocado** pieces and freshly chopped **Fresh Cilantro**. You can add extra sauces such as Guacamole, Salsa, Greek Yogurt, or Salsa dressing if you like.

title: Can You Freeze Cabbage?
instructions: Start by removing any damaged or wilted outer leaves from the whole head. Rinse the **1  Cabbage Head** under cold running **1 Liter Water** to remove any dirt or debris. Cut the cabbage into quarters, making sure to keep the core intact. This will help hold the leaves together during freezing.

Blanching is optional when freezing **1  Cabbage Head**, but it can help preserve the color, flavor, and texture. Drop the cabbage wedges or quarters into a pot of boiling **1 Liter Water** for about 90 seconds to blanch. Then, quickly transfer them to a bowl of ice water to stop cooking.
After blanching, allow the **1  Cabbage Head** to drain thoroughly. You want to remove excess moisture to prevent freezer burn.
Now, you can decide how you want to freeze shredded **1  Cabbage Head**. You can freeze it in wedges, shredded, or as whole leaves for stuffed cabbage rolls. Cut it into the desired size.

Place the **1  Cabbage Head** pieces on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Ensure they are in a single layer and not touching. Pop the baking sheet into the freezer. This process, known as "flash freezing," keeps the pieces from sticking together.
Once the **1  Cabbage Head** is completely frozen, transfer the frozen cabbage to freezer bags or containers. Remove as much air as possible before sealing them tightly.

title: Keto Egg Muffins
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°Fahrenheit (175°Celsius) and lightly grease a 6-cup muffin pan so the egg muffins release easily after baking.

Crack the **6  Eggs (large)** into a bowl, add **1/4 Cup Milk (of your choice)**, **1/4 teaspoon Salt**, black **1 Pinch Black Pepper**, and **1/4 teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, then whisk until smooth with no streaks remaining.

Stir in the diced red **1/2 Cup Red Bell Pepper (finely diced)** **1 Pinch Black Pepper**, cooked **1/2 Cup Cooked Sausage (crumbled)**, **1/4 Cup Fresh Spinach (chopped)**, and **1/3 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** cheddar, mixing gently so everything is evenly distributed.

Pour the mixture carefully into the prepared muffin egg cups, filling them 3/4 to the top. Tap the pan lightly on the counter to release any trapped air bubbles. Bake for 18–22 minutes until the centers are set, and a toothpick comes out clean, then let them rest briefly before serving or storing.

title: Chicken Breakfast Sausage
instructions: Gather the ground **1.1 Pounds Ground Chicken (17.6 oz)**, **1/2 Piece Onion (about 4.23 oz, finely diced)** diced onion, and seasonings so everything is ready before you begin. Having ingredients prepped keeps the process smooth.

Combine the ground **1.1 Pounds Ground Chicken (17.6 oz)**, **1/2 Piece Onion (about 4.23 oz, finely diced)**, **1/2 teaspoon Salt**, **1/2 teaspoon Black Pepper (freshly ground)**, **1/2 teaspoon Caraway Seeds**, **1/2 teaspoon Dried Thyme**, **1/4 teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, and **1/4 teaspoon Nutmeg** in a bowl and mix until evenly seasoned throughout.
Divide the mixture into eight equal portions and shape into evenly sized patties for uniform cooking.
Heat **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil (30 ml)** oil over medium heat and cook the patties for 3–4 minutes per side until browned and fully cooked through, then serve or cool for later.

title: Goat Cheese Omelet with Sautéed Spinach
instructions: Gather all ingredients, chop the **1 Cup Spinach (fresh, chopped)**, crumble the goat **2 Ounces Goat Cheese (crumbled)**, and keep **1 Tablespoon Butter**, **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)**, and **½ teaspoon Black pepper (to taste)** within reach.
Crack the **3  Large Eggs** into a bowl, season with **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)** and **½ teaspoon Black pepper (to taste)**, and whisk until smooth and fully combined.
Melt **1 Tablespoon Butter** in a non-stick skillet over medium heat, add the **1 Cup Spinach (fresh, chopped)**, and cook briefly until just wilted.
Pour in the **3  Large Eggs** and cook until mostly set, add goat **2 Ounces Goat Cheese (crumbled)** to one side, fold, and cook another minute until creamy and tender.

title: Baked Feta Eggs
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375 Fahrenheit (190 Celsius). Gather all your ingredients and tools so everything is within reach. Spray your baking pan lightly with oil to avoid sticking.
Place the feta **1 Block Feta Cheese (Block)** in the middle of your prepared pan. Drizzle or spray more oil over the top of the feta for **1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil** creaminess.

Crack the **8 Pieces Eggs** directly into the pan around the **1 Block Feta Cheese (Block)**. Sprinkle the Italian **1 Tablespoon Italian Seasoning** over the top for a nice herb flavor. Add salt and pepper, but remember that feta is salty, so don’t overdo it.

Place the pan in the oven and bake for 15–20 minutes at 400 Fahrenheit (200 Celsius), depending on how you like your **8 Pieces Eggs**. Keep an eye on them to ensure they are not overcooked and the whites are set, but the yolks stay slightly runny.

Remove the pan from the oven and let it cool for a minute. Use a fork to scramble the **8 Pieces Eggs** and **1 Block Feta Cheese (Block)** together, creating a creamy, cheesy texture. Serve immediately and enjoy.

title: How To Cook Bacon in Minutes
instructions: Prepare your sliced **20 Slices Bacon** on the side and heat your stove.

Place your frying pan on the stove and set medium heat to maximum. Once fully hot, add the **20 Slices Bacon** slices to the skillet and let them cook slowly to render the fat and crisp up nicely. Using 2 wooden spatulas, flip and make sure the bacon cooks evenly on all sides. Let it cook until brown and crispy. The cooking time is usually 5 minutes or less depending on the thickness of the bacon.

Keep cooking the **20 Slices Bacon** and add some young onions for additional flavor. This is only optional. After cooking, carefully remove the bacon from the pan and place it on paper towels to drain excess grease. Serve immediately and enjoy your perfectly cooked bacon.

title: Easy Cheesy Breadsticks Recipe Without Eggs
instructions: Prepare all ingredients for easy assembly. At the same time heat up oven to 200 degrees Celsius or 400 Degrees Fahrenheit.

Prepare your **2 Cups Mozzarella Cheese** block and shred the cheese into smaller pieces. Place the shredded mozzarella into a nonstick pot and heat up while mixing slowly. Make sure you melt the mozzarella entirely.

Once your **2 Cups Mozzarella Cheese** is melted, slowly add almond flour or ground **1 Cup Ground Almonds**. Using your spatula, integrate almonds fully into the mozzarella until the dough is soft and without any visible lumps of almond flour.
Having your stove switched off, add baking **1 teaspoon Turmeric Powder**, and using your spatula, mix that again into the fathead dough.
Keep mixing the dough until you end up with a beautifully soft and silky fathead dough to work with.

Transfer the dough onto a silicone sheet and, with your hands, knead the dough for a few minutes until you get a beautiful smooth consistency. Press the dough and knead for a few minutes until you feel the texture is soft and ready for rolling.
Once your dough is smooth and ready, you can roll the dough evenly into a rectangular shape, which will go onto the baking tray.
Once you spread the dough on a silicone sheet or a piece of parchment paper, brush the dough with melted **2 Tablespoons Butter** mixed with **1 teaspoon Turmeric Powder** powder.

Cut the dough along the narrow side into long stripes using a pizza cutter and sprinkle with **1/4 Cup Sesame Seeds** seeds. Place it into the oven and bake the breadsticks for 7 to 9 minutes or until golden brown.

title: Hamburger Keto Buns Recipe
instructions: Gather all the fresh **2 Tablespoons Sunflower Seeds** and nuts you will be using in the recipe. At the same time, preheat your oven to 175 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit.

**1/4 Cup Grind Hazelnuts** and mix the **2 Tablespoons Sunflower Seeds** and nuts. You can do it in a food processor or a grinder. Grinding the seeds and nuts just before using them will intensify their flavor and ensure they blend well in the mixture.
Using a kitchen machine, whisk the egg whites until they become frothy. Then, add the egg yolks, dry seed, and nut mixture from the previous step. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined.

Add **1/2 Tablespoon Vinegar** and water to the mixture. The vinegar helps with leavening and adds a tangy flavor, while the water helps hydrate the ingredients and create the desired consistency. Mix the ingredients until a sticky dough forms.

Wet your hands with water to prevent sticking, and shape the dough into small balls. Place the balls onto a lined baking sheet, leaving some space between them. Using the palm of your hand, gently press down on each ball to flatten and form a bun shape. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes at 175 Celsius or 350 Fahrenheit or until the buns are golden **3 Tablespoons Flax Seeds brown** and baked through.

title: Easy Shakshuka Recipe
ingredients: 2 Pieces Jalapeños (or Red Chili Peppers, diced (swap with green bell pepper if desired))
instructions: Chop **1 Cup Onion (diced)**, bell **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)**, **2 Pieces Jalapeños (or Red Chili Peppers, diced (swap with green bell pepper if desired))**, **3 Cloves Garlic (minced)**, and **3 Tablespoons Fresh Cilantro (chopped)**, then heat **1 Tablespoon Olive Oil** oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat.

Sauté **1 Cup Onion (diced)** and bell **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)** 6–7 minutes until soft, then stir in **2 Pieces Jalapeños (or Red Chili Peppers, diced (swap with green bell pepper if desired))**, **3 Cloves Garlic (minced)**, **1 Tablespoon Smoked Paprika**, **½ teaspoon Ground Cumin**, **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)**, and pepper just until fragrant.
Pour in diced **1 Can diced tomatoes (28 ounces)**, lightly crush, and simmer uncovered 10–30 minutes until slightly thickened; stir in most of the **3 Tablespoons Fresh Cilantro (chopped)**.

Make wells, crack in **6  Eggs**, cover, and cook until whites set; top **2 Pieces Jalapeños (or Red Chili Peppers, diced (swap with green bell pepper if desired))** **½ Cup Crumbled Feta** and remaining **3 Tablespoons Fresh Cilantro (chopped)** before serving.

title: Creamy Pimento Cheese Spread
ingredients: 4 Ounce Pimentos (1 jar, diced, drained well)
¼ teaspoon Hot Sauce (a splash, optional)
instructions: Gather **1 Cup Monterey Jack (finely shredded )** cheeses, cream **4 Ounce Cream Cheese (softened)**, mayo, drained **4 Ounce Pimentos (1 jar, diced, drained well)**, **1 Piece Green **¼ teaspoon Onion Powder** (thinly sliced)** onion, spices, and optional hot **¼ teaspoon Hot Sauce (a splash, optional)** so everything is ready to mix.
Mix softened cream **4 Ounce Cream Cheese (softened)** and **½ Cup Mayonnaise** in a bowl until completely smooth and lump-free.
Fold in **2 Cups Sharp Cheddar Cheese (finely shredded )** and **1 Cup Monterey Jack (finely shredded )** Jack gently so they’re evenly coated without overmixing.

Add **4 Ounce Pimentos (1 jar, diced, drained well)**, **1 Piece Green **¼ teaspoon Onion Powder** (thinly sliced)** onion, and spices, mixing until well distributed; adjust **½ teaspoon Salt** or hot **¼ teaspoon Hot Sauce (a splash, optional)** if needed.
Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to firm up, then serve with crackers or veggies.

title: Seared Salmon with Avocado and Lime
ingredients: 2 Pieces Avocados (ripe, cut into small chunks)
instructions: Pat **4 Pieces Salmon (about 6 ounces each)** dry and season both sides with **1 teaspoon Paprika**, **½ teaspoon Salt (to taste)**, and **½ teaspoon Pepper (to taste)**, pressing the spices in lightly.

Mix diced avocado, cherry **1 Cup Cherry Tomatoes (cut into quarters)**, red **¼ Cup Red Onion (finely diced)**, **¼ Cup Fresh Cilantro (chopped)**, and **1 Piece Lime (juice)** juice, then season and toss gently to keep it chunky.
Heat **1 tablespoon Olive Oil** oil over medium-high and cook **4 Pieces Salmon (about 6 ounces each)** 4–5 minutes per side until golden outside and just cooked through.
Top the warm **4 Pieces Salmon (about 6 ounces each)** with the **¼ Cup Fresh Cilantro (chopped)** avocado mixture and serve right away

title: Fried Dill Pickles Spears
instructions: Collect dill **8 Pieces Pickle Spears** slices, **1/2 Cup Coconut Flour** flour, eggs, and breadcrumbs, then set up three shallow bowls for each coating stage to keep things quick and tidy.
Pat the **8 Pieces Pickle Spears** slices dry and lightly coat them in **1/2 Cup Coconut Flour** flour, shaking off any excess so the layers stick without getting too thick.
Whisk the eggs until smooth, then dip each floured **8 Pieces Pickle Spears** slice into the egg to fully coat and help the breadcrumb layer adhere.
Press each egg-coated **8 Pieces Pickle Spears** into the breadcrumbs until covered on both sides, then set them aside while you heat the oil.
Fry the coated pickles in hot oil over medium heat for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and crisp, then drain on paper towels before serving.

title: Crispy and Juicy Air Fryer Recipe Shrimp
instructions: Preheat the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 3 minutes. Gather peeled **1 Pound Large Shrimp (peeled and deveined)**, **2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil** oil, **1 teaspoon Sweet Paprika Spice**, **½ teaspoon Garlic Powder** granules, **½ teaspoon Salt**, and cracked **¼ teaspoon Black Pepper (freshly ground)** so everything is ready.

Whisk **2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil** oil, **1 teaspoon Sweet Paprika Spice**, **½ teaspoon Garlic Powder** powder, **½ teaspoon Salt**, and **¼ teaspoon Black Pepper (freshly ground)** in a bowl until evenly combined into a smooth seasoning mix.
Toss the **1 Pound Large Shrimp (peeled and deveined)** in the seasoned oil until fully coated and let them rest for 10 minutes so the flavors absorb.

Arrange **1 Pound Large Shrimp (peeled and deveined)** in a single layer in the basket and cook for 5–6 minutes, flipping or shaking halfway. Finish with fresh **Fresh Parsley (chopped, for garnish (optional))** and a squeeze of **Lemon Wedges (optional, for serving)** before serving.

title: Fresh Zucchini Fritters with Chicken
ingredients: 1 Piece Zucchini (medium, grated and squeezed well to remove moisture)
instructions: Set out ground **1 Pound Ground Chicken**, grated **1 Piece Zucchini (medium, grated and squeezed well to remove moisture)**, egg, green **2 Pieces Green Onions (thinly sliced)**, **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (finely minced)**, spices, and **¼ teaspoon Olive Oil (for frying)** oil so everything is ready to use.
Grate the **1 Piece Zucchini (medium, grated and squeezed well to remove moisture)** and squeeze out as much moisture as possible to keep the fritters from turning soggy.

Combine **1 Pound Ground Chicken**, **1 Piece Zucchini (medium, grated and squeezed well to remove moisture)**, egg, green **2 Pieces Green Onions (thinly sliced)**, **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (finely minced)**, **½ teaspoon Smoked Paprika**, onion **½ teaspoon Onion Powder**, **½ teaspoon Salt**, and **¼ teaspoon Black Pepper (ground)** until evenly mixed.
Form into 1½-inch balls and pan-fry in **¼ teaspoon Olive Oil (for frying)** oil over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.

title: Air Fried Dill Pickles
instructions: Gather dill **3 Pieces Pickles (big)**, **1/2 Cup Coconut Flour** flour, eggs, and **1/2 Cup Breading**, pat the pickles dry, slice as desired, and preheat the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius).
Lightly dust each pickle **1 Piece Egg** in **1/2 Cup Coconut Flour** flour, shaking off excess so the egg adheres properly.
Whisk the eggs, then dip each floured pickle until fully coated, letting any extra drip off.
Press **3 Pieces Pickles (big)** into the **1/2 Cup Breading**, coat evenly, and place in a single layer in the air fryer basket.
Cook at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) for 5 minutes until lightly golden.
Flip with tongs and air fry 3 more minutes until crisp and golden, then serve hot.

title: Keto Fried Pickles
instructions: Gather all your ingredients, including **15 Pieces Mini Pickles (Whole)**, dry coating mix, eggs, and any seasonings you plan to use. Make sure your pickles are drained well to avoid excess moisture. Have the oven preheated to 200°Celsius (400°Fahrenheit).

Lightly dip each pickle slice into **1/2 Cup Coconut Flour** flour, making sure it’s fully covered but not overloaded. This step creates a dry base that helps the egg layer stick perfectly. Make sure the coating is evenly pressed for the best results.

Beat the eggs in a separate bowl to create the wet coating. This helps the dry coating stick better to the **15 Pieces Mini Pickles (Whole)**. Dip each pickle slice into the egg mixture before moving on to the dry coating.
Roll each egg-dipped pickle into your **1 Cup Breading**. Gently press to make sure everything sticks all around. Make sure all **15 Pieces Mini Pickles (Whole)** are ready for crisping up.

Place the coated dill pickle slices on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake in a preheated oven until they’re golden for 10 minutes. Turn them and cook for 5 more minutes. Serve warm with your favorite dipping sauce for a tasty snack.

title: Air Fryer Frozen Onion Rings
instructions: Take the frozen **12 Pieces Onion Rings (Frozen)** rings straight out of the freezer—no need to thaw them. Lightly spray them with EVO oil to improve their crispiness, but this step is optional. Preheat your air fryer.

Lightly spray the air fryer basket with EVO oil to prevent sticking and improve crispiness. This step helps create a golden, crunchy texture while reheating. Make sure the oil is evenly distributed across the basket before adding the **12 Pieces Onion Rings (Frozen)** rings.

Arrange the frozen **12 Pieces Onion Rings (Frozen)** rings inside the air fryer basket in a single layer. Avoid overcrowding to ensure they cook evenly and get crispy all around. If needed, cook in batches for the best results.

Set the air fryer to 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) and cook the **12 Pieces Onion Rings (Frozen)** rings for 7 minutes. The hot air circulation will help them crisp up while keeping the inside tender. Check on them halfway to ensure they’re cooking evenly.

Use tongs to flip each **12 Pieces Onion Rings (Frozen)** ring carefully for an even crunch. Air fry for another 7 minutes at 400°Fahrenheit (200°Celsius) until they are golden and crispy. Serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauce.

title: Low Carb Tabbouleh Salad
instructions: Prepare and clean all of the ingredients for the salad.
With chopping knife, cut **1  Big Bunch Parsley** to a smallest pieces you can manage.
Cut all of the **2  Medium Size Tomatoes** into small squares.
Separate mint **50 grams Mint Leaves** from the stems and using chopping knife, cut mint leaves into the smallest tiny pieces you can manage.
Place all of the ingredients into a **2  Medium Size Tomatoes** size bowl and add Hemp **0,5 Cup Hemp Seeds**.
Take **1  Lemon** and squeeze all the juice from it onto the bowl with all ingredients in.
Use the best extra virgin **2 Tablespoons Olive Oil** oil you have and add it in.
With a big spoon mix all of the ingredients together to have the best ever Low Carb Tabbouleh salad. Add dash of salt and pepper and taste.

title: Best Low Carb Oven Roasted Beet Spread Recipe
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200C or 400 F.
Prepare all of the ingredients for easier set up.
Wash your beetroots but you do not have to peel them.
Having prepared your aluminium foil, cut the **1  Head of Garlic** head into half and cover each half with aluminum foil.
The same applies to Beets.
Once all of your beetroots are packed in the foil as well as **1  Head of Garlic**, place them all onto the baking sheet and straight into the oven for roasting.
Depending on the size of your beetroots, roast them for about 45 minutes to an Hour on 200 Celsius or 400 Fahrenheit.
Once your beetroots and **1  Head of Garlic** are roasted in the oven take them out, open and let them cool down.
When they’re cool you can peel the skin off the beads first. Make sure your beets are room temperature before going into the next step.
Using a cheese grater great your beets one by one in a glass bowl.
Once you grate all of the beetroots, take out the insights from the roasted **1  Head of Garlic** and add it into the glass bowl where the beets are.
Add remaining ingredients such as creme **150 g Creme Fraiche** or cream cheese.
Depending on the spiciness add 1 tablespoon of freshly grated **1 TBsp Horseradish**.
A pinch of salt and black **Salt & Pepper** and you’re done.
Using a fork mix all of the ingredients together and your beautiful simple and easy beetroot low carb spread is done in no time.
Enjoy and bon appétit.

title: TikTok Green Goddess Salad Recipe
ingredients: 4  Small Cucumbers or half of the big one
instructions: If you have not prepared your **5-6  Streaks Fresh Green Onions** goddess dressing in advance, I have a complete recipe with step-by-step and video instructions on how to make it.
Prepare all of the ingredients for the **5-6  Streaks Fresh Green Onions** goddess salad. Every single vegetable needs to be cut into the smallest pieces possible.
In a big mixing bowl, first, add your **Half Cabbage**.
Into the **Half Cabbage**, add freshly cut cucumber.
As the third ingredient, **5-6  Streaks Fresh Green Onions** spring goes in.
Chive is our last ingredient and could be replaced by any other herbs you have.
Add your **5-6  Streaks Fresh Green Onions** goddess dressing once you have all of the vegetables in a big mixing bowl.
Using a spatula or big spoon, gently start folding the **5-6  Streaks Fresh Green Onions** dressing into the vegetables.

title: Keto Broccoli Salad with Bacon
ingredients: 1/2 Cup Roasted Pumpkin Seeds / Hemp Seeds
2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar (mayo, Sour Cream, Ranch Dressing)
instructions: Prepare all of the ingredients. Chop your **1  Chopped Onion**, cut **1/2 or 1 Cup Bacon Bits**, roast **1/2 Cup Roasted Pumpkin Seeds / Hemp Seeds** seeds for the crunch, shred **1/2 Cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese** and wash **1/2 Cup Blueberries**. If you are not planning to blanch your **1  Broccoli - blanch for 2 minutes**, wash and cut it into florets.
Take whole **1  Broccoli - blanch for 2 minutes** head and submerge into the boiling water for 3 minutes. Immediately take out and place into a big bowl filled with ice cubes and cold water.
As all other ingredients are prepared, dry your **1  Broccoli - blanch for 2 minutes** thoroughly and cut it into small florets. Place into the bowl big enough so you can mix it all in.
One by one, add all of the ingredients into the bowl.
Lastly, add 2 **2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar (mayo, Sour Cream, Ranch Dressing)** of unfiltered apple cider vinegar.
Gently mix all together, ensuring all ingredients are thoroughly blended with **1/2 Cup Yogurt** and **2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar (mayo, Sour Cream, Ranch Dressing)**.

title: Best Avocado Egg Salad Recipe
instructions: Prepare all ingredients needed. Use a ripe **1  Avocado**; **2 Tablespoons Greek Yogurt** can be made in liters using Instant Pot.
Slice the **1  Avocado** in **Juice from Half Lemon** and cut it into small chunky square-shaped pieces. Place it into the medium size bowl, where you mix the whole salad afterward.

For this recipe, I have used pre-**3  Eggs Boiled** eggs, which I have left to cool down. You do not want to add eggs that are still warm because, in the end, this salad is supposed to be refreshing, and the heat from the eggs might make the **1  Avocado** brown quickly before adding **Juice from Half Lemon** in.
Chop **1/2 Cup Chives** and add them to the bowl.
Adding Greek **2 Tablespoons Greek Yogurt** to this **1  Avocado** salad will give more creaminess and replace mayonnaise for some used to it.
Squeeze whole half a **Juice from Half Lemon** into the mixture, especially over the avocados.
Add a generous amount of extra virgin **EV Olive Oil** oil to the bowl.
Add a little salt and pepper and adequately mix the whole salad. Add more herbs and lemon **Juice from Half Lemon**, salt, or pepper, and serve.

title: Tomato and Cucumber Salad with Feta
instructions: Collect all your ingredients first to make the process easy. You’ll need fresh **1 Piece Cucumber (seeded and sliced)**, **3 Cups Cherry Tomatoes (halved )**, green **2 Pieces Green Peppers (chopped)**, onion, **1 Cup Black Olives**, **1 Piece Feta (block, cubed)** cheese, **1 Cup Mint Leaves (fresh)**, and a few pantry staples for the dressing. Having everything washed, measured, and within reach makes prep a breeze.

In a small mixing bowl, combine **¼ Cup Olive Oil (extra-virgin)** oil, your preferred **3 Tablespoons Vinegar (Red wine or white)**, minced **2 Pieces Garlic Cloves (minced finely)**, dried **1 teaspoon Oregano (Dried)**, Dijon **1 teaspoon Dijon Mustard**, **1 teaspoon Sea Salt**, and **1 teaspoon Black pepper (Ground)**. Whisk or shake until everything is well combined and slightly thickened. Let it sit while you focus on the vegetables so the flavors blend nicely.

Cut the **1 Piece Cucumber (seeded and sliced)** in half lengthwise, scoop out the seeds, and slice it thinly. Dice the bell **2 Pieces Green Peppers (chopped)**, halve the cherry **3 Cups Cherry Tomatoes (halved )**, and thinly slice the red onion. Cube the **1 Piece Feta (block, cubed)** and set out the **1 Cup Black Olives** and **1 Cup Mint Leaves (fresh)** so they’re ready for assembly.

Add all the prepped vegetables and **1 Piece Feta (block, cubed)** to a large bowl or arrange them on a serving platter. Drizzle the dressing over everything and toss gently, being careful not to break up the feta too much. Sprinkle a little more **1 teaspoon Oregano (Dried)** on top and finish with fresh **1 Cup Mint Leaves (fresh)** for a pop of flavor.

title: Refreshing Cucumber Dill Salad with Red Onion
ingredients: ½ Piece Red Onion (sliced extra thin)
instructions: Start by collecting all your ingredients: **2 Pieces English Cucumbers (thinly sliced)**, red **½ Piece Red Onion (sliced extra thin)**, apple cider **¼ Cup Apple Cider Vinegar**, **1 Tablespoon Simple Syrup** syrup, sea **1 teaspoon Salt**, **2 Tablespoons Fresh **Extra Dill for Garnish (optional)** (chopped)** dill, and black **Black Pepper (freshly cracked)**. Rinse the vegetables thoroughly and pat them dry with a clean towel. Grab a roomy mixing bowl where you’ll bring it all together.

Thinly slice the **2 Pieces English Cucumbers (thinly sliced)** into rounds and do the same with the red **½ Piece Red Onion (sliced extra thin)**. Aim for even slices so they soak up the marinade evenly. Chop the dill finely and keep a bit aside if you'd like to **Extra Dill for Garnish (optional)** at the end.

Place the sliced **2 Pieces English Cucumbers (thinly sliced)** and onions into your mixing bowl. Add the **¼ Cup Apple Cider Vinegar**, sweetener, and **1 teaspoon Salt**, then gently stir to coat the vegetables without mashing them. You want everything to be evenly dressed while keeping the textures crisp.

Pop the salad into the fridge for at least 20 minutes to let the flavors blend. Once chilled, drain off any **Extra Dill for Garnish (optional)** liquid and move the salad to a serving dish. Top with the reserved dill and a touch of freshly ground black **Black Pepper (freshly cracked)** before serving.

title: How To Grow Broccoli Sprouts
instructions: Prepare your seeds and water.

Add the **4 Tablespoons Broccoli sprouting seeds** seeds into a glass container and cover with water. Close the lid and let soak broccoli seeds in water on your kitchen counter at room temperature for 24 hours.

Pick one of the mini casserole dishes or a late with edges. Cut a kitchen paper towel to fit your plate. 2 sheets for the base and 2 sheets on top. Place paper towel sheets at the base of your plate and spray water to moisten it. Sprinkle 2 **4 Tablespoons Broccoli sprouting seeds** of broccoli seeds that have been soaked, and spread them around the whole area using your hand. On top, place another kitchen paper towel and spray that as well to be moist. Throughout the next 2 to 3 days, spray the plate to ensure the paper is always moist.

After about 2 to 3 days, you will see the sprout growing. This is when you can take the top layer of the paper out. Spray your sprouting seeds again at least twice daily, ensuring they are constantly moist.

After your seeds have been soaked for 24 hours, wash them thoroughly. Place into the mason jar or any other glass jar with an open lid. You need about two **4 Tablespoons Broccoli sprouting seeds** of broccoli seeds per jar. Cover the jar with a mesh or cheese cloth and close the lid. Rinse the seeds once again and let all of the water run out. Place your jar upside down onto one of the small salad bowl.
Rinse your sprouts every day with running water and let the magic of sprouting work it is way. In about 5 days, you will see the fresh sprouts fully grown and ready to enjoy.

title: Keto Mashed Cauliflower Recipe

instructions: Gather ingredients, crush the **3 Cloves Garlic**, shred the cheddar, and prepare the **2 Cups Cauliflower Rice (half of medium cauliflower)** rice.
